1.1: Blessed is the one who don't be takin' advice from shady folks, don't chill where sinners hang out, and don't post up with folks who stay mocking.
1.2: Instead, they be lovin' the Lord's Word—thinkin' on it day and night like it's they favorite song on repeat.
1.3: They like a tree planted by a stream—deep roots, strong trunk. Always got fruit in season, leaves don't shrivel, and everything they touch? It flourish.
1.4: But the wicked? Nah, they ain't built like that. They like dry husks—blown away by the wind, ain't got no foundation.
1.5: That's why they won't hold up in court when judgment hits, and they don't belong where the righteous folks gather.
1.6: The Lord sees and knows the way of the righteous—He walkin' with them. But the path of the wicked? That road lead straight to ruin.

2.1: Why the nations wildin'? Why folks out here plottin' stuff that ain't gon' work?
2.2: The kings of the world settin' theyselves up, the rulers all teamin' up—tryna come at the Lord and His Chosen One like they gon' do somethin'.
2.3: They say, 'Let's break free from all this! We done with their rules and control.'
2.4: But the One sittin' up in heaven? He just laughs. God lookin' at 'em like, 'Y'all really tried it.'
2.5: Then He gon' speak, and when He do—it's gon' be heat. His anger gon' shake 'em up real good.
2.6: He say, 'I already picked My King, and He posted up on Zion—My holy mountain.'
2.7: Lemme go 'head and repeat what God said: 'You my Son. Today, I made that official.'
2.8: 'Ask Me, and I'll hand You the nations. The whole earth Yours if You want it.'
2.9: 'You gon' break 'em down with an iron rod—like smashin' clay pots, no mercy.'
2.10: So look, kings—y'all better wise up. And judges? Y'all better listen close.
2.11: Serve the Lord with some real respect, and celebrate Him—but don't get too casual. Keep it humble.
2.12: Show love to the Son, or He might get heated—and when He do, it's a wrap. One spark of His anger and folks get wiped out. But if you trust Him? You blessed.

3.1: Lord, my enemies just keep multiplying! So many folks tryna come for me now.
3.2: Plenty of people out here sayin', 'He ain't got no help—God not messin' with him.'
3.3: But You, Lord? You my shield. You my honor. You the one that keep my head held high.
3.4: I cried out loud to You, Lord—and You heard me from Your holy mountain.
3.5: I laid down and went to sleep. I woke up still breathing—'cause You kept me safe through the night.
3.6: I ain't scared, not even if ten thousand folks surroundin' me on all sides.
3.7: Get up, Lord! Save me, my God! You been out here swingin'—You hit my enemies in the face and knocked out they teeth.
3.8: Rescue comes from You, Lord. Your blessing stay on Your people.

4.1: God of my right standing—hear me when I call! You came through for me when I was stressed. Have mercy, and listen to my prayer.
4.2: Y'all, how long you gon' try to shame me? How long you gon' chase empty things and fall for lies?
4.3: But know this—the Lord set apart the real ones for Himself. When I call on Him, He gon' hear me.
4.4: Go 'head and be mad—but don't sin. Lay in bed, think on it, and be still.
4.5: Bring God the right kind of offering—one that's honest. And trust Him for real.
4.6: Plenty folks out here askin', 'Who gon' come through with something good?' Lord, let Your face shine on us.
4.7: You done filled my heart with joy—more than they get when they pockets full and their wine flowing.
4.8: I'm gon' lay down and sleep in peace, 'cause You the only one, Lord, who keeps me safe.

5.1: Lord, listen to what I'm sayin'. Hear what's heavy on my heart.
5.2: Pay attention to my cry, my King and my God—'cause I'm talkin' to You.
5.3: Every morning, You gon' hear my voice. I lay my prayers before You early, and I wait, watchin'.
5.4: You not the kind of God that mess with wickedness—evil can't chill where You at.
5.5: The arrogant ain't got no space in Your presence. You not rockin' with folks who do dirty.
5.6: You takin' out the liars. You can't stand folks who love violence and play people.
5.7: But me? I'm comin' into Your house leanin' on Your mercy. I bow down in reverence, facin' Your holy place.
5.8: Lord, lead me right—'cause my enemies lurkin'. Show me the straight path.
5.9: Ain't nothin' true in their words. Deep down, they full of destruction. Their throats wide open like graves, and they slick with the talk.
5.10: Hold 'em accountable, God. Let 'em trip over their own schemes. Kick 'em out for all the wrong they do—'cause they went against You.
5.11: But everybody who trust You? Let 'em celebrate! Let 'em shout with joy, 'cause You coverin' them. Let the ones who love Your name turn up in joy.
5.12: Lord, You bless the righteous. You cover 'em in favor like a shield.

6.1: Lord, please don't check me outta anger. Don't discipline me when You heated.
6.2: Have mercy on me, Lord—I'm weak right now. Heal me, 'cause my body hurt deep.
6.3: My soul feel heavy too… But You, Lord—how long I gotta wait?
6.4: Come back for me, Lord. Pull me outta this. Save me, not 'cause I'm worthy, but 'cause You got mercy.
6.5: 'Cause once I'm gone, I can't praise You. Ain't no shoutin' You out from the grave.
6.6: I'm tired of cryin'. My bed soaked every night, tears floodin' my pillow.
6.7: My eyes done puffed up from all this grief—worn out from dealin' with these enemies.
6.8: Y'all who do evil? Fall back. The Lord heard my cryin'.
6.9: Yeah, the Lord heard my request. He gon' take my prayer in.
6.10: All my enemies? Let 'em be ashamed and shook. Let 'em retreat quick, embarrassed and broken.

7.1: Lord my God, I'm puttin' all my trust in You. Save me from the folks tryna hunt me down. Rescue me.
7.2: If You don't, they gon' tear me up like a lion—rippin' me apart, and nobody gon' be there to help.
7.3: Lord my God, if I really did something foul—if I got guilt on my hands—
7.4: If I paid back somebody's peace with drama, or stole from an enemy without reason—
7.5: Then go 'head, let the enemy catch me. Let him stomp me out, drag me down to the dirt, and bury my name.
7.6: But Lord, if that ain't me—get up! Rise in Your anger. Push back the rage of my enemies. Step in with the justice You already declared!
7.7: Let all the people gather 'round You. Come back and sit high above it all for their sake.
7.8: You judge everybody, Lord. So judge me based on how I've lived—on the integrity inside me.
7.9: Let the wicked mess come to an end, God. But lift up the ones tryin' to do right. You the kind of God that check hearts and motives.
7.10: You my defense, God. You save the ones who stay solid in their heart.
7.11: God don't play favorites—He a righteous judge. And He stay mad at wickedness every single day.
7.12: If folks don't turn from their mess, God gon' sharpen His sword. He already pullin' back His bow.
7.13: He gettin' ready with weapons that bring death. His arrows? They comin' in hot—on fire.
7.14: Wicked folks be pregnant with sin—they carry trouble and birth straight-up lies.
7.15: They dig pits for others, but end up fallin' in their own trap.
7.16: Everything they plotted gon' bounce back on 'em. The violence they dealt? It's comin' down on their own head.
7.17: But me? I'ma praise the Lord for His righteousness. I'ma sing to the name of the Lord Most High!

8.1: Lord, our Lord—Your name hit different across the whole earth. Your glory? It's higher than the heavens!
8.2: Even babies and toddlers be speakin' strength. You set that up to shut down Your haters and those who come for You.
8.3: When I look up at the sky You made—see the moon and stars, all that handiwork You designed—
8.4: I gotta ask, what's man that You even think about us? What's the son of man, that You'd pull up to be with us?
8.5: You made us just a little under the angels. Then turned around and crowned us with glory and honor.
8.6: You put us in charge of what You created—everything You made is under our feet.
8.7: The sheep, the oxen, and all the wild animals out in the field,
8.8: The birds flyin' high, and the fish swimmin' deep—everything movin' through the seas.
8.9: Lord, our Lord—Your name is powerful in every corner of the earth!

9.1: I'm gon' praise You, Lord, with everything I got. I'ma tell everybody what You done did.
9.2: I'm rejoicing in You, gon' be glad and sing to Your name, Most High.
9.3: When my enemies fall back, they trip and disappear at just the sight of You.
9.4: You been holdin' me down—defendin' my name and my cause. You sit on the throne, judgin' with fairness.
9.5: You checked the nations, took out the wicked, and erased their names—like forever.
9.6: Enemy, your time up. You done wiped out cities—but even their memory gone now.
9.7: But the Lord? He still standin'. His throne set for judgment that don't shake.
9.8: He judge the whole world with righteousness. He deal with people the right way.
9.9: The Lord a safe place for the oppressed—a shelter when the storm hits.
9.10: Everybody who know Your name put they trust in You. You ain't never left folks who look for You.
9.11: Sing to the Lord, who lives in Zion! Let the world know what He done done.
9.12: He don't forget the blood that's been spilled. He hear the cries of the humble loud and clear.
9.13: Have mercy on me, Lord. See how they treatin' me out here—You the one who lifted me up from the edge of death.
9.14: So I can keep shoutin' about You in the city. I'ma rejoice in how You saved me.
9.15: The nations done fell into the traps they set. They caught in their own mess.
9.16: God makes it known—His judgment hit different. The wicked get caught in their own drama.
9.17: The wicked get tossed into hell—same with every nation that forgets God.
9.18: But the poor? They ain't gon' be forgotten forever. The needy still got hope.
9.19: Get up, Lord! Don't let these folks win. Judge the nations to they face.
9.20: Scare 'em straight, Lord. Let 'em know—they just human.

10.1: Lord, why You feel so far away? Why You hidin' when things get hard?
10.2: The wicked stay pressin' the poor with pride—catch 'em in the same traps they set.
10.3: They brag on whatever their selfish heart want. They hype up greed and throw shade at You.
10.4: They too full of themselves to seek God. You ain't even on they mind.
10.5: They always seem to be winnin'. Your judgments? Too high up for them to notice. They look down on everybody who stand against 'em.
10.6: They say to theyself, 'I'm untouchable. Ain't nothin' ever gon' shake me.'
10.7: But their mouth full of cussin', lies, and threats. Under their tongue? Trouble and sin stay hidin'.
10.8: They post up in the cut, watchin'. In the shadows, they take out the innocent. They stay focused on the ones who can't defend theyself.
10.9: They move like a lion hidin' in the brush—waitin' to snatch the poor and pull 'em into their net.
10.10: They crouch low, ready to pounce—so the helpless get crushed under their weight.
10.11: They tell themselves, 'God ain't watchin'. He forgot all about this. He ain't gon' do nothin'.'
10.12: Get up, Lord! Lift Your hand, God. Don't forget the ones who humble themselves.
10.13: Why the wicked act like You not real? Why they think You won't ever check 'em?
10.14: But You see it all. You pay attention to pain and injustice. You gon' step in. The helpless lean on You. You come through for the fatherless.
10.15: Break the power of the wicked, Lord. Chase down every bit of evil until it's all gone.
10.16: You the King, Lord—forever and ever. The nations that ain't with You? They done disappeared from Your land.
10.17: Lord, You hear what the humble want. You steady workin' on their hearts. You lean in and listen.
10.18: You gon' bring justice for the orphan and the oppressed—so the wicked on earth can't keep runnin' things.

11.1: I'm trustin' in the Lord—so how you gon' tell me, 'Run like a bird and hide in the mountains'?
11.2: Look—evil folks got they bows pulled back, arrows loaded up, ready to shoot at the ones tryna live right, and they do it from the shadows.
11.3: If the very foundation fall apart, what can the righteous even do?
11.4: The Lord still sittin' in His holy temple. His throne locked in up in heaven. He watchin'—His eyes test everybody down here.
11.5: God checks the hearts of the righteous. But the wicked? The ones who love violence? He can't stand 'em.
11.6: The wicked gon' get coals dropped on 'em. Fire, brimstone, and hot winds—that's what's in their cup.
11.7: The Lord is righteous, and He loves when folks do right. His face shines on the ones who walk upright.

12.1: Help us, Lord! The real ones out here disappearin'. Folks who used to stand on truth? They vanishin'.
12.2: Everybody talkin' slick to each other—flattery in their mouth, but their hearts got two faces.
12.3: Lord, shut down all them smooth-talking lips and every tongue that talk big with pride.
12.4: They out here sayin', 'We gon' win with our words. We say what we want—ain't nobody our master.'
12.5: But the Lord say, 'Because the poor been crushed and the needy stay cryin', I'ma get up now. I'ma place them somewhere safe—exactly what they been waitin' for.'
12.6: The Lord's words? Pure. Like silver refined in the fire—seven times over. No flaws, no cap.
12.7: You gon' keep those words, Lord. You gon' protect Your people from this wild generation forever.
12.8: The wicked lurk everywhere—'cause when filth gets praised, they walk tall in the streets.

13.1: How long, Lord? You gon' forget about me forever? How long You gon' keep turnin' Your face away?
13.2: How long I gotta wrestle with my own thoughts, carry this heartache every day? How long my enemies gon' keep winnin' over me?
13.3: Look my way, Lord my God. Hear me. Light up my eyes—don't let me fall into the sleep of death.
13.4: Don't let my enemy say, 'Yep, I beat him.' Don't let the ones hatin' on me throw a party if I slip.
13.5: But I'm still trustin' in Your mercy. My heart gon' keep smilin' 'cause I know You'll save me.
13.6: I'ma sing to You, Lord, 'cause You been good to me—real good.

14.1: A fool talkin' to they own heart say, 'Ain't no God.' They twisted—doin' dirty and evil with no shame. Ain't nobody out here really doin' good.
14.2: The Lord lookin' down from heaven, watchin' all of us—tryna see if anybody got some sense, anybody really seekin' Him.
14.3: But everybody done swerved off. Together, they all corrupted. Not one of 'em out here doin' right—not a single soul.
14.4: Don't these wicked folks know anything? They chew up my people like it's lunch and don't even think to call on the Lord.
14.5: But watch—they gon' be scared for real, 'cause God ride with the righteous generation.
14.6: Y'all try to shame the poor for standin' firm, but the Lord? He their safe place.
14.7: Man, I wish salvation for Israel would come down from Zion! When the Lord brings His people back from captivity, Jacob gon' celebrate, and Israel gon' be glad for real.

15.1: Lord, who can chill in Your tent? Who can live up on Your holy hill?
15.2: The one who walk right, do right, and speak truth straight from the heart.
15.3: The one who don't talk behind folks' backs, don't do his neighbor dirty, and don't throw shade on his own people.
15.4: He don't gas up the wicked, but he got respect for the ones who fear the Lord. If he make a promise—even if it hurt—he still keep it.
15.5: He don't loan money with strings attached. He ain't takin' bribes to mess up the innocent. Anybody who live like this? Solid. They can't be shaken.

16.1: Keep me safe, God—I'm trustin' in You.
16.2: My soul already told the Lord, 'You my Lord. Anything good in me? That come from You alone.'
16.3: As for the faithful ones on earth—they the real ones, and I love bein' around 'em.
16.4: Folks who chase after other gods? They just stackin' up sorrow. I ain't pourin' out no offerings for 'em, and I ain't even speakin' their names.
16.5: Lord, You my portion, my cup, my inheritance. You the one holdin' me together.
16.6: You placed me in a good spot. The boundaries You set? Beautiful. What You gave me is solid.
16.7: I bless You, Lord, 'cause You always give me wisdom. Even at night, my heart be speakin' truth.
16.8: I keep my eyes on You, Lord. You right beside me—so I ain't goin' nowhere.
16.9: That's why I'm smilin' on the inside, shoutin' on the outside, and my body can finally rest with hope.
16.10: You not gon' leave my soul in the grave. You ain't gon' let Your Holy One rot away.
16.11: You showin' me the path to real life. Bein' with You? That's joy on full. At Your right hand? Endless peace and pleasure.

17.1: Lord, listen to me—I'm bringin' a real case. Hear my cry. I ain't comin' with no lies.
17.2: Let my justice come straight from You. Look at me with eyes that see truth.
17.3: You done tested my heart, showed up in the nighttime, and searched me deep. You ain't found nothin'. I made up my mind—I'm not gon' speak foul.
17.4: When it comes to how people move, I been guided by Your Word. I stayed away from the path of destroyers.
17.5: Hold me steady on Your path, Lord. Don't let me slip.
17.6: I been callin' on You, 'cause I know You hear me. Lean in close and listen to what I'm sayin'.
17.7: Show me that unfailing love You known for—the kind that comes through with power for the ones who trust You against those tryin' to tear us down.
17.8: Keep me close—like the apple of Your eye. Tuck me under the shadow of Your wings.
17.9: Protect me from the ones tryin' to crush me—from enemies that got me surrounded.
17.10: They got hard hearts and slick mouths. Pride all in they speech.
17.11: Now they got us boxed in. They movin' in like they ready to strike.
17.12: They like a lion, crouched low, waitin' to pounce. Ready to tear somethin' up in secret.
17.13: Get up, Lord! Step to 'em. Shut 'em down. Save me from these wicked ones with Your sword.
17.14: Use Your hand, Lord, to handle these worldly men—livin' only for this life. You gave 'em stuff, filled up their bellies, blessed their kids—but that's all they want.
17.15: But me? I'm waitin' to see Your face in righteousness. When I wake up and look like You, that's when I'll be satisfied.

18.1: I love You, Lord—You my strength.
18.2: You my rock, my fortress, my rescuer. My God, my safe place. I trust You. You my shield, my stronghold, and the horn of my salvation.
18.3: I call on the Lord—He worthy of praise. That's how I know I'm gon' be saved from my enemies.
18.4: Death had me surrounded, and waves of wickedness had me shook.
18.5: The grip of the grave closed in on me—death had traps waitin' for me.
18.6: In my panic, I called out to You, Lord. I cried to my God, and You heard me from Your temple. My cry hit Your ears.
18.7: Then the earth shook. Mountains trembled 'cause You was angry.
18.8: Smoke came out Your nose. Fire shot out Your mouth—burnin' coals and all.
18.9: You split the sky and came down, steppin' on clouds full of darkness.
18.10: You flew on a cherub, ridin' the wind like it was Yours.
18.11: You wrapped Yourself in darkness like a cloak, thick storm clouds around You.
18.12: But then light broke through—hail and fire came through those clouds.
18.13: You thundered from heaven, Lord. The Most High let His voice loose—hailstones and fire lit up the sky.
18.14: You shot arrows and scattered the enemies. Lightning struck and shook 'em.
18.15: The bottom of the ocean showed, the whole earth got exposed—all from the shout of Your breath.
18.16: You reached down and grabbed me. Pulled me up out the deep.
18.17: You rescued me from my strongest enemy—from haters that had way more power than me.
18.18: They came for me on my worst day. But You, Lord? You held me down.
18.19: You brought me into wide open space. You rescued me 'cause You actually delight in me.
18.20: You paid me back for livin' right. For the clean hands I brought before You.
18.21: I stuck with Your ways, Lord—I ain't ghosted You or played You sideways.
18.22: I kept Your commands in front of me. I ain't tossed Your Word to the side.
18.23: I stayed solid with You. I kept myself from fallin' back into sin.
18.24: So yeah, You repaid me—based on how I lived, based on what You saw in me.
18.25: With the merciful, You show mercy. With the loyal, You stay loyal.
18.26: With the pure, You stay pure. But with the crooked? You get slick.
18.27: You lift up the humble, but You bring proud folks down.
18.28: You the one who lights my lamp. You brighten my darkness, God.
18.29: With You, I can run straight through a squad. With You, I can jump clean over a wall.
18.30: God's way is flawless. His Word is tested and true. He a shield to anyone who trusts Him.
18.31: Ain't nobody like the Lord. Who else is our rock? Nobody.
18.32: God the one who gave me strength and set my steps straight.
18.33: He made my feet move like a deer's—He put me high where I couldn't be touched.
18.34: He taught me how to fight. My arms strong enough to bend a bronze bow.
18.35: You gave me the shield of salvation. Your hand kept me steady. Your gentleness made me great.
18.36: You cleared the path for me, made sure I ain't slip.
18.37: I chased my enemies and caught 'em. I ain't stop till they was done.
18.38: I struck 'em down so they couldn't get up. They fell under my feet.
18.39: You armed me for battle, gave me strength. You put my haters under me.
18.40: You handed me their necks—I crushed the ones that hated me.
18.41: They cried out, but nobody saved 'em. Not even You answered.
18.42: I smashed 'em like dust in the wind. Swept 'em away like street trash.
18.43: You rescued me from beef with the people. Made me the head over nations. Strangers now serve me.
18.44: Soon as they hear about me, they fall in line. Foreigners bow down quick.
18.45: They lose heart fast—come outta hiding scared.
18.46: The Lord lives! Blessed be my rock! Let the God who saves me be lifted up!
18.47: He the one who fights for me. He puts nations under me.
18.48: You keep me safe from my enemies. You lift me up above the ones comin' for me. You saved me from violent folks.
18.49: That's why I'ma thank You, Lord, in front of everybody—even the nations. I'ma sing praises to Your name.
18.50: You give big victories to Your king. You stay showin' love to Your anointed—David, and everybody that come from his line forever.

19.1: The skies straight up show off God's glory. The heavens put His work on full display.
19.2: Every single day speaks on it. Every night drops knowledge.
19.3: Ain't no language barrier—everybody can hear what creation's sayin'.
19.4: Their message spread all across the world. The whole globe got the memo. God set a place up in the sky for the sun—
19.5: Like a groom walkin' out the wedding suite, hyped up to run his race like a champ.
19.6: The sun rises on one end, runs across the whole sky, and touches everything. Ain't nobody escaping its heat.
19.7: God's law is flawless—it brings life back to the soul. His Word can make the simplest person wise.
19.8: His rules are right—they lift your spirit. His commands shine bright—they open your eyes.
19.9: The fear of the Lord? It's clean and lasts forever. His judgments are true—ain't no flaws in them.
19.10: They more valuable than gold—even the purest kind. And sweeter than honey fresh from the comb.
19.11: Your Word keeps Your servant in check. And if I follow it? Big reward.
19.12: But who can see all their own mess-ups? Clean me up from the stuff I don't even realize I did.
19.13: Hold me back from bold, willful sins. Don't let 'em run my life. Then I'll be clean—free from big-time failure.
19.14: Let what I say and what I feel be good in Your eyes, Lord—my strength, my rock, my Redeemer.

20.1: May the Lord answer you when trouble hits. May the name of the God of Jacob be your protection.
20.2: May He send you help straight from His holy place, and give you strength from Zion.
20.3: May He remember every offering you gave, and receive your sacrifices with favor.
20.4: May He give you what your heart been prayin' for, and make all your plans succeed.
20.5: We gon' celebrate when your victory comes. In God's name, we gon' wave our banners high! May the Lord come through with everything you asked.
20.6: Now I know—the Lord saves His anointed one. He answers from heaven, with power in His right hand.
20.7: Some folks put their trust in chariots, some in horses. But we? We trust in the name of the Lord our God.
20.8: They fall flat, but we rise up and stand strong.
20.9: Come through for us, Lord! Let the King answer when we call.

21.1: The king out here rejoicin' in Your strength, Lord! He lit over the way You saved him.
21.2: You gave him exactly what his heart was askin' for—you ain't hold nothin' back from his lips.
21.3: You pulled up with blessings on blessings, and set a crown of pure gold on his head.
21.4: He asked You for life, and You gave it—days that stretch on forever.
21.5: His name got weight now 'cause of how You saved him. You gave him honor and royal shine.
21.6: You made him one of the most blessed, period. And Your presence got him overflowin' with joy.
21.7: The king put his trust in the Lord, and because of the Most High's mercy, he stay unshaken.
21.8: Your hand gon' track down all Your enemies. Your right hand gon' find everybody hatin' on You.
21.9: When it's time, You gon' burn 'em up like a hot furnace. In Your anger, Lord, You swallow 'em whole—fire takin' care of the rest.
21.10: You gon' wipe out their legacy, their kids, and everybody comin' after 'em.
21.11: They tried to come up with evil plans against You—but they ain't even got the power to pull it off.
21.12: So You gon' make 'em retreat. Your arrows already locked and loaded—aimed straight at their faces.
21.13: Be lifted up, Lord, in Your strength! We gon' sing and shout about how powerful You are.

22.1: My God, my God—why You leave me hangin'? Why You so far when I'm cryin' out for help?
22.2: I call out all day, God, but You don't answer. I keep goin' through the night, and I still get no peace.
22.3: But You still holy, sittin' high on the praises of Israel.
22.4: Our ancestors put their trust in You. You came through for them.
22.5: They cried out, and You delivered. They leaned on You and never felt shame.
22.6: But me? I feel less than human—looked down on, laughed at, pushed to the side.
22.7: Everybody who sees me mockin' me. They twist they lips, shakin' they heads like…
22.8: 'Oh, he trusted God? Let God save him then! If God really love him, He'll come get him!'
22.9: But You the one who brought me into this world. I've been dependin' on You since I was nursin'.
22.10: From birth, I've been Yours. You been my God since I left the womb.
22.11: Don't stay far, Lord—trouble right here, and ain't nobody else to help.
22.12: I'm surrounded—like wild bulls from Bashan, closin' in.
22.13: They got they mouths wide open at me, like lions ready to rip me apart.
22.14: I'm feelin' like water poured out—bones all outta place. My heart feel like melted wax inside.
22.15: I'm dried up like broken clay. My tongue stickin' to my mouth. You brought me to the edge of death.
22.16: Evil ones all around me like dogs. A whole mob got me trapped. They pierced my hands and my feet.
22.17: I can see every bone in my body. They just starin' at me like I'm not even human.
22.18: They splittin' up my clothes and rollin' dice to see who get my outfit.
22.19: But You, Lord—don't stay far. You my strength—hurry up and help me!
22.20: Rescue me from the sword. Save my soul from these wild dogs.
22.21: Snatch me from the lion's mouth. Pull me out from these horns. You came through—I know You heard me!
22.22: I'ma tell my people all about You. I'ma praise You right in the middle of the crowd.
22.23: Y'all who fear the Lord—praise Him! All Jacob's people, lift Him up. All Israel's children, honor Him!
22.24: He ain't turn His back on the one sufferin'. He didn't ignore the pain. When He cried for help—God listened.
22.25: My praise is for You, Lord, in the big assembly. I'ma keep my word in front of all who fear You.
22.26: The poor gon' eat and be full. Those who seek You gon' praise. Let your heart live forever!
22.27: Everybody—every nation—gon' remember and turn to the Lord. All families everywhere gon' bow down.
22.28: The Lord run this kingdom. He rule over all the nations.
22.29: Rich folks gon' worship. Even the ones facin' death gon' bow down—folks barely holdin' on to life still gon' kneel.
22.30: Future generations gon' serve Him. They gon' tell the next wave all about the Lord.
22.31: They gon' show up and declare His righteousness to the ones not even born yet—sayin', 'God already did it.'

23.1: The Lord is my shepherd—I got everything I need.
23.2: He let me rest in green pastures, and leads me beside still, peaceful waters.
23.3: He restore my soul, bringin' me back to life. He guides me down the right path—for His name's sake.
23.4: Even when I'm walkin' through the darkest valley, where death's shadow creepin'—I ain't scared. 'Cause You right there with me. Your rod and staff? They hold me down.
23.5: You set the table for me—even with my enemies watchin'. You bless me with oil, and my cup? It's overflowin'.
23.6: Surely, Your goodness and mercy gon' chase me every day I'm alive. And I'ma live in Your house, Lord—forever.

24.1: The earth belongs to the Lord—everything in it. The whole world and everybody livin' on it.
24.2: He the one who built it on the seas, set it solid on top of the waters.
24.3: Who can step up on the Lord's hill? Who can stand in His holy space?
24.4: The one with clean hands and a pure heart—ain't worshippin' no idols, and ain't swearin' fake.
24.5: That one gon' get blessed by the Lord, and be made right by the God who saves.
24.6: This the generation that seeks Him. These the folks who really want God's face.
24.7: Lift your heads up, gates! Swing open wide, everlasting doors! Let the King of glory step in.
24.8: Who is this King of glory? The Lord—strong and mighty. The Lord—mighty in battle.
24.9: Lift your heads up, gates! Lift up, everlasting doors! The King of glory comin' through!
24.10: Who is this King of glory? The Lord of angel armies—He the King of glory.

25.1: Lord, I'm liftin' up my soul to You.
25.2: My God, I'm trustin' You. Don't let me be embarrassed. Don't let my enemies laugh at me.
25.3: Ain't nobody who wait on You gon' be put to shame. But folks who act shady for no reason? Yeah, they should be ashamed.
25.4: Lord, show me how You move. Teach me Your ways.
25.5: Lead me in truth. Teach me. You the God who saves me. I'm waitin' on You all day.
25.6: Remember Your mercy, Lord—Your faithful love that's been around from way back.
25.7: Don't bring up my old mess—the sins I did when I was young. Look at me through Your mercy. Remember me with love, for the sake of Your goodness.
25.8: God is good and upright. That's why He teaches sinners the right way.
25.9: He shows the humble how to move with justice. He teaches the lowly His way.
25.10: Every path the Lord takes is soaked in mercy and truth—for those who follow His Word and keep His promises.
25.11: Lord, for Your name's sake, forgive me. My mess is deep.
25.12: Who fear the Lord? Those are the ones He gon' teach and guide where they need to go.
25.13: They gon' live in peace, and their kids gon' inherit the land.
25.14: The Lord shares His secrets with those who fear Him. He show 'em what covenant really means.
25.15: I keep my eyes on the Lord—'cause He the one that's gon' pull me out the trap.
25.16: Turn to me, Lord. Have mercy. I'm feelin' alone and worn out.
25.17: My heart heavy with problems. Pull me out this pain.
25.18: See what I'm goin' through—my pain, my struggles. And please forgive all my sins.
25.19: Look at my enemies, Lord. They many. And they hate me hard—for no good reason.
25.20: Protect my soul. Rescue me. Don't let me be put to shame—I'm trustin' You.
25.21: Let integrity and righteousness keep me grounded—'cause I'm waitin' on You.
25.22: God, redeem Israel. Pull Your people outta all their troubles.

26.1: Lord, speak up for me. I been walkin' right, movin' with integrity. I put my trust in You—I ain't about to fall.
26.2: Check me out, Lord. Examine me. Test my thoughts and my heart.
26.3: Your love stay in front of me, and I been walkin' in Your truth.
26.4: I don't sit with fake folks, and I don't roll with hypocrites.
26.5: I can't stand being around the wicked. I'm not tryna be posted up with evil people.
26.6: I wash my hands in innocence, and I step to Your altar, Lord—
26.7: So I can speak loud with thanksgiving and tell everybody about the dope things You done.
26.8: Lord, I love Your house—the place where Your presence and glory live.
26.9: Don't lump me in with sinners. Don't take me out like the violent ones—
26.10: Folks with shady plans in one hand and bribes in the other.
26.11: But me? I'm walkin' in integrity. Redeem me, Lord. Show me mercy.
26.12: My feet stand on solid ground. In the middle of the people, I'ma bless the Lord.

27.1: The Lord is my light and my salvation—so who I'm supposed to be scared of? The Lord is my strength—why would I be shook?
27.2: When the wicked tried to come for me, tryna tear me up—my enemies? They tripped and fell flat.
27.3: Even if a whole army surrounded me, my heart wouldn't flinch. If war popped off, I'd still stand confident.
27.4: Only one thing I'm askin' the Lord for, and I'm chasin' it: to live in His house every single day, to soak in His beauty, and seek Him in His holy space.
27.5: When trouble hit, He gon' tuck me away in His shelter. He gon' hide me in His safe place and sit me high on a rock.
27.6: Now I'm lookin' down at my enemies—they all around, but my head stay lifted. I'ma bring Him joyful offerings and sing loud. Yeah, I'ma praise the Lord with a song.
27.7: Lord, hear me when I cry! Show me mercy and answer back!
27.8: When You said, 'Come seek My face,' my heart said, 'I'm lookin' for You, Lord.'
27.9: Don't hide from me. Don't push me away in anger. You been my help—don't leave me now. Don't walk off, God my Savior.
27.10: Even if my own mama and daddy dip out on me, the Lord gon' scoop me up.
27.11: Show me how to walk, Lord. Lead me down the right path—'cause I got enemies watchin'.
27.12: Don't hand me over to them. They lyin' on me, breathin' violence, tryin' to take me out.
27.13: Truth is, I would've gave up—if I didn't believe I'd see God's goodness while I'm still alive.
27.14: Wait on the Lord. Be strong, and let your heart stay solid. Yeah—I said, wait on the Lord!

28.1: I'm cryin' out to You, Lord—my solid rock. Don't go quiet on me. If You stay silent, I might as well be dead.
28.2: Please hear me when I call, when I lift my hands toward Your holy place—beggin' and reachin' for You.
28.3: Don't lump me in with the wicked—with the ones who act nice on the outside but got evil in their hearts.
28.4: Give them what they earned, Lord. Pay 'em back for the mess they made. Let the work of their hands come right back on 'em.
28.5: They don't care about what You do, Lord. They ignore Your handiwork. So You gon' tear them down—and You ain't rebuildin' 'em.
28.6: Bless the Lord! He heard me when I cried out!
28.7: The Lord is my strength and my shield. I put my trust in Him, and He came through. My heart is full of joy—and I'ma sing and praise Him loud.
28.8: The Lord is strength for His people, a safe place for the one He anointed.
28.9: Lord, save Your people. Bless what belongs to You. Be their shepherd, and carry them forever.

29.1: Y'all mighty ones—give God the glory! Give the Lord the strength and honor He deserves.
29.2: Give the Lord the praise that match His name. Worship Him in the beauty of holiness.
29.3: The Lord's voice echoes over the waters. The God of glory is thunderin'—He movin' over the deep.
29.4: God's voice got power. His voice sound like royalty—it's full of majesty.
29.5: The Lord's voice shatters the big cedar trees. He smashes the cedars of Lebanon to pieces.
29.6: He makes the mountains jump like baby calves—Lebanon and Sirion bounce like wild oxen.
29.7: The Lord's voice cuts through fire—divides the flames.
29.8: His voice shakes the whole wilderness. The desert of Kadesh trembles when He speaks.
29.9: His voice makes deer go into labor and strips forests bare. And everybody in His temple? All they can say is, 'Glory!'
29.10: The Lord was sittin' on the throne back when the flood came. He still sittin' on the throne now—as King forever.
29.11: The Lord gon' give His people strength. And He blesses His people with peace.

30.1: Lord, I'm liftin' You up—'cause You lifted me up. You ain't let my haters celebrate over me.
30.2: Lord my God, I cried out to You—and You healed me.
30.3: You pulled my soul up from the grave. You kept me alive when I was this close to the pit.
30.4: Y'all saints—sing to the Lord! Thank Him when you think on His holy name.
30.5: His anger don't last long, but His favor? That's for life. We might cry through the night, but joy come in the morning.
30.6: Back when everything was good, I said, 'I'm solid. Ain't nothin' gon' shake me.'
30.7: It was Your favor, Lord, that kept me steady like a mountain. But when You hid Your face, I was shook.
30.8: So I cried out to You, Lord. I pleaded with You hard.
30.9: What good is it if I'm gone? If I die, how I'm gon' praise You? Can dust speak on Your truth?
30.10: Hear me, Lord. Have mercy. Be my help!
30.11: You flipped my mourning into a dance. Took off my sackcloth and dressed me in joy.
30.12: So now I can praise You out loud and never hold back. Lord my God, I'ma thank You forever.

31.1: I'm trustin' in You, Lord—don't let me be put to shame. Save me with Your righteousness.
31.2: Lean in and hear me. Come quick and help me. Be my solid rock, my safe place, my fortress.
31.3: You my rock and my strong tower. For Your name's sake, lead me. Show me which way to go.
31.4: Pull me out the trap they set for me in secret—'cause You my strength.
31.5: I'm puttin' my spirit in Your hands. You already redeemed me, Lord, God of truth.
31.6: I don't mess with idols—I trust the Lord.
31.7: I'm gon' rejoice in Your mercy. You saw my pain. You knew what I was goin' through.
31.8: You ain't hand me over to my enemies. You set my feet in wide-open space.
31.9: Have mercy, Lord—I'm hurtin'. I'm cryin' so much, my eyes tired. My soul and body feel heavy.
31.10: Grief been drainin' my life. I've been sighin' for years. My strength is gone 'cause of my own sin. I feel like my bones fallin' apart.
31.11: My enemies mock me. My neighbors side-eye me. Even my own people avoid me in the street.
31.12: I'm forgotten like I never existed. Like a broken pot, tossed aside.
31.13: I hear the whispers and the threats. Fear all around. They out here plottin'—tryna take my life.
31.14: But me? I'm still trustin' You, Lord. I say, 'You my God.'
31.15: My life in Your hands. Deliver me from the folks tryna come for me.
31.16: Let Your face shine on me, Lord. Save me with Your mercy.
31.17: Don't let me be put to shame for callin' on You. But let the wicked be silent—in the grave.
31.18: Shut down the lying mouths—talkin' reckless and proud against the righteous.
31.19: Your goodness is wild, Lord—stored up for the ones who fear You. You show it off in front of everybody who trust You.
31.20: You hide them in Your presence—safe from all the drama. You protect them from folks runnin' their mouths.
31.21: Bless the Lord—He showed me real love, like I was locked in a strong city.
31.22: I said too fast, 'You forgot about me!' But You heard me when I cried.
31.23: Y'all who love the Lord—stay with Him. He got the faithful. But the proud? He gon' pay them back.
31.24: Be strong, y'all. Let your heart hold firm—all of you who put your hope in the Lord.

32.1: Blessed is the one whose sins got wiped clean—whose wrongs been covered.
32.2: Blessed is the person the Lord ain't holdin' charges against—and who got no lies in their spirit.
32.3: When I stayed quiet, holdin' it all in—my bones felt old. I was groanin' nonstop.
32.4: Day and night, Your hand was heavy on me. My energy dried up like a hot summer drought.
32.5: Then I came clean. I told You what I did. I stopped hidin' my mess. I said, 'I'm confessin' my sins to the Lord,' and just like that—you forgave me.
32.6: That's why everybody who love You should pray while there's still time. When the floods rise up, they won't touch him.
32.7: You my safe space. You keep me from trouble. You surround me with songs of freedom.
32.8: I'ma teach you. I'ma show you the path. I'ma guide you with My own eyes watchin'.
32.9: Don't be out here actin' like a wild horse or stubborn mule—needin' ropes and bits just to get close.
32.10: Wicked folks gon' deal with a lot of pain. But the one who trusts the Lord? Mercy gon' wrap all around him.
32.11: So go 'head and celebrate, y'all who do right. Rejoice in the Lord! Shout for joy, all you whose hearts stay solid.

33.1: Y'all righteous folks—go 'head and rejoice in the Lord! Praisin' God look good on upright people.
33.2: Grab that harp and praise the Lord. Play somethin' fresh on them ten strings.
33.3: Sing Him a brand-new song. Play it with skill, and don't be shy with that joyful shout.
33.4: The Lord's Word is solid—everything He do is rooted in truth.
33.5: He love righteousness and justice. And the earth? It's drippin' with His goodness.
33.6: God spoke the heavens into being. The stars and galaxies? Just a breath from His mouth.
33.7: He scooped up the seas and stacked the waters. Put the deep places in storage like it's nothin'.
33.8: Let the whole earth have reverence for the Lord. Let everybody everywhere stand in awe.
33.9: When He speaks, it happens. When He commands, it holds firm.
33.10: The Lord cancel out the plans of nations. He flip the strategies of people like they nothin'.
33.11: But His plan? It stands forever. His heart don't change—generation after generation.
33.12: That nation that calls the Lord their God? Blessed. The folks He chose as His own? They locked in.
33.13: The Lord lookin' down from heaven—watchin' everybody on earth.
33.14: From where He sits, He sees all of us.
33.15: He the one who shaped every heart. He watchin' how we all move.
33.16: Kings don't get saved just 'cause they got big armies. A strong man can't win just off muscle.
33.17: Don't count on horses for safety either. All that power won't guarantee nothin'.
33.18: But the Lord's eye is locked on the ones who respect Him—on the ones hopin' in His mercy.
33.19: He the one who saves them from death and keeps 'em alive when things get tight.
33.20: Our soul waitin' on the Lord. He our help and our shield.
33.21: We rejoicin' in Him, 'cause we trust His holy name.
33.22: Let Your mercy cover us, Lord—just like we been hopin' in You.

34.1: I'ma bless the Lord at all times—His praise stay on my lips.
34.2: I'm braggin' on the Lord. The humble ones gon' hear it and be glad.
34.3: Come on, let's lift Him up together. Let's exalt His name as one.
34.4: I went lookin' for the Lord—He heard me and freed me from every fear I had.
34.5: When folks look to Him, they light up—they don't end up lookin' ashamed.
34.6: I was that broke, desperate man who cried out—and the Lord came through, saved me from it all.
34.7: God's angel sets up camp 'round the ones who respect Him—and He keeps 'em safe.
34.8: Try Him for yourself—taste and see that the Lord is good! Blessed is the one who trusts Him.
34.9: Y'all who love the Lord—reverence Him. Ain't no lack for those who fear Him.
34.10: Even young lions go hungry sometimes—but those who chase after God? They won't miss out on any good thing.
34.11: Come here, kids—listen up. I'ma teach y'all how to fear the Lord for real.
34.12: Who want a good life and long days filled with good things?
34.13: Then keep your mouth from evil, and don't let your lips tell lies.
34.14: Turn away from wrong—do what's right. Go after peace like it's your mission.
34.15: God got His eyes on the righteous, and His ears open when they cry.
34.16: But He turns His face against evildoers—He erases their memory from the earth.
34.17: The righteous cry out, and the Lord hears them. He snatches them from every single trouble.
34.18: God stays close to the brokenhearted. He saves those with crushed spirits.
34.19: Yeah, the righteous go through a lot—but the Lord deliver them from all of it.
34.20: He protects every bone—not one gets broken.
34.21: Evil gon' take out the wicked. And those who hate the righteous? They gon' be judged.
34.22: But the Lord redeems the soul of His servants—and anybody who trusts in Him? They won't be condemned.

35.1: Lord, fight for me. Speak up for me against the ones tryin' to come at me. Go to war with those at war with me.
35.2: Grab Your shield, both big and small, and step up to defend me.
35.3: Pull out the spear, stop the ones chasin' me. Tell my soul, 'I got you—I'm your salvation.'
35.4: Let the ones tryin' to take me out be embarrassed and shut down. Turn back the ones plottin' on me, and let 'em be confused.
35.5: Let 'em blow away like dust in the wind—chased by the angel of the Lord.
35.6: Let their path be dark and dangerous. Let the angel of the Lord stay on they neck.
35.7: They set traps for no reason, diggin' pits tryin' to catch me slippin'.
35.8: Let disaster sneak up on them. Let their own trap catch them—let 'em fall into the very hole they dug.
35.9: Then my soul gon' turn up with joy in the Lord. I'ma rejoice 'cause He saved me.
35.10: Every bone in my body gon' say, 'Lord, ain't nobody like You! You protect the powerless from the powerful. You rescue the poor from the ones tryna rob them.'
35.11: Liars rise up and say things I don't even know about.
35.12: They pay me back evil for the good I did. It broke my heart.
35.13: But when they were down bad? I was fastin', wearin' sackcloth. I was prayin' for them with my whole soul.
35.14: I was movin' like they were family—like a brother or a close friend. I grieved like somebody mournin' their mama.
35.15: But when I got hit, they celebrated. They gathered up on me. Enemies popped up from nowhere, tryna tear me up nonstop.
35.16: They mocked me like clowns at a party—grittin' they teeth at me like it was funny.
35.17: Lord, how long You just gon' watch this? Rescue me from these lions. Save my life from the madness.
35.18: I'ma thank You in front of everybody. I'ma praise You in the middle of the crowd.
35.19: Don't let my haters celebrate over me for no reason. Don't let the ones hatin' for nothin' throw shade and smirk.
35.20: They don't talk peace. They stay schemin' lies against folks just tryna live quiet.
35.21: They open their mouth wide like, 'Aha! We saw it!'
35.22: You saw it too, Lord. Don't stay quiet. Don't be distant, God.
35.23: Wake up, Lord. Show up for me. Stand up for my case, my God and my Lord.
35.24: Defend me, Lord, like only You can. Don't let them win. Don't let them laugh at my fall.
35.25: Don't let 'em say, 'Yes! That's what we wanted!' Don't let them claim, 'We got him!'
35.26: Let the ones who wanted me hurt be embarrassed and confused. Let shame wrap the ones who tried to stunt on me.
35.27: But let the ones who want what's right for me rejoice and be glad. Let 'em shout forever, 'The Lord is great! He loves blessin' His servant!'
35.28: And me? I'ma keep talkin' about Your righteousness. I'ma praise You all day long.

36.1: I got this word deep in my spirit about the wicked—there ain't no fear of God in their eyes.
36.2: They gas themselves up, too proud to see their own sin or recognize their hate.
36.3: Every word out their mouth is wicked and shady. They stopped tryin' to do right a long time ago.
36.4: Even when they lay down at night, they still plottin'. They stuck on paths that ain't good—and evil don't even bother 'em no more.
36.5: But Lord, Your mercy? It reaches the heavens. Your faithfulness stretch up to the clouds.
36.6: Your righteousness stand tall like mountains. Your justice run deep like the ocean. You protect both people and animals.
36.7: Your love is priceless, God. That's why folks trust You—they hide under the shadow of Your wings.
36.8: You feed them full from Your house, and You let 'em drink from the river of Your delight.
36.9: With You is the fountain of life—and in Your light, we see real light.
36.10: Keep showin' love to the ones who know You. Keep bein' righteous to the ones whose hearts stay true.
36.11: Don't let the proud step on me. Don't let the wicked put their hands on me and push me out.
36.12: Look—they already fell. The wicked been thrown down, and they ain't gettin' back up.

37.1: Don't trip over evil people. Don't be jealous of folks out here doin' wrong.
37.2: They gon' get cut down like grass—gon' fade like dry weeds.
37.3: Trust the Lord and do right. Stay where He planted you and eat off His faithfulness.
37.4: Find joy in the Lord, and He'll give you what your heart really wants.
37.5: Roll your plans onto the Lord. Trust Him—He'll handle it.
37.6: He gon' make your righteousness shine like the sunrise, and your justice blaze like noonday.
37.7: Chill in the Lord. Wait for Him. Don't trip when the wicked succeed with their shady moves.
37.8: Let go of anger. Drop the rage. Don't let it eat you up—it only brings damage.
37.9: Evildoers gon' be cut off. But the ones who wait on the Lord? They gon' inherit everything.
37.10: Soon, the wicked gon' be gone. Look for them—you won't find a trace.
37.11: But the humble? They get the land—and they gon' enjoy deep peace.
37.12: The wicked be plottin' on the righteous, grindin' they teeth at them.
37.13: But God just laughs—'cause He see their end is comin'.
37.14: They pull out swords and bend bows, tryna take out the poor and honest.
37.15: But their own sword gon' stab their own heart, and their bows gon' break.
37.16: Better to have a little and live right than to have riches and be wicked.
37.17: The wicked's strength gon' snap, but the Lord holdin' the righteous steady.
37.18: God knows every day of those who live right—and their reward lasts forever.
37.19: Even when times get bad, they won't be ashamed. When famine hits, they still fed.
37.20: But the wicked? They gon' die. God's enemies vanish like smoke blowin' away.
37.21: Wicked folk borrow and don't pay back. But the righteous? They give freely and show mercy.
37.22: Who God blesses gon' inherit the land. But who He curses? Gone.
37.23: The Lord sets the steps of a good person. He take joy in how they move.
37.24: Even if they stumble, they won't fall hard—'cause God holdin' them up.
37.25: I was young, now I'm old—but I ain't never seen the righteous left hangin', or their kids beggin' for bread.
37.26: They always generous, always lendin'—and their kids stay blessed.
37.27: Turn from evil, do good—and you'll live in the land forever.
37.28: The Lord loves justice. He won't leave His faithful ones. They covered forever. The wicked's legacy? Gone.
37.29: The righteous inherit the land and live in it forever.
37.30: The righteous speak wisdom, and they speak justice.
37.31: God's law lives in their heart—they don't trip or fall.
37.32: The wicked stay watchin' the righteous—lookin' for a chance to take them out.
37.33: But the Lord ain't lettin' that happen. He won't let them be judged unfairly.
37.34: Wait on the Lord. Keep movin' in His way. He gon' lift you up. You'll inherit the land—and see the wicked cut off.
37.35: I've seen wicked people look powerful—spreadin' out like a tall tree.
37.36: But they disappeared just like that. Looked for 'em—and they were gone.
37.37: Pay attention to the blameless. Watch the upright. That person's future? Peace.
37.38: But the wrongdoers? All destroyed. The wicked got no future.
37.39: The righteous get saved by the Lord. He their strength when trouble comes.
37.40: The Lord help 'em and delivers 'em. He saves 'em from the wicked—'cause they trust Him.

38.1: Lord, please don't correct me while You mad. Don't check me in Your anger.
38.2: Your arrows hit deep. Your hand feel heavy on me.
38.3: My body ain't right—ain't no peace in me. My bones hurt 'cause of Your anger. All this mess I caused? It's catchin' up.
38.4: My sins too much to carry—like waves floodin' over my head. I'm crushed under the weight.
38.5: I got wounds that stink and won't heal—'cause I was bein' foolish.
38.6: I'm bent over, feelin' low. I've been movin' in grief all day long.
38.7: My back's burnin', my body all messed up—ain't no strength left in me.
38.8: I'm weak, crushed to the core. I groan from the chaos inside my heart.
38.9: Lord, You see all my wants. Even my silent cries ain't hidden from You.
38.10: My heart beatin' fast. My strength is gone. My vision—fadin' too.
38.11: My friends and fam stay distant. Nobody wanna deal with me in this condition.
38.12: People tryna kill me got traps laid. They talk behind my back, plannin' my downfall all day.
38.13: But me? I'm like I can't hear. I ain't respondin' to nothin'.
38.14: I'm silent—no comebacks, no defense. I got nothin' to say.
38.15: But Lord, I'm still hopin' in You. You the one I know gon' hear me.
38.16: I prayed, 'Please don't let my enemies laugh at me. Don't let them clown me if I stumble.'
38.17: I'm close to fallin'—this pain stay with me constantly.
38.18: I'm ownin' my sin. I feel it deep. I'm not hidin' from the weight of it.
38.19: But my enemies? They strong. They loud. They deep in numbers—and they hatin' me for no good reason.
38.20: They pay me evil for good. They against me 'cause I try to do what's right.
38.21: Don't walk out on me, Lord. Please don't stay far away.
38.22: Come quick, Lord. You my only salvation.

39.1: I told myself, 'I'm gon' watch how I move, so I don't slip up and sin with my mouth.' I kept my lips locked—especially around folks who don't mess with God.
39.2: I stayed silent. Didn't say a word. Even held back good things. But that silence made my sorrow bubble up.
39.3: My heart was burnin' inside. The more I thought on it, the hotter I got—'til I couldn't hold it in no more and I spoke:
39.4: Lord, help me understand how short my time really is. Let me see how limited my days are—so I know just how fragile I am.
39.5: You made my life short, like a hand's width. My time here don't even register next to You. Truth is—at our best, we just vapor.
39.6: We walk around like shadows. Runnin' in circles over nothin'. Stackin' up riches—just for somebody else to grab when we gone.
39.7: So what am I even waitin' for now, Lord? My hope's in You.
39.8: Free me from all my sins. Don't let me be the punchline for fools.
39.9: I'm quiet again. Mouth shut. 'Cause I know this came from You.
39.10: Please ease up, Lord. Your hand been heavy. I'm feelin' worn down.
39.11: When You call somebody out for their sin, even the finest parts of them start to fade—like a moth eatin' at cloth. Yeah, we really just vapor.
39.12: Hear me out, Lord. Listen to my cry. Don't stay silent when I'm out here cryin' tears.
39.13: Let me catch my breath before I leave this life and I ain't here no more.

40.1: I waited on the Lord—real patient. And He leaned in and heard me cryin'.
40.2: He pulled me up outta that deep, dark pit—out the muddy mess I was stuck in. He put my feet on solid ground and gave me firm steps to walk on.
40.3: He dropped a brand-new song in my mouth—a praise track to our God. Folks gon' see it, get shook, and put their trust in the Lord too.
40.4: Blessed is the one who trusts the Lord—not lookin' up to the proud, or fallin' for lies.
40.5: Lord my God, You done so many wild, wonderful things. I couldn't even count Your thoughts toward us if I tried—they too many to number!
40.6: You ain't askin' for sacrifices or offerings. Nah—you opened my ears. Burnt offerings and sin offerings? That ain't what You want.
40.7: So I said, 'Look, I'm showin' up. The book already talked about me.'
40.8: I love doin' what You want, God. Your Word lives in my heart.
40.9: I done shared the good news loud in the crowd. I didn't hold back, Lord—You already know.
40.10: I didn't keep Your righteousness to myself. I told everybody about Your faithfulness and salvation. I let 'em know about Your love and truth.
40.11: Don't hold back Your mercy from me, Lord. Let Your love and truth cover me, always.
40.12: I'm surrounded by trouble. My own sins got me overwhelmed—too many to count. My heart feel like it's givin' out.
40.13: Lord, I'm beggin'—come rescue me. Please hurry up and help me!
40.14: Let the ones tryna take me out be embarrassed. Let the ones rootin' for my downfall get hit with shame.
40.15: Let the ones who clown me and say, 'Aha!' be stuck in their shame.
40.16: But let everybody who seek You be full of joy. Let the ones who love how You save say over and over again: 'The Lord is BIG!'
40.17: I'm poor and needin' help, but the Lord still thinkin' about me. You my help and my Savior—don't take too long, God!

41.1: Blessed is the one who look out for the poor—'cause when trouble comes, the Lord gon' show up for them.
41.2: The Lord gon' keep 'em safe, keep 'em alive, and bless 'em right here on earth. He won't let their enemies win.
41.3: Even when they sick in bed, the Lord gon' be their strength. He gon' hold 'em up and keep 'em steady.
41.4: I said, 'Lord, have mercy on me. Heal me—I know I messed up and sinned against You.'
41.5: But my enemies talk wild about me. They like, 'When he gon' die already? When his name gon' fade out?'
41.6: Some of them fake, actin' like they care when they show up—but they just collectin' drama to go run and tell.
41.7: Everybody who hate me whisperin' together, plottin' on how to bring me down.
41.8: They say, 'He got some disease on him—he ain't gettin' up from that.'
41.9: Even my close friend—somebody I trusted, somebody who ate at my table—turned on me and stabbed me in the back.
41.10: But You, Lord—be merciful. Lift me back up so I can face what's been done.
41.11: I know You got me, Lord—'cause my enemies didn't get the last word.
41.12: You hold me up 'cause I stayed real. You set me in Your presence forever.
41.13: Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, now and forever. Amen and amen.

42.1: Just like a deer pantin' for water, my soul be thirstin' for You, God.
42.2: I'm parched for the livin' God. When can I show up and be in Your presence?
42.3: I've been cryin' so much, my tears been my food day and night. And folks stay askin' me, 'Where your God at now?'
42.4: When I think back on it, I pour my whole soul out. I used to be out there with the crowd, goin' to God's house with joy and praise, walkin' in step with everybody celebratin'.
42.5: Why you so down, soul? Why you restless? Hope in God—I'ma still praise Him. He the one holdin' me up.
42.6: God, I'm feelin' low right now. But I'ma remember You from way out in Jordan, from Hermon's heights, from the little hill called Mizar.
42.7: Deep callin' to deep as Your waterfalls crash. It's like wave after wave hittin' me—all You.
42.8: But even still—during the day, the Lord gon' show me love. And at night, His song stay with me—a prayer to the God who gave me life.
42.9: I say to You, my rock, 'Why it feel like You forgot about me? Why I gotta keep mournin' while my enemies keep pressin' me?'
42.10: It's like my bones breakin' from the weight of their words. All day they throw shade, sayin', 'Where your God at?'
42.11: Why you still down, soul? Why you anxious? Hope in God—I'ma praise Him again. He the one who lifts my face. He my God.

43.1: Speak up for me, God. Fight my case against this shady nation. Save me from these fake and unjust folks.
43.2: You my strength, God—but why it feel like You tossed me aside? Why I gotta walk around mournin' while my enemies keep pressin' me?
43.3: Send out Your light and truth, Lord—let that guide me. Bring me back to Your holy place, to where You dwell.
43.4: Then I'll step to Your altar, God—the place of my joy overflowin'. I'ma play this harp and praise You, God—You mine.
43.5: Why you still down, soul? Why you restless? Hope in God—'cause I'ma praise Him again. He's the one liftin' my head. He's my God.

44.1: God, we heard all about it—our ancestors told us what You did back in their day, way back.
44.2: You drove out the nations with Your own hand, but You planted our people. You crushed others but lifted us.
44.3: It wasn't their swords that got them the land. It wasn't their strength. It was You—Your hand, Your power, the light of Your face—'cause You chose to love them.
44.4: You my King, God. Speak the word—give Jacob the victory.
44.5: With You, we push back our enemies. In Your name, we stomp on those who try to rise against us.
44.6: I ain't trustin' my bow. My sword won't save me.
44.7: But You saved us from our enemies. You embarrassed the ones who hated us.
44.8: We brag on God all day long. We stay praisin' Your name.
44.9: But now… You pushed us away and shamed us. You don't roll with our armies no more.
44.10: We run from our enemies, and they takin' everything.
44.11: You let us get treated like sheep for the slaughter. We scattered out here, spread across nations.
44.12: You sold us cheap—like we ain't even worth nothin'. Didn't even profit off it.
44.13: Now we a joke to our neighbors—people laugh and mock us all around.
44.14: They use our name like a meme. Everybody shakin' they head when they hear about us.
44.15: I stay feelin' the shame—it's in my face all the time.
44.16: 'Cause of all the hate and loud disrespect from the enemy.
44.17: All this happened, but we ain't forget You. We didn't break Your covenant.
44.18: Our hearts ain't turn from You. Our steps ain't left Your path.
44.19: Still, You crushed us like we was wild animals. You left us in dark places.
44.20: If we had turned to other gods, if we reached out to false names—
44.21: Wouldn't You have called us out? You see straight through hearts.
44.22: But it feel like we dyin' every day—for Your sake. Like sheep headed for the slaughterhouse.
44.23: Wake up, Lord! Why You sleepin'? Get up! Don't leave us like this forever.
44.24: Why You hidin' Your face? Why You forgettin' our pain and struggle?
44.25: Our souls down in the dust. Our bodies stuck to the ground.
44.26: Come help us, Lord. Rise up and redeem us—do it 'cause You still got mercy.

45.1: My heart overflowing with somethin' good—I gotta speak on the King. My tongue movin' like a ready pen—this poem gon' flow.
45.2: You finer than anybody walkin'. Grace drip from Your lips—that's why God blessed You forever.
45.3: Strap up, Mighty One. Rock that sword. Walk in glory and majesty.
45.4: Ride out strong in truth, humility, and righteousness. Let Your right hand show out and do wonders.
45.5: Your arrows hit straight in the hearts of Your enemies. Nations fall under Your feet.
45.6: Your throne, God, lasts forever. Justice is what You rule with—that scepter stay righteous.
45.7: You love what's right and hate evil. That's why God, Your God, anointed You with joy more than anybody else.
45.8: You smell like myrrh, aloes, and cassia. Fresh out the palace, they got You feelin' lifted.
45.9: Royal daughters roll with You. But right next to You? The queen standin' in gold straight outta Ophir.
45.10: Listen up, daughter. Lean in close. Let go of your people and your father's house.
45.11: The King gon' desire your beauty. He's your Lord—worship Him.
45.12: Even the people of Tyre bringin' gifts. The rich tryna get in good with you.
45.13: That royal daughter shinin' inside the palace—her outfit laced in gold.
45.14: She steppin' to the King in a fit full of colors, with her girls right behind her.
45.15: They comin' in with joy and celebration. Enterin' the King's place like royalty.
45.16: Your sons gon' rise in place of your fathers. You gon' make 'em rulers across the earth.
45.17: I'ma make sure Your name gets remembered forever. People gon' praise You from now to always.

46.1: God is our safe place and our strength—always right there when trouble hits.
46.2: So we not scared—even if the earth shakes, even if the mountains slide into the sea.
46.3: Even if the waters roar and foam, even if the mountains tremble as the waves rise.
46.4: There's a river that brings joy to the city of God—the place where the Most High lives.
46.5: God right there in the middle of her—she won't be shaken. God gon' help her as soon as the sun comes up.
46.6: Nations wildin', kingdoms fallin'. But when God speaks? The earth melts.
46.7: The Lord of Heaven's Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our safe spot.
46.8: Come see what the Lord has done—the devastation He brings when He steps in.
46.9: He stops wars all over the world. He breaks bows, snaps spears, and sets chariots on fire.
46.10: Be still—and know that I'm God. I will be lifted up among all nations. I will be praised all over the earth.
46.11: The Lord of hosts is right here with us. The God of Jacob? That's our refuge.

47.1: Clap your hands, everybody! Shout to God like you already got the victory!
47.2: The Lord Most High is awesome—He the real King over the whole earth.
47.3: He gon' bring nations under our feet, and humble every people beneath us.
47.4: He gon' pick out our inheritance Himself—the same blessing He gave Jacob, the one He loves.
47.5: God went up with a shout! The Lord rose up with the blast of a trumpet!
47.6: Sing praise to God—sing it loud! Sing to our King—sing like you mean it!
47.7: God runs the whole world—so sing with some understanding. This ain't just noise—it's truth.
47.8: God sittin' on His throne, rule over all the nations. He got it on lock.
47.9: Leaders of the earth gathered up with God's people—the people of Abraham. All the power in the world? It belongs to God. And He lifted way up.

48.1: The Lord is great—and He deserve big praise, right here in the city of our God, up on His holy mountain.
48.2: That mountain—Mount Zion—it sit high and beautiful, bringin' joy to the whole earth. It's the spot of the Great King.
48.3: God live in her fortresses—He's known in that place as a safe space.
48.4: Look, the kings came together, lined up in formation.
48.5: But when they saw Zion? They were shook. Stunned. They dipped quick.
48.6: Fear hit 'em hard—like a woman havin' contractions.
48.7: You broke their ships, Lord—like they got hit with a hard east wind.
48.8: We heard about it—but now we've seen it, too. The city of the Lord of Heaven's armies. The city of our God. He the one holdin' it down forever.
48.9: We been meditatin' on Your love, God, right in the middle of Your temple.
48.10: Your name stretch worldwide, God—and so does Your praise. Your right hand stay doin' what's right.
48.11: Let Mount Zion turn up with joy. Let Judah's daughters be glad, 'cause Your judgments are just.
48.12: Take a walk around Zion. Go ahead—check her out. Count the towers.
48.13: Peep the defenses. Look at the palaces. So you can tell the next generation how good our God is.
48.14: This God right here? That's our God—forever and always. He gon' guide us… all the way to the end.

49.1: Listen up, everybody—this message is for all y'all. All over the world.
49.2: Whether you low status or high up, rich or broke—this word for you.
49.3: I'm speakin' wisdom, and what I've been meditatin' on? That's real understanding.
49.4: I been tuned in to truth like a proverb, and now I'ma break it down on the strings.
49.5: Why should I be scared when trouble comes? When shady folks surround me with schemes?
49.6: Some folks trust in their money. They flex their wealth like it'll save 'em.
49.7: But they can't buy life for nobody—not even their brother. They can't pay God enough to save a soul.
49.8: Redemption cost way too much. Ain't no price tag that can stop death forever.
49.9: You ain't gon' live forever, and you will see the grave one day.
49.10: You see it for yourself—wise folks die. Fools die too. And they all leave their riches behind.
49.11: Deep down, they think their homes gon' last forever. They name land after themselves like they immortal.
49.12: But no matter how much honor you got, you still human. You die like any animal.
49.13: That's how it go for fools—and the people who cosign their lifestyle.
49.14: They lined up like sheep headin' to the grave. Death feedin' off 'em. But in the morning? The righteous gon' rise up and run it. Their beauty gon' rot in the grave, far from where they once lived.
49.15: But me? God gon' redeem my soul from death's grip—He gon' bring me to Himself.
49.16: Don't trip when you see people get rich or when their lifestyle start lookin' big and shiny.
49.17: 'Cause when they die, they takin' nothin' with 'em. Their status don't follow the coffin.
49.18: Yeah, they might hype themselves up while they livin'. Folks love to praise you when you 'doin' well for yourself.'
49.19: But they still goin' where their ancestors went. And none of them gon' see the light again.
49.20: If you got honor but no understanding? You just like the animals—gon' perish the same way.

50.1: The Mighty One—God, the Lord—He spoke, and called the whole earth to attention, from sun-up to sundown.
50.2: From Zion, God shines out—beautiful, flawless, majestic.
50.3: Our God comin', and He ain't stayin' quiet. Fire blazin' in front of Him, storm rage all around.
50.4: He callin' out to heaven above and earth below—to judge His people.
50.5: 'Bring Me My people—the ones who made a covenant with Me through sacrifice.'
50.6: The skies gon' testify to how right He is—'cause God Himself is Judge.
50.7: 'Listen up, My people—I got something to say. Israel, I'ma testify against you. I'm God. Your God.'
50.8: 'I ain't checkin' you over your sacrifices—you been bringin' them nonstop.'
50.9: 'But I ain't takin' no bull from your house or no goats from your pens.'
50.10: 'All the animals in the forest? They Mine. Cattle on a thousand hills? That's Me too.'
50.11: 'I know every bird flyin'. All the wild creatures? Belong to Me.'
50.12: 'If I was hungry, I wouldn't ask you. The world already Mine—everything in it.'
50.13: 'Do you think I eat bull meat? You think I sip on goat blood?'
50.14: 'What I want is your gratitude. Pay up the vows you made to the Most High.'
50.15: 'Call on Me when trouble hits—I'll pull you out, and you'll give Me glory.'
50.16: But to the wicked, God says: 'Who told you you could recite My words or talk like you part of My covenant?'
50.17: 'You hate correction. You toss My Word behind your back like it ain't nothin.'
50.18: 'You see a thief—you cool with it. Hangin' with cheaters like it's all good.'
50.19: 'Your mouth speaks dirt. Your tongue stay twisted in lies.'
50.20: 'You sit up talkin' down on your own people—even slander your own mama's son.'
50.21: 'You did all this and I stayed quiet—you thought I was just like you. Nah. I'm comin' to check you face to face.'
50.22: 'You better think about this, y'all who forgot Me—'cause if I tear into you, can't nobody save you.'
50.23: 'But the one who praises Me? That's the one honorin' Me. And if you walk right, I'ma show you what salvation look like.'

51.1: Have mercy on me, God—not 'cause I deserve it, but 'cause You full of love. Your kindness don't run out, so please erase all my mess.
51.2: Wash me deep, Lord—get all this sin off me. I'm tryna be clean for real.
51.3: I know what I did. My sin stay in my face—I can't ignore it.
51.4: I sinned against You, Lord. It was You I disrespected. I was wrong, and You right to call me out.
51.5: I been messed up from the start. I came into this world already flawed.
51.6: But You want truth deep down in the heart. You want me to understand wisdom where nobody else can see.
51.7: Purge me with hyssop—clean me like only You can. Wash me 'til I'm whiter than snow.
51.8: Let me hear joy again. I wanna feel life in these bones You broke.
51.9: Turn Your face away from my sins. Blot out all my wrongs.
51.10: Create in me a clean heart, God. Make my spirit solid again.
51.11: Don't throw me out Your presence. Please don't take Your Spirit away from me.
51.12: Bring back the joy of being saved. Keep me steady with Your generous Spirit.
51.13: Then I'll teach other folks who fell off—so they can turn back too.
51.14: Free me from this guilt, God—the kind that come from blood on my hands. You still the God who saves. And if You do, I'ma sing loud about how righteous You are.
51.15: Open my lips, Lord—so I can give You the praise You deserve.
51.16: You don't want just sacrifices. If You did, I'd bring 'em. You ain't lookin' for burnt offerings alone.
51.17: What You really want is a broken spirit—a heart that's crushed and honest. You won't turn that away.
51.18: Do good for Zion, Lord. Rebuild the city walls.
51.19: Then You'll be pleased with the right kind of sacrifices—with hearts behind the offerings. And folks gon' bring bulls to Your altar again.

52.1: Why you braggin' on your evil, big man? God's goodness don't stop—it stay constant.
52.2: Your tongue stay schemin'—like a sharp blade cuttin' folks down with lies.
52.3: You love wrong more than right. Lies more than truth.
52.4: Every word out your mouth tryna destroy. You got a deceitful tongue, and you proud of it.
52.5: But God gon' deal with you—permanently. He gon' snatch you up, tear you out your house, and rip your roots up from the land of the livin'.
52.6: The righteous gon' see it and be like, 'Whoa.' They gon' laugh and say—
52.7: 'That's the one who didn't lean on God, but trusted in money and made evil his safety net.'
52.8: But me? I'm like an olive tree growin' strong in God's house. I trust His mercy—forever and ever.
52.9: I'ma praise You, Lord, forever—'cause You already did it. And I'ma stay posted with Your people, waitin' on Your name—'cause Your name is good.

53.1: The fool say in they heart, 'Ain't no God.' They corrupt out here—doing straight-up dirty. Ain't nobody doin' right.
53.2: God lookin' down from heaven, checkin' to see if anybody got sense—if anybody out here actually seekin' Him.
53.3: But everybody turned away. All of 'em twisted now. Ain't none doin' good. Not a single one.
53.4: These evil workers—don't they know better? They eat up My people like a snack and never call on God.
53.5: Now look at 'em—shakin' in fear, and for what? God already scattered the bones of those who came at you. He shamed 'em—'cause He ain't messin' with them.
53.6: Man, if salvation would just rise up outta Zion! When God brings His people back from the struggle—Jacob gon' celebrate, and Israel gon' be real glad.

54.1: Save me, God—use Your name. Stand up for me with Your strength.
54.2: Lord, hear my prayer. Really listen to what I'm sayin'.
54.3: Strangers came at me outta nowhere. Oppressors tryna take my life. They ain't got God on their mind.
54.4: But look—God my help. The Lord got folks standin' with me.
54.5: He gon' pay back my enemies for what they did. Shut 'em down with Your truth.
54.6: I'ma offer You praise, free and real. I'ma bless Your name, Lord—'cause it's good.
54.7: You done brought me through every kind of trouble. And now I'm watchin' You handle my enemies right in front of me.

55.1: God, hear my prayer. Don't turn away from me when I'm cryin' out.
55.2: Listen close. I'm restless, complainin' out loud—I can't sit still.
55.3: It's the voices of my enemies, Lord. They keep pressin' me. The wicked keep throwin' shade, bringin' chaos and hate my way.
55.4: My heart hurt deep. Death got me shakin'.
55.5: I'm scared. I'm tremblin'. Panic got me in a chokehold.
55.6: I said, 'If I had wings like a dove, I'd dip out and finally rest.'
55.7: I'd fly far away—hide in the wilderness.
55.8: I'd run fast—get away from the storm before it hits full force.
55.9: Break 'em down, Lord. Mix up their words—'cause all I see is violence and drama in the city.
55.10: They patrollin' the streets all day and night—iniquity, trouble, everywhere.
55.11: It's destruction in the air. Lies and oppression don't ever take a break out here.
55.12: If it was an enemy comin' for me, I could deal with that. If it was a hater, I'd duck the drama.
55.13: But it was you. Somebody like me. My own companion. My friend.
55.14: We used to walk together, talk deep, go to God's house together in the crowd.
55.15: Let judgment come quick on them. Let 'em drop alive into the pit—evil lives in their crib.
55.16: But me? I'm callin' on God. The Lord gon' save me.
55.17: Morning, noon, and night—I'ma pray out loud. And He gon' hear me.
55.18: He already brought me peace—rescued me from the battle around me. Even when it felt like everybody was against me.
55.19: God gon' listen. The Eternal One gon' strike back. 'Cause they ain't changin'—they don't fear God.
55.20: That person—he turned on the ones who was at peace with him. Broke the bond like it meant nothin'.
55.21: His words sounded smooth like butter—but his heart was geared for war. His talk was soft like oil—but his tongue cut like a blade.
55.22: Cast your stress on the Lord—He gon' hold you up. He won't let the righteous fall.
55.23: But You, God? You gon' bring the wicked down—straight into destruction. Bloodthirsty, shady folks ain't even gon' live out half their years. But me? I'ma trust in You.

56.1: Have mercy on me, God—people out here tryna swallow me whole. All day long they stay tryna beat me down.
56.2: My enemies don't quit—they stay on me heavy. It's a lot of them, Lord.
56.3: But when I'm scared? I trust in You.
56.4: In God—whose Word I praise—I'm puttin' my trust. I ain't gon' be afraid. What can flesh really do to me?
56.5: All day they twist up my words. Every thought they got? It's wicked.
56.6: They mob up, lay low, track my every move—waitin' to catch me slippin'.
56.7: You gon' let them get away with that, God? Nah. Handle 'em in Your righteous anger.
56.8: You've seen every step I took while runnin'. You caught every tear I cried—You got it all written down.
56.9: The moment I call out to You, my enemies back up. I know You for me—no doubt.
56.10: In God—whose Word I praise. In the Lord—whose Word I praise.
56.11: I trust You, God. I ain't scared. What can anybody do to me?
56.12: I made vows to You, God—and I'ma keep my word. I'ma praise You like I promised.
56.13: You kept my soul from death. You kept me from fallin'—so I can walk with You in the light of the livin'.

57.1: Have mercy on me, God—please, have mercy. My soul trustin' in You. I'm takin' shelter under Your wings 'til the storm pass by.
57.2: I'm cryin' out to God Most High—the One who handles everything for me.
57.3: He gon' send help from heaven and save me. He gon' put to shame the one tryna take me out. God gon' send His mercy and truth down here.
57.4: I'm surrounded by lions. I'm layin' low among folks who stay heated. Their teeth like spears and arrows—their tongue cut like a blade.
57.5: Be lifted up, God—above the heavens. Let Your glory sit high over the whole earth.
57.6: They set a trap for me—my soul feel heavy. They dug a pit, but look—they fell in it themselves.
57.7: My heart locked in, God. I'm steady. I will sing. I will praise.
57.8: Wake up, soul. Wake up, music. I'ma rise up with the sun.
57.9: I'm gon' praise You, Lord, in front of all the people. I'ma sing to You across the nations.
57.10: Your mercy reach up to the skies. Your truth go all the way to the clouds.
57.11: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens. Let Your glory rise over the whole earth.

58.1: Y'all really speakin' justice? For real? You call that righteous judgment, humans?
58.2: Nah. Deep down, y'all twisted. Y'all out here dealin' violence like it's business as usual.
58.3: The wicked been off since birth. Soon as they learn to talk, they start lyin'.
58.4: Their words poison—like snake venom. They like cobras with stopped-up ears.
58.5: They don't even listen to snake charmers—no matter how slick the song is.
58.6: Break their teeth, God! Knock out the fangs of these young lions, Lord!
58.7: Let 'em vanish like water flowin' away. When they pull the bowstring back—let them arrows snap mid-air.
