58.8: Let 'em melt away like a snail on the pavement. Let 'em be like stillborns—never even see the light.
58.9: Before their pots can feel the heat from the fire—they gon' get swept away in God's burning wrath like a storm.
58.10: The righteous? They gon' rejoice when they see justice. They gon' walk through the aftermath of God dealin' with evil.
58.11: And folks gon' say, 'Yep, the righteous do get rewarded. For real—for real—God is the Judge over this whole earth.'

59.1: God, rescue me from my enemies. Stand between me and the ones comin' for me.
59.2: Pull me outta the hands of these wicked folks. Save me from these bloodthirsty men.
59.3: Look—they settin' traps for my life. The powerful ganged up on me—and I ain't even do nothin', Lord.
59.4: They out here runnin' up on me, gettin' ready to strike, and I'm innocent. Wake up, Lord! Come see what's goin' down.
59.5: Lord God of Heaven's Armies—God of Israel—rise up and bring judgment to these nations. Don't spare any of these bold, wicked folks.
59.6: They come creepin' at night, growlin' like stray dogs, prowlin' through the city.
59.7: They talk reckless, like swords comin' out their mouths. They think nobody hearin' 'em.
59.8: But You, Lord? You laugh at them. You got every nation lookin' foolish.
59.9: I'ma wait on You—'cause You my strength. God is my defense.
59.10: My God full of mercy—He gon' pull up and meet me. I'ma see with my own eyes how He handles my enemies.
59.11: Don't take 'em out too quick—so folks don't forget. Break 'em down slow. Scatter 'em with Your power. You, Lord, are our shield.
59.12: For all the lies they talk and all the mess they speak—catch 'em slippin' in their pride. They mouths full of curses and lies.
59.13: Burn it all down, God. Wipe 'em out with Your anger—'til they ain't even there. Then everybody gon' know God runs this—He the One in charge from Jacob to the ends of the earth.
59.14: And still—every night they come back, growlin' like dogs, prowlin' through the city.
59.15: They on the hunt for food. And if they don't get it? They howl like they starvin'.
59.16: But me? I'ma sing about Your power. Loud. In the morning, I'ma praise Your mercy—'cause You been my protector when trouble came knockin'.
59.17: You, my strength—I'm singin' to You. God is my defense. My God of mercy.

60.1: God, You pushed us away. You broke us down. You were mad at us—but Lord, bring us back.
60.2: The ground shook 'cause of You—cracked and split. Heal it, Lord—it's still unstable.
60.3: You showed us hard times. Gave us a cup full of confusion—we been stumbling ever since.
60.4: But You gave a banner to the ones who fear You—so we can wave it high for the sake of truth.
60.5: Come save the ones You love—use Your right hand. Answer me when I call.
60.6: God spoke from His holiness and said: 'I'ma rejoice. I'ma claim Shechem and measure out Succoth.'
60.7: 'Gilead? Mine. Manasseh? Mine. Ephraim my helmet. Judah my command post.'
60.8: 'Moab? That's my washbasin. I'ma throw my sandal at Edom. Philistia? Go ahead and shout—but know it's Me you shoutin' under.'
60.9: But who's gon' lead me to that strong city? Who's takin' me into Edom?
60.10: Ain't it You, God—the One who pushed us away? You didn't march with our armies.
60.11: We need help, Lord. Human strength ain't enough.
60.12: But through God? We gon' move bold. He the One who gon' stomp out our enemies.

61.1: Lord, hear me cryin' out. Listen close to my prayer.
61.2: From way out, feelin' far from everything—I'm callin' You. When my heart overwhelmed, lead me to the Rock that's higher than me.
61.3: You been my shelter, my safe spot. A strong tower when the enemy roll up.
61.4: I'm stayin' in Your house forever. I'm trustin' the shadow of Your wings to cover me.
61.5: You heard the vows I made, God. You gave me the same blessing You gave to everybody who fears Your name.
61.6: You gon' keep the king alive, add years to his life like he got generations left in him.
61.7: Let him stay before You forever, Lord. Cover him with mercy and truth—let that be what keeps him.
61.8: So I'ma praise You forever, Lord. Every day I wake up, I'ma keep my promises to You.

62.1: My soul sittin' in silence, waitin' on God. He the one who saves me.
62.2: He the only rock I got—my salvation, my protection. I won't be shaken much.
62.3: How long y'all gon' keep comin' for me? You actin' tough, but you leanin' like a broke-down wall—ready to fall.
62.4: All y'all talk about is how to take folks down. You love lies. Smilin' in my face, but cursin' behind my back.
62.5: Soul, stay quiet—wait on God alone. He's where my hope come from.
62.6: He the only rock I stand on—my salvation, my shield. I ain't goin' nowhere.
62.7: My rescue and my honor? That's all in God's hands. He my strength, my refuge, my safe place.
62.8: Y'all—trust Him at all times. Pour your heart out to Him. God is our refuge.
62.9: Low-class folks? Just a puff of smoke. High-class folks? A whole lie. Put both on a scale—they don't even weigh more than air.
62.10: Don't lean on injustice. Don't bet on dirty money. And if your pockets get heavy? Don't let your heart get caught up in it.
62.11: God already said it once—and I heard it twice: Power belongs to God.
62.12: And mercy? That's Yours too, Lord. 'Cause You pay everybody back for how they move.

63.1: God, You my God. I'm up early searchin' for You. My soul thirsty, my body reachin'—like I'm in a dry land with no water.
63.2: I been lookin' for You in the sanctuary—tryna see Your power, tryna feel Your glory.
63.3: Your love? Better than life itself. So I'ma praise You with these lips.
63.4: Long as I'm breathin', I'ma bless You. I'ma lift my hands high in Your name.
63.5: You fill me up like a soul feast—like rich food for the spirit. My mouth gon' praise You with joy.
63.6: Even when I'm layin' in bed at night, I'm thinkin' 'bout You. Meditatin' on You when everything quiet.
63.7: You been my help, Lord. So under the shadow of Your wings? I'ma rejoice.
63.8: My soul clings tight to You—and Your right hand holdin' me up.
63.9: But the ones tryna take me out? They headed straight to the dirt.
63.10: They gon' fall by the sword—left out in the wild for jackals to claim.
63.11: But the king? He rejoicin' in God. Everybody who swears by Him gon' celebrate. But liars? They mouths gon' get shut.

64.1: God, listen to me when I pray—protect me from fear when the enemy out here movin'.
64.2: Hide me from the ones schemin' in secret—from folks plottin' rebellion and evil.
64.3: They sharp with their tongues like swords. They pull back words like arrows—biting, bitter words.
64.4: They shoot from the shadows at people who ain't even done nothin'. No hesitation. No fear.
64.5: They hype each other up to do wrong. They talk slick about setting traps in the dark. Like, 'Ain't nobody gon' see us.'
64.6: They plotting deep—slick with it. 'We got this plan down to a science.' But God sees that mess—He know every hidden thought.
64.7: But God? He got arrows too. He gon' shoot back—and they gon' get hit quick.
64.8: They gon' trip over their own mouths—get caught up in their own lies. Folks gon' see it and run the other way.
64.9: Then everybody gon' fear God. They gon' talk about what He did—and really think on it.
64.10: The righteous? They gon' be glad in the Lord, put their trust in Him. And everybody with a real heart? They gon' praise loud.

65.1: Praise stay ready for You, God, up in Zion. And we gon' keep our vows to You.
65.2: You the One who hears prayer. That's why everybody—no matter who they are—gonna come to You.
65.3: Sin been heavy on us. But You? You step in and cover our wrongs.
65.4: Blessed is the one You choose—who You let come close and live in Your space. We stay full off the goodness in Your house, in Your holy place.
65.5: You answer us with wild, righteous works, God of our salvation. You the hope for folks way off across the globe—even way out on the ocean.
65.6: You built the mountains strong, dressed in power.
65.7: You the One who calms the seas when they loud—and hushes the chaos in the people too.
65.8: People way out in the corners of the earth stand in awe when You show up. From sunup to sundown, You make everything sing with joy.
65.9: You visit the earth and give it rain. You bless it heavy. God's river stay full. You make sure there's grain—You planned it all out.
65.10: You drench the soil. Loosen it up. You water every row. Everything start growin' 'cause of Your hand.
65.11: You crown the year with Your goodness, and every step You take drips with blessing.
65.12: Even the wild fields get touched. The little hills dance with joy.
65.13: The pastures dressed up in flocks, the valleys packed with grain. They shout and sing—they can't hold it in.

66.1: Shout for joy to God, everybody—whole earth, lift Him up!
66.2: Sing loud for His name! Make His praise sound glorious.
66.3: Tell God: 'Yo, Your works are crazy amazing! Your power so strong, even Your enemies gotta bow down.'
66.4: The whole earth gon' worship You. They gon' sing praise to You. They gon' lift up Your name with songs.
66.5: Come see what God do. His works toward people? Straight up awesome.
66.6: He turned the sea into dry land—they walked across the river on foot. And we still celebratin' Him for that.
66.7: He rules with power that don't fade. He watchin' every nation. So don't think rebellion gon' slide past Him.
66.8: Bless God, y'all! Let His praise ring loud!
66.9: He's the one keepin' us alive. He don't let us slip.
66.10: You tested us, God. You refined us like silver in the fire.
66.11: You let us get caught up. You laid weight on our backs.
66.12: People rode over our heads—we been through the fire and the flood. But You brought us out into a good place, a rich spot.
66.13: Now I'ma bring offerings to Your house. I'ma pay my vows, Lord.
66.14: The ones I promised when I was beggin' You for help.
66.15: I'ma bring the fat offerings—rams smellin' sweet, bulls and goats—all for You.
66.16: Come here, everybody who respects God—let me tell y'all what He did for me.
66.17: I cried out to Him with my mouth, and I lifted Him up with my words.
66.18: If I had hidden sin in my heart? He wouldn't have listened.
66.19: But God did hear me. He paid attention when I prayed.
66.20: Praise God! He didn't shut me out. He didn't withhold His mercy!

67.1: God, show us mercy and bless us. Let Your face shine on us.
67.2: So that the whole world can know Your way—and every nation can see Your salvation.
67.3: Let the people praise You, God—all the people.
67.4: Let the nations rejoice and sing with joy! 'Cause You judge with fairness, and You run this earth right.
67.5: Let the people praise You, God—every last one of 'em.
67.6: Then the earth gon' produce more. Our God—the One who's ours—He gon' bless us.
67.7: Yes, God will bless us. And every corner of the earth gon' respect Him.

68.1: Let God rise up! Let His enemies scatter! Let everybody who hate Him run for cover.
68.2: Blow 'em away like smoke in the wind. Melt 'em like wax near fire. That's what happens when God shows up.
68.3: But the righteous? They gon' be glad. They gon' rejoice in His presence—big time.
68.4: Sing to God! Praise His name! Lift up the One who rides the clouds. His name is Yah—go ahead and shout before Him.
68.5: He's a Father to the fatherless, defender of widows—that's who God is in His holy place.
68.6: He puts lonely people in families. He sets prisoners free and blesses 'em. But the rebellious? They stay stuck in dry places.
68.7: God, when You stepped out in front of Your people, when You marched through the wilderness—
68.8: The earth shook, the skies poured rain when You showed up, God. Mount Sinai moved at the presence of Israel's God.
68.9: You sent rain, Lord—plenty of it. You refreshed Your tired people.
68.10: Your people lived in that place. You took care of the poor outta Your own goodness.
68.11: You dropped the Word, Lord—and a whole army of women shouted it loud.
68.12: Kings ran off—they fled! And the women back home divided the loot.
68.13: Even y'all layin' low by the sheep pens—y'all gon' shine like silver-winged doves, gold feathers in the sun.
68.14: When the Almighty scattered kings, it looked like fresh snow on Mount Zalmon.
68.15: The mountain of Bashan? That big ol' peak? Yeah, it's majestic.
68.16: But don't be jealous, Bashan—'cause God picked Zion as His forever home.
68.17: God rollin' deep—thousands on thousands of angelic chariots. The Lord is right there among them, just like He was at Sinai.
68.18: You rose up high, Lord. Took captivity captive. You even got gifts from the rebels—so You could dwell there.
68.19: Bless the Lord—He load us up with blessings daily. He's the God who saves!
68.20: Our God saves. And when death try to come for us? God got the escape plan.
68.21: But His enemies? He gon' strike 'em down—right in the head.
68.22: God said, 'I'ma bring 'em back from Bashan. Pull 'em up from the sea's depths.'
68.23: So y'all can walk in victory. Even the dogs gon' get their portion from the defeated.
68.24: We saw it—Your parade, God. You, our King, marchin' into the sanctuary.
68.25: Singers in front, musicians followin'. Young women on tambourines dancin' through.
68.26: Praise God in the gathering! Bless the Lord—from the root of Israel.
68.27: There go little Benjamin leadin'. Then Judah's princes, Zebulun's crew, Naphtali's squad.
68.28: God, You gave us strength—now strengthen what You started.
68.29: Because of Your temple in Jerusalem, kings gon' come with gifts.
68.30: Shut down the beasts in the reeds. The bulls and their calves—let all who love war fall back. Bring peace—with silver in hand.
68.31: Envoys comin' from Egypt. Ethiopia stretchin' out her hands to God.
68.32: Sing to God, all nations! Sing praises to the Lord!
68.33: To the One ridin' the ancient heavens! He speaks with power—loud and clear!
68.34: Tell everybody how strong God is. His majesty covers Israel. His power rides in the clouds.
68.35: God, You more awesome than the temple itself. You the One who gives strength and power to Your people. Blessed be God!

69.1: God, save me! I'm in deep—water up to my neck.
69.2: I'm sinkin' in the mud, can't find no solid ground. I'm caught in the flood, gettin' swept under.
69.3: I've cried 'til I'm worn out. My throat dry, my eyes tired from waitin' on You, God.
69.4: I got more enemies than I got hairs on my head—hatin' for no reason. They powerful, tryna take me down, even though I ain't done nothin'. Still endin' up payin' for things I didn't take.
69.5: You know me, God. You see my foolish moments. Ain't nothin' hid from You.
69.6: Don't let the ones who trust You be embarrassed because of me, Lord. Don't let folks who seek You feel played on account of me, O God of Israel.
69.7: I've been clowned and shamed for reppin' You. My face stay covered in it.
69.8: Even my own family don't recognize me. I'm a stranger to them.
69.9: I care so much about Your house, it eats me alive. And when folks hate on You, I end up catchin' that heat too.
69.10: I fasted, I cried, I humbled myself—and they made fun of that too.
69.11: I wore sackcloth to mourn, and they turned me into a joke.
69.12: Leaders at the gate talk about me. Drunks made me their punchline.
69.13: But I'm still prayin' to You, Lord. I know You'll hear me when the time is right. Answer me with Your love and truth.
69.14: Pull me out the mud. Don't let me drown. Rescue me from the haters and the deep water.
69.15: Don't let the flood take me under. Don't let the pit swallow me whole.
69.16: Hear me, Lord—Your love is good. Turn toward me with all that mercy You've got.
69.17: Don't hide from me. I'm in trouble—please answer me quick.
69.18: Come close, redeem me. Save me from these enemies.
69.19: You know what I'm dealin' with—my shame, my pain, my haters? You see it all.
69.20: They broke my heart with all that disrespect. I'm heavy. I looked for someone to care—nobody. Looked for comfort—found none.
69.21: They gave me bitter stuff to eat, and when I was thirsty, they gave me vinegar.
69.22: Let their fancy setups turn into traps. Let their blessings backfire.
69.23: Let them go blind to what's real. Make their strength shake.
69.24: Pour out Your anger on them, God. Let Your wrath hit heavy.
69.25: Let their homes stay empty. Let nobody live where they lived.
69.26: They mess with the ones You already wounded. They mock the pain You allowed.
69.27: Pile sin on top of sin. Don't let them walk into Your righteousness.
69.28: Erase their names from the book of life. Don't list them with the righteous.
69.29: But I'm low, Lord. I'm hurtin'. Let Your salvation lift me up.
69.30: I'ma praise Your name with a song. I'ma thank You loud.
69.31: That kind of praise mean more to You than sacrifices.
69.32: The humble gon' see this and celebrate. If you seek God, your heart gon' come alive.
69.33: God listens to the poor. He don't ignore those locked up.
69.34: Let heaven and earth praise Him—even the oceans and everything in 'em.
69.35: God gon' save Zion. He gon' rebuild Judah. His people gon' live there and own it.
69.36: The kids of His servants gon' inherit it. The ones who love His name? They gon' dwell in it.

70.1: Hurry up, God—come get me. Move fast, Lord—I need help!
70.2: Let the ones tryna take me out be embarrassed. Let the ones who want me hurt be shut down and confused.
70.3: Turn 'em around in shame—especially the ones talkin' slick, like, 'Aha! Got him!'
70.4: But everybody who's lookin' for You? Let 'em rejoice. Let 'em be glad in You. And let the ones who love Your salvation keep shoutin', 'God is great!'
70.5: But me? I'm broke and strugglin'. Come quick, God! You my help. You my deliverer. Lord, don't take too long!

71.1: I'm trustin' in You, Lord—don't let me end up embarrassed.
71.2: Come through for me in righteousness. Get me outta this. Lean in and hear me—save me.
71.3: Be my strong spot, my safe place—the one I run to over and over. You already told me You'd save me. You my rock. You my fortress.
71.4: God, pull me outta the hands of the wicked—these cruel, shady people tryna take me down.
71.5: You been my hope since the jump, Lord. I been leanin' on You since I was young.
71.6: You held me up from the womb. You the One who brought me out. So I'ma keep praisin' You—nonstop.
71.7: People look at me like I'm a mystery, but You my safe place.
71.8: Let my mouth stay full of praise for You—all day, every day.
71.9: Don't leave me when I get old, Lord. Don't walk off when my strength start slippin'.
71.10: My enemies whisperin'. They plottin' behind my back.
71.11: They sayin', 'God left him. Now's the time. Ain't nobody comin' to save him.'
71.12: But Lord, don't stay far. Come quick. I need help now.
71.13: Let everybody tryin' to hurt me be embarrassed. Let 'em be brought low and shut down.
71.14: But me? I'ma keep hopin'. I'ma keep praisin'—more and more.
71.15: I'ma talk about how right You are. How You save. All day. And I still don't even know the full of it.
71.16: I'm walkin' in Your strength, God. And I'm only talkin' about Your righteousness.
71.17: You been teachin' me since I was a kid. And I'm still out here tellin' folks about the amazing things You've done.
71.18: So even now that I'm older, with gray hair—don't leave me, God. Let me keep tellin' this generation how strong You are. Let me show the next ones Your power.
71.19: Your righteousness, God? It's sky high. You do great things. Ain't nobody like You.
71.20: You've let me see hard times—deep pain. But You'll lift me back up. You'll raise me out the pit again.
71.21: You gon' increase my influence—and surround me with comfort.
71.22: I'ma praise You with the strings, Lord. I'ma sing about Your faithfulness. You holy, You Israel's One and Only.
71.23: When I sing, my lips gon' rejoice. My soul gon' praise too—'cause You the One who saved me.
71.24: My tongue stay talkin' about how righteous You are—all day. 'Cause the folks who came for me? They embarrassed. They lost.

72.1: God, give the king Your justice. Pass down Your righteousness to the king's son.
72.2: Let him judge Your people the right way—give the poor what's fair.
72.3: Let the mountains bring peace to the people. Let the hills overflow with righteousness.
72.4: Let him stand up for the poor. Save the kids in need. And break the oppressor into pieces.
72.5: May folks fear and respect You as long as the sun and moon shine—through all generations.
72.6: Let him show up like rain fallin' on cut grass, like fresh showers waterin' the land.
72.7: In his days, may the righteous flourish. Let peace be abundant—until the moon gone.
72.8: His reach? From sea to sea. From the river all the way to the edge of the earth.
72.9: Even folks out in the wild gon' bow down. His enemies? They gon' eat dust.
72.10: Kings from Tarshish and the islands gon' bring gifts. Kings from Sheba and Seba showin' up with offerings.
72.11: All kings gon' kneel before Him. Every nation gon' serve Him.
72.12: 'Cause when the needy cry, He hears. When the poor got nobody, He steps in.
72.13: He got mercy on the weak and the broke. He gon' save the souls of the desperate.
72.14: He gon' rescue them from violence and oppression. Their lives matter to Him—they precious in His eyes.
72.15: Long live the King! Folks bringin' Him gold from Sheba. They prayin' for Him every day. Praisin' Him nonstop.
72.16: Grain gon' grow like crazy—even on mountaintops. Fruit flowin' like Lebanon trees. City folks gon' thrive like grass after rain.
72.17: His name? Gon' last forever. Shine as long as the sun. Everybody blessed through Him. All nations gon' call Him blessed.
72.18: Bless the Lord God—the God of Israel—'cause only He does wonders like this.
72.19: Bless His glorious name forever. Let the whole earth be filled with His glory. Amen and amen.
72.20: This wraps up the prayers of David, son of Jesse.

73.1: For real—for real—God is good to Israel, especially to the ones who got a pure heart.
73.2: But me? I almost slipped. My feet were shakin'. I was close to fallin' off.
73.3: I was jealous of the arrogant—'cause I saw how the wicked was livin' large.
73.4: They don't struggle when they die. Their bodies strong all the way through.
73.5: They don't deal with the pain regular folks do. Life ain't hittin' them like it hit us.
73.6: That's why they walkin' around with pride like it's jewelry. Violence wrapped around them like designer coats.
73.7: They got more than enough—eyes full of excess. Hearts overflowin' with everything they want.
73.8: They mockin' folks, speakin' evil. They act like oppression ain't a problem.
73.9: Mouth talkin' reckless about heaven. Tongue out here wildin' through the whole earth.
73.10: And somehow, people still follow them. Drinking it all in like it's sweet.
73.11: They even bold enough to say, 'How God gon' know? Like the Most High really watchin'.'
73.12: This what the wicked look like—livin' easy, stackin' wealth.
73.13: Man… I started wonderin' if livin' right was even worth it. Like I cleaned up for nothin'.
73.14: All day I stay gettin' hit. Every morning it's another lesson.
73.15: But if I had really said all that out loud, I would've been fake toward Your people, Lord.
73.16: Tryin' to make sense of it all messed me up inside.
73.17: Till I stepped into Your sanctuary—and then I saw the bigger picture.
73.18: You got them on slippery ground. They headed straight for a crash.
73.19: One minute they up, next they destroyed. Gone in a blink—shook and swallowed up.
73.20: They like a dream You forget when You wake up. When You show up, Lord, it's a wrap.
73.21: That realization broke me. Had my heart all twisted.
73.22: I was trippin'. Ignorant. Actin' like a wild animal in front of You.
73.23: But even then—you stayed with me. Held me by the hand.
73.24: You still givin' me wisdom. And when it's all said and done? You gon' bring me into glory.
73.25: Ain't nobody in heaven but You. And down here? You the only One I really want.
73.26: My flesh? My heart? They may fail. But God? You my strength and my portion—forever.
73.27: Folks who wander from You? They gon' perish. Anybody leavin' You for idols? Done.
73.28: But me? I'm stayin' close to God. I'm puttin' my trust in the Lord—so I can tell the world about what He's done.

74.1: God, why You actin' like You done with us? Why Your anger burnin' against Your own sheep—Your people?
74.2: Remember Your crew, Lord—the ones You bought way back. The tribe You claimed, the folks You saved. This Mount Zion where You used to dwell.
74.3: Step up, Lord—look at the ruins. The enemy wrecked everything in Your sanctuary.
74.4: They loud in the middle of Your meeting place—screamin' like they own it. They put up their own banners where Yours used to be.
74.5: They came in swingin' like lumberjacks, axes in hand, choppin' like they was cuttin' down trees.
74.6: They smashed up all the carved art—busted it up with axes and hammers like it meant nothin'.
74.7: Then they set fire to Your holy place—burned it down and dragged Your name through the dirt.
74.8: They said, 'Let's wipe them out completely.' And they really torched every spot where You used to be worshiped.
74.9: We can't see no signs from You. No more prophets. Nobody even knows how long this gon' last.
74.10: God, how long You gon' let the enemy clown us? They out here disrespectin' Your name nonstop—forever?
74.11: Why You keep holdin' back Your hand? Pull out Your power and handle them.
74.12: You've always been our King, Lord. You save right here in the middle of the world.
74.13: You split the sea with power. You crushed sea monsters in the deep.
74.14: You broke Leviathan's head into pieces—served him up like scraps for folks in the wilderness.
74.15: You opened up springs and rivers. You dried up strong currents with a word.
74.16: You own the day and the night. You set the sun in place. You made light what it is.
74.17: You drew the borders of the earth. You created summer and winter.
74.18: Lord, remember this: the enemy been out here talkin' reckless. Foolish people draggin' Your name.
74.19: Don't let Your precious ones—like Your turtledove—get snatched by wild beasts. Don't forget the poor forever.
74.20: Remember Your promise. The world feel dark and violent out here. Evil lurks in every corner.
74.21: Don't let the oppressed stay ashamed. Let the poor and the broken rise up and praise You.
74.22: Get up, God! Fight for Your name. Don't forget how they mock You every day.
74.23: Don't ignore the voices of Your enemies. The noise of their hate just keeps gettin' louder.

75.1: We thank You, God—we thank You loud! 'Cause Your works let everybody know You close.
75.2: God says, "I move when the time is right. I judge fair, no cap."
75.3: "When the earth feel like it's fallin' apart and folks panickin'? I'm the one holdin' the pillars steady."
75.4: "I told the cocky folks, 'Chill with all that pride.' Told the wicked, 'Don't be out here flexin' like you untouchable.'"
75.5: "Don't lift yourself up like you run things. Don't talk slick with that proud energy."
75.6: "'Cause elevation don't come from the east, west, or south."
75.7: "God is the one who promotes. He the Judge. He bring folks down—and He lift folks up."
75.8: "The Lord got a cup in His hand—it's full, strong, and mixed. He pour it out, and the wicked gon' drink it to the last drop—bitter dregs and all."
75.9: "But I'ma keep speakin' on this forever. I'ma keep singin' to the God of Jacob."
75.10: "God gon' cut off all the horns—all that power—from the wicked. But the righteous? Their horn gon' rise."

76.1: God got a name in Judah. He's known, and His name ring out in Israel.
76.2: His place of worship is in Salem. His home base? Zion.
76.3: That's where He broke the arrows, snapped the shields, shut down the swords and the whole battle setup.
76.4: You shine brighter than any mountain full of trophies. You more glorious than anything they ever conquered.
76.5: The bold and brave? They laid out. Sleepin' like they never knew how to fight. Their strength don't mean nothin' now.
76.6: One word from You, God of Jacob—and the chariots and horses knocked out cold.
76.7: You deserve to be feared. Who can even stand when You get mad?
76.8: From heaven, You let judgment be heard. Earth went silent—shook and still.
76.9: You stood up to judge, God. You rose to rescue the ones gettin' crushed down here.
76.10: Even human anger gon' end up praisin' You. And whatever rage is left? You gon' wear that like a belt.
76.11: So go ahead—make those vows to the Lord your God and keep 'em. Everybody close to Him? Bring Him gifts. He's worthy of that fear.
76.12: He cuts off the breath of princes. He don't play with power. God is awesome—even kings gotta bow.

77.1: I cried out to God with everything in me—yeah, I lifted my voice to Him. And He heard me.
77.2: In my worst moment, I reached for the Lord. I was up all night, hands stretched out—couldn't stop. But my soul? Wouldn't even take comfort.
77.3: I tried to remember God—but it just made me feel worse. I kept complainin' till I felt completely overwhelmed.
77.4: You the one keepin' my eyes wide open, Lord. I'm so stressed, I can't even speak.
77.5: I started thinkin' back on the old days… on how it used to be.
77.6: I pulled up songs from the night. I tried to talk to myself, tried to search my own heart for answers.
77.7: Did the Lord leave me for good? He done being good to me?
77.8: Did His mercy run out? Are His promises done forever?
77.9: Did God forget how to show grace? Is He mad forever—holdin' back His love?
77.10: And I said, 'This pain I feel is real… but I'm still gon' remember the years when the Most High moved His right hand.'
77.11: I'ma think on all the things You've done, Lord. I won't forget the wonders You worked back in the day.
77.12: I'ma meditate on all Your works—and I'ma talk about how You move.
77.13: God, Your way is holy. Ain't no god like our God.
77.14: You the One who do miracles. You show Your strength to the world.
77.15: With Your own arm, You saved Your people—the descendants of Jacob and Joseph.
77.16: When the waters saw You, God—they panicked. Even the deep parts shook in fear.
77.17: The clouds poured heavy. The sky cracked loud. Lightning flew like arrows.
77.18: Thunder roared through the storm. The sky lit up like fire. The earth trembled and shook.
77.19: Your path was through the sea, Your way through deep waters—but nobody could track Your footsteps.
77.20: Still, You led Your people like sheep—guiding them by Moses and Aaron's hand.

78.1: Listen up, my people—hear the law. Lean in to what I'm about to say.
78.2: I'ma speak in parables. I'm bringin' up deep stuff from way back.
78.3: Stories we heard and already know—the ones our folks passed down to us.
78.4: We ain't keepin' it to ourselves. We tellin' the next generation how great God is—His strength, His works, all He's done.
78.5: He set up a testimony with Jacob, gave Israel the law, and told our fathers, 'Pass this on to your kids.'
78.6: So the next generation would know, and their kids would rise up and tell their kids.
78.7: So they'd put their hope in God, remember His works, and keep His commandments.
78.8: Not like their stubborn, rebellious ancestors—folks whose hearts were off, whose spirit ain't stay true to God.
78.9: Ephraim's people had weapons, they were strapped—but still turned back when it was time to fight.
78.10: They broke God's covenant. Refused to walk in His law.
78.11: They forgot what He'd done—His wonders they had seen with their own eyes.
78.12: He did wild miracles in front of their daddies—out in Egypt, in the fields of Zoan.
78.13: Split the sea wide open. Led them through. Made water stand tall like walls.
78.14: Gave 'em cloud cover by day, and fire light all night.
78.15: Split rocks in the desert—gave 'em water like rivers from the depths.
78.16: Made streams flow from stone—water gushed like it came from a faucet.
78.17: But they still sinned. Kept testin' God out there in the wilderness.
78.18: They got bold—demanded food they craved, like they was in charge.
78.19: Talkin' slick like, 'Can God even set a table in the desert?'
78.20: 'Yeah, He hit the rock and water poured out—but can He bring us bread? Meat, though?'
78.21: God heard that and got heated. Fire broke out in Jacob. Anger rose against Israel.
78.22: Why? 'Cause they ain't believe in God. Ain't trust His deliverance.
78.23: But He still opened up heaven and dropped blessings.
78.24: Rained down manna—bread straight from glory.
78.25: They ate angel food. And they had more than enough.
78.26: He stirred up the wind—brought meat from the skies.
78.27: Rained down quail like dust—birds like sea sand.
78.28: They landed right in camp, all around their tents.
78.29: They ate 'til they was full. God gave 'em what they asked for.
78.30: But while they were still chewin', God's judgment hit.
78.31: He struck down the strongest men—took out the best of Israel.
78.32: Even after all that, they kept sinning. Still didn't believe in His power.
78.33: So He let them waste years in vanity—livin' scared.
78.34: When folks started droppin', then they ran back to God.
78.35: They remembered—'Oh snap, He's our rock. Our Redeemer.'
78.36: But it was just talk. They flattered Him with lies.
78.37: He saw their hearts weren't real. They stayed breakin' the covenant.
78.38: Still, God was full of mercy. He forgave, didn't wipe them out. Pulled back His anger over and over.
78.39: He remembered—they just flesh. Like breath in the wind—here, then gone.
78.40: Over and over, they disrespected Him in the wilderness. Broke His heart in the desert.
78.41: Kept testin' Him. They put limits on the Holy One of Israel.
78.42: They forgot how powerful He is—how He saved them from Egypt.
78.43: All the signs He did there—wonders in Zoan.
78.44: Turned rivers to blood. Water undrinkable.
78.45: Sent flies and frogs—infestations that wrecked everything.
78.46: Crops got eaten by bugs. Everything they worked for—gone.
78.47: Hail took out their vineyards. Frost hit their fig trees.
78.48: Hail hit their cattle. Lightning hit the flocks.
78.49: God unleashed full wrath—anger, fury, trouble—sent destructive angels on 'em.
78.50: He cleared the way for His judgment. No mercy. They faced death and plague.
78.51: Took out all Egypt's firstborn—strength of their homes, gone.
78.52: But His people? He led them like sheep. Guided them gently in the wild.
78.53: They walked safe. No fear. Meanwhile, the sea drowned their enemies.
78.54: He brought them to holy ground—the mountain He picked.
78.55: Drove out nations. Handed over the land. Gave every tribe their spot.
78.56: But they still tested God. Still pushed His limits. Still ignored His laws.
78.57: Just like their ancestors—unfaithful, unreliable, like a bow that won't shoot straight.
78.58: Made Him mad with idols. Got Him jealous with carved images.
78.59: God heard it, got furious. Started to hate what Israel had become.
78.60: Left Shiloh—His dwelling place. The tent where He lived among them.
78.61: Let His power get captured. His glory snatched by enemies.
78.62: Let His people fall by the sword. Was angry with His own inheritance.
78.63: Fire consumed the young men. The women had no weddings.
78.64: Priests killed in battle. Widows too numb to cry.
78.65: Then God woke up—like a warrior sobering up from wine.
78.66: He beat the enemy back. Shamed them permanently.
78.67: He dropped Joseph's tribe. Didn't choose Ephraim.
78.68: He picked Judah instead. Picked Zion. Said, 'This where I stay.'
78.69: Built His sanctuary strong—high like the heavens, grounded like the earth.
78.70: Then He chose David—pulled him from the sheep pen.
78.71: Took him from watching ewes to lead His people—Jacob and Israel.
78.72: And David led with integrity and guided them with skilled hands.

79.1: God... the nations came in and wrecked what's Yours. They violated Your holy temple. They left Jerusalem in ruins.
79.2: Your people—Your servants—they left their bodies in the streets. Birds eatin' on them. Wild animals feedin' off saints like it's nothin'.
79.3: They spilled blood like water all around the city—and ain't nobody left to bury them.
79.4: Now we a joke to the neighbors. Everybody around us mockin' and laughin'.
79.5: How long, Lord? You gon' stay mad forever? Is Your jealousy burnin' like wildfire?
79.6: Pour that anger on the ones who don't even know You. On kingdoms that never called Your name.
79.7: They the ones who destroyed Jacob. Tore up everything we had.
79.8: Don't hold our past sins against us. Let Your mercy meet us quick—'cause we down bad.
79.9: Help us, God of our salvation—for Your name's glory! Save us. Forgive us. Not 'cause we deserve it, but to rep Your name right!
79.10: Why should these nations get to say, 'Where's their God now?' Let 'em see You avenge the blood of Your servants.
79.11: Let the cries of the locked-up reach You. Use Your power to keep alive the ones marked for death.
79.12: Pay our enemies back, Lord—sevenfold. They been throwin' Your name in the dirt.
79.13: But we? We Your people. The sheep You shepherd. We gon' thank You forever. We gon' praise You through every generation.

80.1: Listen up, Shepherd of Israel—You who lead Joseph's tribe like a flock. You sittin' between the cherubim—shine!
80.2: Before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh—flex Your strength and pull up to save us!
80.3: Bring us back, God. Let Your face shine bright—and we'll be saved.
80.4: Lord God of Heaven's armies, how long You gon' be mad—even while we pray?
80.5: You been feedin' us tears for bread. Our cups overflowin'—with sorrow.
80.6: You made us a problem to our neighbors. Our enemies over there crackin' jokes at our pain.
80.7: Restore us, Lord of hosts. Let Your face shine again—and we gon' be alright.
80.8: You pulled a vine up outta Egypt. You cleared out the nations and planted it.
80.9: You made space, gave it room to grow. It rooted deep and spread all over the land.
80.10: The hills were shaded by its branches. Even the tallest trees got covered.
80.11: It stretched all the way to the sea—its branches reached to the river.
80.12: So why You tear down the hedge around it? Now everybody walkin' by pickin' at it.
80.13: The wild boar from the woods tearin' it up. Beasts from the field feastin' on it.
80.14: Please, God of hosts—turn back to us. Look down from heaven. Come check on Your vine.
80.15: That vineyard You planted with Your own hand. That branch You made strong for Yourself.
80.16: It's burned up. Cut down. Perishin' from just one look from You.
80.17: Put Your hand on the one at Your right hand—the son of man You raised up.
80.18: Then we won't turn from You again. Breathe life into us, and we'll call Your name for real.
80.19: Restore us, Lord God of hosts. Let Your face shine—and we gon' be saved.

81.1: Sing loud to God—He our strength! Shout for joy to the God of Jacob!
81.2: Start up the music—hit the tambourine, the sweet harp, and the lute!
81.3: Blow the trumpet at the New Moon, and again at the full moon on our feast day.
81.4: This ain't random—it's law. A command from the God of Jacob.
81.5: He set it in place for Joseph when He went through Egypt—back when I heard a language I ain't even understand.
81.6: God says, "I took that burden off your shoulders. Your hands ain't carry no more heavy baskets."
81.7: "You called Me when you were in trouble—and I came through. I answered from the storm. I tested you at Meribah's waters."
81.8: "Listen, My people—I'm tryin' to teach you something! Israel, hear Me out!"
81.9: "Don't let no foreign gods in your life. Don't bow to anything that ain't Me."
81.10: "I'm the Lord your God—the One who brought you outta Egypt. Open your mouth wide—I'll fill it."
81.11: "But My people ain't tryna hear Me. Israel acted like I wasn't even there."
81.12: "So I let 'em go—they chose stubbornness, they followed their own plans."
81.13: "But oh, if they would just listen… If they'd walk the way I laid out for 'em…"
81.14: "I would've crushed their enemies quick. I would've flipped the script on their oppressors."
81.15: "Even My haters would've had to fake submission—but they'd be stuck in their fate."
81.16: "And My people? I would've fed 'em the best of wheat. I would've satisfied 'em with honey straight from the rock."

82.1: God showin' up in the middle of the courtroom—standing in the circle of power, judging all these so-called gods.
82.2: He askin': 'How long y'all gon' keep ruling unfairly? How long you gon' keep siding with the wicked?'
82.3: Stand up for the poor and the fatherless. Give real justice to the oppressed and those in need.
82.4: Rescue the ones who can't fight for themselves. Pull them out the grip of the wicked.
82.5: These folks ain't got no clue. No understanding. They movin' blind—and the whole earth shakin' because of it.
82.6: I told y'all, 'You gods, right? You children of the Most High.'
82.7: But you still gon' die like mere men. You gon' fall like every other fallen prince.
82.8: So rise up, God! Bring real judgment to the earth—'cause all nations belong to You anyway.

83.1: Don't stay quiet, God! Don't hold back! Don't be still—please, speak up!
83.2: Look, Your enemies wildin'—makin' noise, gettin' bold, liftin' their heads in pride.
83.3: They schemin' behind closed doors against Your people. Plotting on the ones You protect.
83.4: They say, 'Let's wipe 'em out—make Israel disappear so nobody even remembers them.'
83.5: They all linkin' up with the same goal—they rollin' deep against You, God.
83.6: It's Edom and the Ishmaelites, Moab and the Hagrites,
83.7: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek, Philistia and Tyre's people—
83.8: Even Assyria joined the squad. They backin' up the children of Lot.
83.9: God, do 'em like You did Midian, like Sisera and Jabin at the Kishon stream—
83.10: Who got dropped at En Dor, turned into nothin' but dust on the ground.
83.11: Take their leaders down like Oreb and Zeeb—yeah, like Zebah and Zalmunna too.
83.12: These fools said, 'Let's take God's land for ourselves. We gon' own what He set up.'
83.13: God, make 'em like dust in the wind—like trash blowin' down the street.
83.14: Burn 'em up like wildfire in the woods, like flames racin' up the mountain.
83.15: Chase 'em with Your storm. Scare 'em with Your whirlwind.
83.16: Cover their faces in shame—so maybe they'll finally call on Your name, Lord.
83.17: Let 'em be confused and embarrassed forever. Let 'em fall off and perish.
83.18: So the world knows that You, and You alone, are the Lord—the Most High over the whole earth.

84.1: Lord of Heaven's Armies, Your house is beautiful—straight up lovely.
84.2: My soul is cravin' it—like I'm about to pass out from hunger. My heart and even my body cryin' out for You, the living God.
84.3: Even the sparrow got a spot to call home, and the swallow found a nest to lay her babies—right there by Your altars, Lord of hosts, my King and my God.
84.4: Blessed are the ones who get to live in Your house. They stay praisin' You.
84.5: Blessed are the ones who lean on Your strength, who keep movin' with purpose toward You.
84.6: When they pass through the Valley of Baca (that dry, sorrowful place), they turn it into a spring. Rain falls, blessings flow.
84.7: They go from strength to strength—every one of 'em shows up before God in Zion.
84.8: Lord God of hosts, please hear me. God of Jacob, I'm callin'—listen close.
84.9: God, look out for us like a shield. Keep Your eyes on the one You've chosen.
84.10: One day in Your courts? That's better than a thousand anywhere else. I'd rather hold the door at Your house than live large in the tents of wickedness.
84.11: The Lord God is both sun and shield. He gives grace and glory. And He don't hold back any good thing from those who walk right.
84.12: Lord of hosts, the one who trusts You? That one's already blessed.

85.1: Lord, You been real good to this land. You brought Jacob's people back home.
85.2: You forgave all our sins. Covered every wrong we ever did.
85.3: You pulled back Your anger. You put out the fire of Your wrath.
85.4: Bring us back, God our Savior. Let the beef be over.
85.5: You gon' stay mad forever? Gon' keep this going for generations?
85.6: Ain't You gon' revive us again? So we can rejoice in You for real?
85.7: Show us that mercy, Lord. Drop that salvation.
85.8: I'ma listen for what the Lord God says. He gon' speak peace to His people, His faithful ones—but we can't go back to the same old foolishness.
85.9: His saving power stay close to the ones who respect Him—so glory can live in the land again.
85.10: Mercy and truth finally met up. Righteousness and peace locked lips.
85.11: Truth gon' rise up from the ground. Righteousness lookin' down from the sky.
85.12: Yes—God gon' bless us with good things. The land gon' produce again.
85.13: Righteousness walkin' ahead of Him—makin' a way for His steps to lead us.

86.1: Lord, lean in and hear me. I'm broke and needin' You bad.
86.2: Protect my life—I'm Yours. You my God. Save me, Your servant, 'cause I trust You for real.
86.3: Have mercy on me, Lord. I been cryin' out to You all day.
86.4: Bring joy to this tired soul, 'cause I'm liftin' it up to You.
86.5: You good, Lord. Quick to forgive. Overflowin' with mercy for anybody who calls on You.
86.6: Listen to my prayer, Lord. Pay attention when I'm callin' out.
86.7: When trouble hits, I call You—'cause I know You gon' answer.
86.8: Ain't no other gods like You, Lord. Nobody do what You do.
86.9: Every nation You made? They gon' come worship You and give You glory.
86.10: You do great things—wonders. Only You are truly God.
86.11: Teach me how to move in Your ways, Lord. I'ma walk in truth. Tie my heart to Yours so I fear Your name right.
86.12: I'ma praise You, Lord my God, with everything I got. I'ma lift Your name up forever.
86.13: Your mercy for me is major. You pulled me out the grave—rescued me from the deep.
86.14: Lord, arrogant folks gunnin' for me. Violent people tryna take me out. They don't care nothin' about You.
86.15: But You? You full of compassion, Lord. You gracious. Patient. Overflowin' with mercy and truth.
86.16: Turn toward me. Show me that mercy. Give me strength—I'm Your servant. Save me like You would save Your own mama's child.
86.17: Give me a sign—something good. Let my haters see it and feel ashamed. 'Cause You, Lord, been helpin' me… and holdin' me down.

87.1: God built His foundation up in the holy mountains.
87.2: The Lord got a special love for the gates of Zion—more than any other place in Jacob's territory.
87.3: Glorious things been said about you, city of God. You legendary.
87.4: God says, "I'ma shout out Rahab and Babylon when I talk to those who know Me. Same with Philistia, Tyre, and Ethiopia—'That one was born there.'"
87.5: But when it comes to Zion, folks gon' say, 'This one—and that one too—was born right here.' And the Most High? He's the one who made her solid.
87.6: God Himself keeps the receipts. When He take roll and count the nations, He gon' say, 'That one right there? Born in Zion.'
87.7: And all the singers, all the musicians gon' say the same thing: 'All my roots, all my joy, all my flow—it started in you.'

88.1: Lord, You my God—my only hope of salvation. I been cryin' to You day and night.
88.2: Please hear me. Let my prayers reach You. Don't ignore my cry.
88.3: I'm full of pain. My life feel like it's right on the edge of the grave.
88.4: People treat me like I'm already gone. Like I'm dead weight with no strength left.
88.5: I'm floatin' in the land of the dead—like the bodies in the grave You don't even seem to see no more. Like I'm cut off from Your hand.
88.6: You the one who let me sink this low. I'm in deep darkness. Rock bottom.
88.7: Your anger is crushin' me. Every wave hittin' me, over and over.
88.8: You pushed everybody away from me. Now they act like I'm cursed. I'm trapped. Ain't no way out.
88.9: My eyes done cried themselves out. Still, Lord—I call You every day. I stretch my hands out to You.
88.10: Can the dead see miracles? They gon' rise up from the grave and praise You?
88.11: Can anybody talk about Your love from the grave? Can folks buried in ruin speak on Your faithfulness?
88.12: Who gon' know Your power in the darkness? Who can testify to Your righteousness from the place where people forgotten?
88.13: But I keep cryin' to You, Lord. Every morning I'm right back at it—prayin', callin', beggin'.
88.14: Why You pushin' me away, God? Why You hidin' from me like this?
88.15: I been sufferin' since I was young. Now I'm barely holdin' on. Your terrors got me paralyzed.
88.16: Your anger swept over me like a storm. Your blows cut me deep.
88.17: Trouble surroundin' me like floodwater—all day, every direction. I'm drownin' in it.
88.18: You done pulled everybody from my life. Now all I got left… is darkness.

89.1: I'ma sing about the Lord's mercy forever. I'ma let everybody—generation to generation—know He's faithful.
89.2: I said, 'God's mercy gonna last forever.' And His truth? It's locked in place—up in the heavens.
89.3: God said, "I made a covenant with My chosen one. I swore to David, My servant—
89.4: 'Your bloodline gon' last forever. Your throne? I'ma build that to stand through all generations.'
89.5: The heavens stay shoutin' about how You move, Lord. All the saints speak on Your faithfulness.
89.6: Ain't nobody in heaven like You. None of the mighty can match You.
89.7: God's feared in the assembly of the saints. Everybody near Him shows respect.
89.8: Lord God of Heaven's Armies—ain't nobody mighty like You. You wear faithfulness like a robe.
89.9: You the one who runs the sea. When it gets wild, You shut it down.
89.10: You crushed Rahab like a dead man. Your strong arm scattered enemies.
89.11: Heaven and earth? That's all Yours. You made the whole world and everything in it.
89.12: North and south? You built that too. Tabor and Hermon sing about Your name.
89.13: Your arm strong, Your hand firm, and Your right hand lifted high.
89.14: Righteousness and justice? That's the foundation of Your throne. Mercy and truth always walk ahead of You.
89.15: Blessed are the ones who know the joyful sound. They live in the light of Your presence.
89.16: They celebrate Your name all day. They lifted high by Your righteousness.
89.17: You're the reason they strong. Your favor is what raises their head.
89.18: Our shield? Belongs to the Lord. Our King? That's the Holy One of Israel.
89.19: You spoke in a vision, Lord, and said: 'I lifted up a strong one. I picked him from the people.'
89.20: 'I found David, My servant. I poured holy oil on him.'
89.21: 'My hand gon' keep him steady. My arm gon' keep him strong.'
89.22: 'Enemies won't trick him. Wicked folks can't hurt him.'
89.23: 'I'ma crush his haters and take down anybody comin' for him.'
89.24: 'My mercy and truth gon' walk with him. And I'ma lift him up in My name.'
89.25: 'He'll rule over sea and river—his hands on both.'
89.26: 'He gon' call Me, "Father—my God, my Rock, my salvation."'
89.27: 'I'ma make him My firstborn—top of the top, highest king on earth.'
89.29: 'His line will last. His throne gon' stand like heaven.'
89.30: 'But if his sons wild out—disrespect My law and ignore My ways—'
89.31: 'If they break My rules and skip My commands—'
89.32: 'I'ma check them. I'ma discipline them with the rod and stripes.'
89.33: 'But I still won't cut off My love. I won't cancel My faithfulness.'
89.34: 'I ain't breakin' My promise. I'm not goin' back on what I said.'
89.35: 'I swore by My own holiness—I don't lie to David.'
89.36: 'His line gon' last forever. His throne gon' shine like the sun.'
89.37: 'Locked in like the moon. A faithful witness in the sky.'
89.38: But Lord… You pushed us away. You rejected the one You anointed. You mad.
89.39: You tossed aside the covenant You made. His crown? In the dirt.
89.40: You broke down every wall around him. Left his strongholds in ruins.
89.41: Now everybody passin' by just takin' what they want. He a joke to the neighbors.
89.42: You let his enemies win. Gave them the upper hand.
89.43: You made his sword dull. Didn't even back him in the fight.
89.44: You ended his glory. Threw his throne to the ground.
89.45: You cut his youth short. Covered him in shame.
89.46: How long, Lord? You gon' stay hidden forever? Is Your anger permanent?
89.47: Remember how short life is! You made humans so fragile—was all this just for nothin'?
89.48: Who can escape death? Who can dodge the grave?
89.49: Where's that love You promised, Lord? The one You swore to David in truth?
89.50: Look at how Your servants are gettin' mocked, Lord. I carry that pain in my chest every day.
89.51: Your enemies ain't just mocking us—they clownin' the steps of Your anointed.
89.52: But still—blessed be the Lord forever. Amen and Amen.

90.1: Lord, You been our home—generation after generation.
90.2: Before the mountains showed up, before the earth was even formed—from forever to forever, You still God.
90.3: You send people back to the dirt, sayin', 'Return, y'all just human.'
90.4: To You, a thousand years ain't nothin'—just yesterday gone by. Just a quick night shift.
90.5: You sweep folks away like a flood. Life be like a dream. Like grass that grow in the morning—
90.6: Sproutin' up early, but by sunset? Cut down and withered.
90.7: We feel the weight of Your anger. Your wrath got us shook.
90.8: You see all our mess—stuff we try to hide? It's out in the open in Your light.
90.9: Every day we livin' under Your judgment. We end our years with nothin' but a tired breath.
90.10: We get 70 years—maybe 80 if we strong. But even then, it's struggle and stress. Then it's over—and we gone.
90.11: Who really understands how deep Your anger is? The way we fear You should match the weight of Your wrath.
90.12: So Lord, teach us to count our days—help us get a wise heart.
90.13: Come back, Lord. How long You gon' wait? Show mercy to Your people.
90.14: Let us wake up to Your love early—so we can be glad, not just sometimes, but all our days.
90.15: Balance it out, Lord—give us joy to match the years we been hurtin'.
90.16: Let us see You work again. And let our kids see Your glory shine.
90.17: Put Your beauty on us, Lord. Bless the work of our hands—make it count. Yes, Lord—make it last.

91.1: The one who stays close in God's secret place gon' live under His shadow—safe under the Almighty.
91.2: I'ma say it loud: the Lord is my safe spot, my fortress—my God. I trust Him with it all.
91.3: He gon' save you from traps set by the enemy, and from every deadly disease out there.
91.4: He gon' cover you with His feathers—wrap you up under His wings. His truth gon' be your armor and shield.
91.5: You ain't gotta be scared of things goin' bump in the night—or arrows flyin' in the daytime.
91.6: You ain't gotta fear no disease creepin' in the dark, or destruction showin' up midday, loud and reckless.
91.7: A thousand might fall right next to you—ten thousand on your other side—but it won't touch you.
91.8: You'll see it with your own eyes—the wicked gettin' what's theirs.
91.9: Why? 'Cause you made the Lord your refuge—the Most High your home.
91.10: Ain't no evil comin' for you. No sickness touchin' your spot.
91.11: God got His angels on assignment—keepin' you safe wherever you go.
91.12: They'll hold you up with their hands—so you won't even stub your toe on a rock.
91.13: You'll walk right over lions and cobras—stomp on serpents and beasts like it's nothin'.
91.14: God says, "Because you love Me for real, I'm gon' rescue you. I'll lift you up 'cause you know My name."
91.15: "You'll call Me—I'ma answer. I'll be right there in the struggle. I'll pull you out and lift you up with honor."
91.16: "I'll give you a long life, full of My goodness—and let you see what salvation really looks like."

92.1: It's a beautiful thing to give thanks to the Lord—and to sing praises to You, Most High!
92.2: To wake up talkin' about Your love, and end the night speakin' on Your faithfulness.
92.3: On a ten-string, a smooth lute, and a harp—playin' real harmonious.
92.4: Lord, You got me smilin' off what You done. I'ma shout in victory over the work of Your hands.
92.5: Lord, Your works go crazy! And Your thoughts? Deep, deep.
92.6: Fools don't get it. People with no sense won't even try to understand.
92.7: Yeah, the wicked might pop up fast like weeds. And the evil might be flourishin'—but that's just setup for their downfall. They won't last.
92.8: But You, Lord? You stay high. Forever.
92.9: Your enemies, Lord—they gon' be wiped out. Every one of 'em scattered.
92.10: But me? You lifted my horn like a wild ox—gave me fresh oil, a whole new anointing.
92.11: My eyes already seen the fall of my enemies. My ears heard about them haters goin' down.
92.12: The righteous? They flourish like palm trees. Growin' tall and strong like cedars in Lebanon.
92.13: They planted in God's house—rooted deep. They flourish right there in His courts.
92.14: Even in old age, they still bear fruit. Still fresh. Still vibrant.
92.15: All to say one thing: the Lord is righteous. He my solid rock—and there ain't no wrong in Him.

93.1: The Lord runnin' it all. Dressed in majesty, wrapped in power—He strapped up with strength.
93.2: His throne been standin' since way back. He always been. Ain't no start point to His reign.
93.3: Yeah, the waters been risin', Lord. They loud. They wild. The floods tryna talk big.
93.4: But You? You higher than all that noise. Stronger than ocean waves. Louder than the storm.
93.5: Your Word don't miss. Solid all the way through. Holiness stay in Your house, Lord—forever.

94.1: O Lord, God of vengeance—the one who serves justice—show up and shine!
94.2: Rise up, Judge of the whole earth. Put the proud in they place.
94.3: Lord, how long? How long the wicked gon' keep winnin'? How long they gon' act like they untouchable?
94.4: They talk reckless, real arrogant. All these evil workers just gassin' themselves up.
94.5: They crush Your people, Lord. They do harm to the ones You call Yours.
94.6: They kill widows, mistreat immigrants, and murder orphans with no remorse.
94.7: And they say, 'God ain't lookin'. He don't know what's goin' on.'
94.8: Y'all slow if you believe that. For real—when y'all gon' wise up?
94.9: The one who made ears—you don't think He hears? The one who shaped eyes—you think He can't see?
94.10: The one who teaches nations—you think He won't correct y'all? You think the Creator of knowledge don't know how this works?
94.11: The Lord knows exactly what folks be thinkin'. And He know it's all pointless.
94.12: But blessed is the one You teach, Lord—the one You school through Your Word.
94.13: You give 'em peace in hard times—while You settin' up the downfall of the wicked.
94.14: God ain't abandoning His people. He ain't done with His inheritance.
94.15: Justice gon' come back lined up with righteousness—and all those with right hearts gon' follow behind it.
94.16: Who gon' stand up for me against this evil? Who steppin' to defend me from these wicked folks?
94.17: If the Lord hadn't held me down, I woulda been laid out in silence.
94.18: Every time I slipped and said, 'I'm fallin'!'—Your love caught me, Lord. You held me up.
94.19: When my mind overwhelmed and anxious, Your comfort brought joy to my soul.
94.20: You really think crooked systems—built on injustice—can link up with You, Lord?
94.21: They gang up against the righteous. They frame innocent folks with blood on their hands.
94.22: But the Lord is my defender. My God is the rock where I run to hide.
94.23: He gon' flip their evil back on them. They gon' get cut off in their own wickedness. The Lord our God gon' shut it all down.

95.1: Come on, y'all! Let's sing to the Lord! Let's shout with joy to the One who saves us.
95.2: Let's pull up in His presence with thanksgiving. Let's praise Him loud with psalms.
95.3: 'Cause the Lord is the real MVP—greatest of all. King above every so-called god out here.
95.4: The deepest parts of the earth? In His hands. The mountaintops too—He hold all that.
95.5: The sea? He made that. The dry land? Shaped it with His own hands.
95.6: So come on—let's worship. Let's bow low. Let's kneel before the One who made us.
95.7: He our God. We His people—His sheep. He the Shepherd with us in His hand. Now hear this part real clear:
95.8: Today, if you hear His voice—don't harden your heart. Don't be stubborn like they were in the wilderness.
95.9: They tested Me, even after everything I showed 'em. They saw My work—but still tried Me.
95.10: I was fed up with that whole generation. I said, 'These folks hearts always off track. They still don't get My ways.'
95.11: So I swore in My anger: 'They not entering My rest.'

96.1: Sing a new song to the Lord! Whole earth—yeah, everybody—sing to Him!
96.2: Sing to the Lord, bless His name. Spread the good news—He savin' folks every single day.
96.3: Tell the nations how glorious He is. Brag on His wonders to every people.
96.4: The Lord is great—and worthy of every bit of praise. He should be feared more than any 'god' out there.
96.5: 'Cause them other gods? Just statues. Just idols. But our God? He made the heavens.
96.6: Honor and majesty surround Him. His sanctuary? Full of strength and beauty.
96.7: Y'all families from every nation—give the Lord His glory. Acknowledge His strength.
96.8: Give Him the glory that's due. Bring your offering and come step into His courts.
96.9: Worship the Lord in holy beauty. Whole earth—tremble in His presence!
96.10: Tell the nations loud: 'The Lord reigns!' The world ain't goin' nowhere—He keeps it steady. And He gon' judge everybody right.
96.11: Let the skies rejoice. Let the earth be glad. Let the ocean make some noise and everything in it!
96.12: Let the fields turn up in joy—and every single tree in the woods praise like they know what's up!
96.13: 'Cause He's comin'. Yep—He's on the way to judge the earth. He gon' judge the world in righteousness, and every nation in real-deal truth.

97.1: The Lord reigns! Let the whole earth turn up with joy—let all the islands be glad too!
97.2: Clouds and deep darkness surround Him, but righteousness and justice hold up His throne.
97.3: Fire goes ahead of Him—burnin' up His enemies like it's nothin'.
97.4: Lightning flashin' everywhere—lightin' up the whole world. The earth see it and start shakin'.
97.5: Mountains? They melt like wax in front of the Lord—yeah, the Lord who runs the whole earth.
97.6: The sky testifies to His righteousness—and every nation gon' see His glory.
97.7: Anybody still out here worshippin' statues? Y'all oughta be ashamed. Those idols can't do nothin'. All fake gods—bow down to Him.
97.8: Zion heard that and got hype. Judah's daughters celebratin'—'cause Your judgments, Lord, are righteous and true.
97.9: You, Lord, are high above the earth—lifted way above every so-called god.
97.10: If you really love the Lord, hate what's evil. He got His people's souls protected—and He rescues them from wicked hands.
97.11: Light is planted like seeds for the righteous—and joy for the ones with clean hearts.
97.12: So go 'head and rejoice in the Lord, y'all who live right. Give thanks when you think on His holy name.

98.1: Sing somethin' brand new to the Lord—He done did amazing things! His right hand, His holy strength, got Him the win.
98.2: The Lord showed the world He saves. Everybody saw His righteousness out loud, not hidden.
98.3: He remembered His mercy. He remembered His promises to Israel. And now the whole world done seen our God bring salvation.
98.4: Shout with joy to the Lord, earth! Break out in song—rejoice and sing loud!
98.5: Sing with the harp. Strum it smooth and drop a psalm while you're at it.
98.6: Blow the trumpets! Let the horns go up! Make joyful noise for the King—He's here!
98.7: Let the sea go wild with praise—all the waves and everything in it. Let the whole world lift it up.
98.8: Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the hills throw a joy party together—
98.9: All in front of the Lord, 'cause He comin' to judge the earth. He gon' judge the world right—and treat every people with fairness.

99.1: The Lord reigns. So everybody need to tremble. He sittin' between the cherubim—let the whole earth shake!
99.2: The Lord is mighty in Zion. He lifted high above all the people.
99.3: Let 'em praise Your great and awesome name—'cause He holy.
99.4: The King strong and He love justice. You set things right. You brought real justice and righteousness to Jacob.
99.5: Lift the Lord up high. Worship at His footstool—He holy.
99.6: Moses and Aaron were part of His priests. Samuel was one of the ones who called on His name. They called—and the Lord answered.
99.7: He spoke to 'em out the cloud. They followed what He said—kept His laws and listened close.
99.8: Lord our God, You answered when they called. You were the forgiving God—but You still checked them when they got outta line.
99.9: Exalt the Lord our God. Worship at His holy mountain. 'Cause the Lord our God? He holy.

100.1: Shout loud with joy to the Lord, everybody—everywhere!
100.2: Serve the Lord with gladness. Pull up to His presence singin' like you mean it.
100.3: Know this for sure: the Lord is God. He the one who made us—we ain't make ourselves. We belong to Him. We His people, His sheep, and He our Shepherd.
100.4: Step through His gates with thanks on your lips. Come in His courts with praise. Be grateful—and speak well of His name.
100.5: 'Cause the Lord is good—like, real good. His mercy don't ever run out. And His truth? That's gon' stand through every generation.

101.1: I'ma sing about Your mercy and justice, Lord. I'ma lift up praise straight to You.
101.2: I'ma move with wisdom and keep it clean. Lord, when You comin' through? 'Cause I'ma walk with integrity—startin' right in my own home.
101.3: I ain't puttin' nothin' wicked in front of my eyes. I hate what shady folks do—it ain't stickin' to me.
101.4: Twisted hearts? Not around me. I ain't even entertaining wickedness.
101.5: If you talkin' slick behind folks' backs, I'ma shut that down. If you walkin' around with a proud look and puffed-up heart, I'm not toleratin' you.
101.6: I got my eyes on the faithful—the ones walkin' right. They the ones welcome in my space. They the ones I'ma put to work.
101.7: Liars and schemers? They can't stay in my house. If you fake, you not standin' in front of me.
101.8: Every morning, I'm clearing out the wicked—cutting off all that evil from the Lord's city.

102.1: Lord, hear me when I pray. Let my cry reach You.
102.2: Don't hide from me when I'm in trouble. Lean in close. When I call, please answer quick.
102.3: My days burn up like smoke. My bones feel like they sittin' in a fire pit.
102.4: My heart hurt bad—withered like dead grass. I be forgettin' to eat.
102.5: I'm groanin' so much, I'm shrinkin'. My bones clingin' to my skin.
102.6: I'm out here feelin' like a lonely bird in the wilderness—like an owl in a dried-up land.
102.7: I can't sleep. I'm sittin' up like a sparrow by myself on a rooftop.
102.8: My enemies mock me all day. Folks usin' my name to curse.
102.9: I've eaten ashes like bread. My drink mixed with tears.
102.10: That's all from Your anger, Lord. You lifted me up—then tossed me aside.
102.11: My life stretchin' out like a long shadow. I'm dryin' up like cut grass.
102.12: But You, Lord? You last forever. Your name gon' be known through every generation.
102.13: You gon' get up and show mercy to Zion. The time is here—it's time for favor.
102.14: Even the servants love the rubble. They honor the dust from her streets.
102.15: Nations gon' fear Your name, Lord. Kings gon' see Your glory.
102.16: The Lord gon' rebuild Zion—and show up in glory, no doubt.
102.17: He gon' hear the cries of the broken. He ain't turnin' away from their prayers.
102.18: Write this down for the next generation—so folks who ain't even born yet can praise the Lord.
102.19: God looked down from His high-up place—from heaven He saw what was happenin' on earth.
102.20: He heard the prisoners groanin'. He gon' set the ones bound for death free.
102.21: So His name can be lifted in Zion—and His praise shouted in Jerusalem.
102.22: When all the nations link up—when every kingdom shows up to serve the Lord.
102.23: He drained my strength. Cut my life short.
102.24: I said, 'God, don't take me out in my prime. You eternal—You last from generation to generation.'
102.25: Way back, You laid earth's foundation. The heavens? You built them too.
102.26: They gon' fade. But You gon' last. They wear out like clothes. You'll swap 'em out like a coat. And they'll be gone.
102.27: But You? You don't change. Your years don't run out.
102.28: The children of Your servants gon' keep on. Their descendants gon' be planted solid in front of You.

103.1: Bless the Lord, O my soul—every part of me, bless His holy name!
103.2: Bless the Lord, O my soul—and don't forget none of the ways He came through for you.
103.3: He's the one who forgives all your sins—and heals every disease.
103.4: He snatched your life out the pit. And then crowned you with love and mercy like royalty.
103.5: He fills your life with good things—so your youth feel brand new, like an eagle on the rise.
103.6: The Lord stands up for the oppressed. He brings justice where it's overdue.
103.7: He let Moses know His ways. The whole nation of Israel saw His power.
103.8: The Lord is merciful and gracious. Slow to anger. Heavy on mercy.
103.9: He don't stay mad forever. He ain't in it to punish.
103.10: He didn't treat us how we deserve. He ain't pay us back for all our wrongs.
103.11: His mercy? It's as high as the heavens over those who fear Him.
103.12: And our sins? Gone—as far as east is from west. That's how far He threw 'em off us.
103.13: Just like a father shows love to his kids—that's how the Lord looks out for those who reverence Him.
103.14: He know what we made of. He remember we just dust.
103.15: Humans? We here today, gone tomorrow. Like grass—we bloom and fade quick.
103.16: The wind pass through and we disappear. Ain't even a trace left.
103.17: But the Lord's mercy? Everlasting to everlasting for those who fear Him. His righteousness stay flowin' to their kids' kids.
103.18: To the ones who keep His word. Who actually do what He said.
103.19: The Lord's throne locked in up in heaven—and He runnin' everything, everywhere.
103.20: Bless the Lord, angels—y'all strong, y'all listen, y'all move when He speaks.
103.21: Bless the Lord, heavenly armies—every one of y'all who carry out His will.
103.22: Bless the Lord, all His works, in every place He reigns. Bless the Lord, O my soul!

104.1: Bless the Lord, O my soul! Lord, You somethin' serious—You drippin' in honor and majesty!
104.2: You wrap Yourself in light like a fit, like the whole sky Your outfit—stretchin' out the heavens like curtains in Your crib.
104.3: You lay the beams of Your upstairs room on the waters. The clouds? That's Your ride. You movin' through the wind like it's wings beneath Your feet.
104.4: Your angels be spirits. Your ministers? Straight fire—burnin' with purpose.
104.5: You laid the earth's foundation solid—ain't nobody movin' it. It's stuck forever.
104.6: You covered the earth like it had on a deep-sea coat—waters sittin' up high like mountaintops.
104.7: But when You checked them with Your voice, they dipped quick. Your thunder had 'em runnin' scared.
104.8: They climbed up mountains, dipped in valleys, hittin' the exact spot You designed for them to stop.
104.9: You set a line they can't cross—ain't no flood gonna overrun the earth again.
104.10: You send springs to flow through the valleys—water slidin' between hills like a DJ mixin' smooth.
104.11: All the wild animals drink from it—even the wild donkeys out here stay hydrated.
104.12: Birds sing right by the water, postin' up in the trees like it's choir practice.
104.13: You water the hills from Your upstairs spot—the earth so full, satisfied from what You put out.
104.14: You make grass grow for cattle, plants for us to work and harvest—food straight from the dirt.
104.15: You give us wine to make the heart glad, oil to make our skin glow, and bread to keep us solid.
104.16: Your trees? Full and lively—the cedars in Lebanon? You planted those Yourself.
104.17: Birds build homes in 'em—the stork found her whole vibe up in the fir trees.
104.18: High hills? That's for the wild goats. The cliffs? Rock badgers chillin' up there like it's penthouse living.
104.19: You made the moon to keep track of time—the sun know exactly when to clock out.
104.20: You flip the switch, make it night—and now all the forest creatures clockin' in for the graveyard shift.
104.21: Young lions out here roaring, tryna get their meal—waiting on You to come through.
104.22: Then the sun rise up—they clockin' out, headed back to their dens like night never happened.
104.23: Meanwhile, humans go out to hustle—grindin' till the sun clock out again.
104.24: Lord, Your work is deep and wide. Everything You made got wisdom written all over it. The earth? Full of Your stuff!
104.25: The sea—so big, so wide—it's like a whole other world. Full of life—big, small, everywhere.
104.26: Ships cruising through, Leviathan out there playin' like You made that sea just to be his playground.
104.27: All of 'em waitin' on You—lookin' to You for that meal, right when they need it.
104.28: When You open Your hand, they gather it up. You got them full, satisfied, blessed.
104.29: But when You turn away? They freak out. You take that breath? They done. Back to dust.
104.30: You send out Your Spirit, and boom—they created again. Earth get a full refresh.
104.31: May Your glory stay forever, Lord. May You keep smilin' at Your masterpiece.
104.32: You just look at the earth—it trembles. Touch the hills—they start smokin'.
104.33: I'ma sing to the Lord as long as I got breath. I'ma praise God while I'm still here.
104.34: Let my thoughts be sweet to Him—I'm rejoicing, straight vibin' in the Lord.
104.35: Let sinners disappear off this earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless the Lord, O my soul! Praise the Lord!

105.1: Go 'head and thank the Lord! Call on His name like you know Him—let everybody know what He done did!
105.2: Sing to Him, praise Him for real! Talk about all the wild, wonderful stuff He done pulled off.
105.3: Shine in His holy name! Let everybody who chasin' after the Lord rejoice out loud!
105.4: Seek the Lord and His strength—don't stop, keep looking for His face constantly.
105.5: Don't forget all the incredible things He's done—His miracles, His judgments, His words that hit different.
105.6: Y'all are Abraham's descendants, His servant's bloodline—Jacob's children, the ones He picked out Himself.
105.7: He the Lord our God—His judgments stretch across the whole earth.
105.8: He don't forget His promises. That covenant? Locked in. It's still good after a thousand generations.
105.9: The one He made with Abraham. The same promise He swore to Isaac.
105.10: Then passed it down to Jacob like family tradition. To Israel, it became an unbreakable deal.
105.11: He said, 'This land—Canaan? That's yours. That's your inheritance. Hold on to it.'
105.12: Back when they was just a small crew—real few, and foreign in the land.
105.13: They was wanderin' from nation to nation, passin' through kingdoms like travelers.
105.14: God ain't let nobody mess with 'em. He shut down kings for their sake.
105.15: He told 'em straight: 'Don't touch My anointed ones. Don't bring no harm to My prophets.'
105.16: Then He called a famine on the land—cut off all the bread supply.
105.17: But He already sent somebody ahead—Joseph, sold as a slave, but movin' in purpose.
105.18: They hurt his feet with chains, locked him up in iron.
105.19: But when the time was right, when his word came through, the Lord tested and proved him.
105.20: The king sent for him—set him free. Ruler of the land said, 'Let him go.'
105.21: Joseph got promoted—put in charge of the whole house, all the goods under his authority.
105.22: He had princes followin' orders, elders sittin' down to learn wisdom.
105.23: Then Israel came into Egypt—Jacob posted up in the land of Ham.
105.24: God made His people multiply—stronger than their enemies, no cap.
105.25: But then He flipped Egypt's heart—they started hatin' on His people and plottin' slick moves.
105.26: So He sent Moses, His servant—and Aaron, the one He chose.
105.27: They showed out with signs and wonders in Egypt, miracles all through the land of Ham.
105.28: He spoke darkness into the land—and it got dark, quick. Egypt couldn't even push back.
105.29: He flipped the waters into blood—killed all their fish with it.
105.30: Frogs popped up everywhere—even in the king's bedroom. No peace, nowhere.
105.31: Then came the flies. Then lice all over their land—on sight, just like He said.
105.32: He turned their rain into hail—sent down fire like fireworks across the country.
105.33: Hit their vines and fig trees—broke trees left and right like twigs.
105.34: Then He spoke again—locusts swarmed in. A whole army, no limit.
105.35: They ate every green thing in sight—left the land bare.
105.36: Then God took every firstborn in Egypt—the strongest ones, the pride of the nation.
105.37: But when He brought His people out? They had silver, gold—nobody was limpin'.
105.38: Egypt was relieved when they left—fear of Israel had them shook.
105.39: God gave them a cloud for shade in the day—and fire for light in the night.
105.40: They got hungry? He sent quail. Then fed 'em with heavenly bread till they was full.
105.41: He cracked a rock—and water came pourin' out like a river in the desert.
105.42: All 'cause He remembered His holy promise—the one He gave Abraham, His guy.
105.43: So He brought His people out with joy—His chosen ones dancin' and shoutin'.
105.44: He handed them land from other nations—gave 'em the work others had done.
105.45: Why? So they would live by His laws and stay faithful to His word. Praise the Lord!

106.1: Praise the Lord! Y'all better thank Him—'cause He good, and His mercy? That thang lasts forever.
106.2: Who can even put into words all the powerful stuff the Lord done? Who got enough praise for all He is?
106.3: Blessed are the ones who stay true to justice—who keep doin' right no matter what.
106.4: Lord, remember me when You show favor to Your people. Slide through with Your salvation, too.
106.5: Let me witness the blessings You got for Your chosen ones. Let me be part of the joy, the glory, the whole inheritance.
106.6: We messed up—just like our ancestors. We sinned, we wilded out, we did dirty.
106.7: Back in Egypt, our folks ain't understand Your wonders. They forgot Your mercy—right at the Red Sea, they rebelled.
106.8: But still, He saved 'em—not for them, but to show off His power and keep His name clean.
106.9: He checked the Red Sea—and it backed up. He led them through like they was walkin' through dry wilderness.
106.10: He rescued them from the ones who hated them—snatched them out the enemy's grip.
106.11: Then the sea came back and swallowed their enemies—not one was left standin'.
106.12: After that, they believed. They sang songs. They praised hard.
106.13: But they forgot quick. Didn't wait on God's direction.
106.14: Instead, they got greedy in the wilderness—tested God like He was regular.
106.15: So He gave 'em what they wanted—but their souls came up empty.
106.16: Then they got jealous of Moses—and of Aaron, the one God had set apart.
106.17: The ground said bet—opened up and swallowed Dathan. Abiram and his squad got covered too.
106.18: Fire blazed up in the camp—burned the wicked clean off the map.
106.19: They built a gold calf at Horeb—and bowed down to that molded thing.
106.20: They swapped their glory for a statue of a cow eatin' grass. Tragic.
