106.21: They straight up forgot God—the same One who saved them, the One who wrecked Egypt with wonders.
106.22: The same God who showed out in Ham, and did the impossible by the Red Sea.
106.23: He was ready to wipe them out—if Moses hadn't stepped in, beggin' for mercy.
106.24: They disrespected the land God promised. Didn't believe a word He said.
106.25: Sat in their tents, complainin'. Ignored God's voice completely.
106.26: So God swore they wouldn't make it—said they'd fall in the wilderness.
106.27: Their kids too—scattered 'em all over foreign lands.
106.28: Then they linked up with Baal at Peor—started eatin' food offered to the dead.
106.29: God was heated at their actions—and a deadly plague broke out.
106.30: Phinehas stood up, shut it down—and that act was counted as righteousness for him forever.
106.31: And God counted that as righteousness for Phinehas—set it down in the record, stamped it eternal, passed down through every generation like legacy.
106.32: They even got God mad at Meribah—made Moses suffer for their mess.
106.33: They pushed God so far, Moses snapped and said things he shouldn't've.
106.34: They didn't clear out the enemy nations like God told them to.
106.35: Instead, they mixed in with the nations—and picked up all their bad habits.
106.36: Started worshiping their idols—which ended up trappin' them.
106.37: They even sacrificed their own kids—to demons.
106.38: Innocent blood on their hands. Their sons and daughters gone. They gave 'em up to idols—and now the land was soaked in blood.
106.39: They defiled themselves with their choices—actin' wild and unfaithful.
106.40: So God's anger burned against His own people. He couldn't stand lookin' at 'em.
106.41: He handed them over—to the same folks they tried to be like. Now their enemies had power over them.
106.42: Those enemies kept them down—treated them like nothin'.
106.43: God rescued them again and again—but they kept rebelin', kept fallin' back into sin.
106.44: Yet even then—when they were sufferin'—He saw 'em and heard their cries.
106.45: For their sake, He remembered His promise. His mercy showed up heavy.
106.46: He even made their captors feel sorry for 'em. Had folks show pity when they didn't have to.
106.47: Save us, Lord our God! Bring us back from these foreign lands—so we can thank You, praise You, and shout Your name loud!
106.48: Bless the Lord, God of Israel—from forever to forever! Let the whole people say, 'Amen!' Praise the Lord!

107.1: Give thanks to the Lord, y'all—'cause He good for real. And His mercy? That thang last forever.
107.2: Let the ones He rescued say it loud—folks He brought out from the enemy's grip.
107.3: He gathered His people from everywhere—east, west, north, and south. Ain't nobody too far.
107.4: They was out there lost in the wilderness—no direction, no place to call home.
107.5: Hungry, thirsty, soul barely hangin' on.
107.6: Then they cried out to the Lord in their trouble—and He came through, pulled 'em out.
107.7: He led 'em on the right path—straight to a place they could settle down.
107.8: Oh, if folks would just thank the Lord for how good He is—and all the wild, wonderful things He do for us!
107.9: He fill up the empty soul—satisfy the ones who hungry deep down.
107.10: Some folks were sittin' in straight darkness—in the shadow of death, locked up in pain and chains.
107.11: All 'cause they rebelled against God's word—clowned the Most High like He didn't know better.
107.12: So He humbled them with hard trials—had 'em fallin' with nobody to catch 'em.
107.13: But they cried out to the Lord in their trouble—and He saved 'em again.
107.14: He brought 'em out the darkness, outta death's shadow—and shattered them chains like glass.
107.15: Oh, if folks would just thank the Lord for His goodness—and the crazy love He keeps showin'!
107.16: He done broke down bronze gates—and snapped iron bars in half.
107.17: Some were straight-up fools—did dirt, caught pain because of it.
107.18: They couldn't even look at food—death was knockin' on they door.
107.19: But even then, they cried out in their trouble—and God stepped in, saved 'em.
107.20: He sent out His word—and boom, healing. Pulled 'em outta destruction.
107.21: Oh, that people would thank the Lord for His goodness—and the wonders He keeps doing for us!
107.22: Let 'em offer up thanks like a sacrifice—and shout loud about what He done!
107.23: Some folks on ships, out on deep waters—grindin', handling business.
107.24: They saw the Lord workin'—witnessed His power deep in the sea.
107.25: God spoke—and the storm wind rose up. Waves got to actin' up.
107.26: They was lifted high, then dropped low—souls melting with fear.
107.27: They stumbled like drunk folks—panicked, not knowin' what to do.
107.28: Then they cried out to the Lord in the storm—and He brought peace.
107.29: He hushed the storm—waves calmed, still like glass.
107.30: They breathed easy, finally. And He led 'em right to the safe spot they was praying for.
107.31: Oh, if folks would just thank the Lord for His goodness—and His dope, miraculous works!
107.32: Praise Him in front of everybody—in the crowd, with the elders, lift Him up.
107.33: He can flip rivers into deserts—dry up springs when folks act wild.
107.34: He'll turn a lush land dry—if the people livin' there wicked.
107.35: But He can also flip it—make a dry place into pools of water.
107.36: He'll plant the hungry there—let 'em build a city, settle down.
107.37: They'll grow crops, plant vineyards—and harvest blessings.
107.38: He'll bless 'em till they overflow—and their livestock won't be lackin' either.
107.39: But if they get pressed—oppression, pain, sorrow—He'll let 'em feel that low.
107.40: He'll expose corrupt leaders—leave 'em lost, wandering with no direction.
107.41: But He'll lift the poor up high—keep 'em safe, bless they families heavy.
107.42: The righteous gon' see it and rejoice. All wicked mouths? Shut.
107.43: If you wise, you'll peep this—and you'll understand the Lord's real love ain't never runnin' out.

108.1: God, my heart locked in—I'm steady. I'm gon' sing, I'm gon' praise You, and I'ma give You all I got.
108.2: Wake up, strings and beats! I'm up before the sun, ready to set the tone.
108.3: I'ma praise You, Lord, in front of everybody—all over the nations, I'ma lift You up.
108.4: Your mercy? Way above the skies. Your truth? It touch the clouds.
108.5: Be lifted high, God, above the heavens. Let Your glory stretch across the whole earth.
108.6: Come through for Your people—the ones You love. Save us with that strong right hand and hear our cry.
108.7: God done spoke from His holy place. He said: 'I'm celebratin'—splittin' up Shechem, measuring out Succoth.'
108.8: Gilead? Mine. Manasseh? Mine. Ephraim? My headgear. Judah? My law, my rule, my scepter.
108.9: Moab? That's My washbasin. Edom? I'll toss My shoe there. Philistia? I'm 'bout to shout over you in victory.
108.10: But who gon' get me inside the strong city? Who leading me into Edom?
108.11: Ain't it You, God, who turned from us? Ain't it You who ain't ride out with our troops?
108.12: Lord, we need help—'cause human help? That ain't it.
108.13: But with God? Oh, we movin' bold. He the one stomping down every last one of our enemies.

109.1: Don't be quiet, God—the One I praise. I need You to speak up!
109.2: These wicked folks out here runnin' they mouth—lying on me heavy.
109.3: They got hate in they hearts and surroundin' me with it. Tryna fight me for no reason.
109.4: I showed 'em love, and they turned around and accused me. But me? I stay prayed up.
109.5: They gave me evil for good, hate for my love.
109.6: So go 'head, Lord—put somebody wicked over him. Let an enemy sit at his right hand.
109.7: When he go to court, let him be found guilty. And even his prayer? Let that count as sin.
109.8: Let his time be cut short—somebody else can have his spot.
109.9: Let his kids grow up without a father. Let his wife become a widow.
109.10: Let his children wander, beg, and hustle for scraps in broken-down places.
109.11: Let the loan sharks come for everything he got. Let strangers eat off all his hard work.
109.12: Don't let nobody show him mercy. And don't let anybody help his kids, either.
109.13: Let his whole bloodline be cut off—erase the family name in the next generation.
109.14: Don't forget the sins of his father. And don't clear his mama's name either.
109.15: Keep them sins in front of You, Lord—wipe their memory off the face of the earth.
109.16: Why? 'Cause he ain't show no mercy. He came after the poor, the brokenhearted—tried to kill off the ones already hurting.
109.17: He loved to curse? Then let curses stick to him. He didn't want blessings? Then keep 'em far from him.
109.18: He wore cursing like a jacket—so let it seep into his bones, flow in his body like oil.
109.19: Let that curse wrap around him like a cloak. Let it grip him tight like a belt he can't take off.
109.20: That's the payback from You, Lord—for the ones who came for me. The ones who dragged my name through the dirt.
109.21: But You, Lord God—do right by me, for Your name's sake. Your mercy real—so pull me out.
109.22: I'm poor and needy, Lord. My heart feel like it's been stabbed.
109.23: I'm fading away like a shadow at sunset—barely hangin' on. Tossed out like a dead locust.
109.24: My knees weak from fasting. Ain't no fat on my bones—I'm wasting away.
109.25: Now I'm a joke to them. They look at me and just shake they heads.
109.26: Help me, Lord my God! Save me by Your mercy.
109.27: Let 'em know You the One who did it—this wasn't luck, it was You.
109.28: Let them talk crazy if they want—but You bless. When they show up, let shame hit 'em. But let me, Your servant, rejoice.
109.29: Let my enemies wear shame like clothes. Let disgrace wrap 'em up like a coat.
109.30: I'ma praise You loud, Lord. Right in front of the crowd, I'ma lift You up.
109.31: 'Cause You stand up for the broke and lowly—You rescue the ones the world tried to condemn.

110.1: The Lord said to my Lord: 'Come sit next to Me, at My right hand—'til I make Your enemies Your footrest.'
110.2: The Lord gon' send Your power straight outta Zion. Rule even while You surrounded by enemies—flex on 'em.
110.3: Your people? They gon' show up willing, ready to ride in the day You show power—shinin' in holiness like the morning dew, young and fresh.

110.5: The Lord right there at Your side—He gon' handle kings when His wrath hit.
110.6: He'll bring judgment across nations—bodies gon' drop, leaders gon' fall. He takin' out the top dogs.
110.7: He gon' stop, drink from the brook on the way—then lift His head high, still standin', still movin', still King.

111.1: Praise the Lord! I'ma give God my whole heart—right there in the crew of the righteous, in the middle of the people.
111.2: Everything the Lord do? It's major. Folks who know what's good stay studyin' His moves.
111.3: His work shine with honor and glory—and His righteousness? That don't ever fade.
111.4: He made His wonders unforgettable. The Lord stay gracious, overflowing with compassion.
111.5: He feeds the ones who fear Him—and He always remembers the promises He made.
111.6: He showed His people real power—handin' them land that used to belong to the nations.
111.7: Everything His hands do is truth and justice. Every law He gave? Solid.
111.8: His words ain't shaky—they stand forever. Built with truth and integrity.
111.9: He sent redemption to His people—sealed His promise for all time. His name? Holy. And powerful.
111.10: The fear of the Lord? That's where wisdom starts. Real understanding belongs to the ones who actually live by His word. And His praise? That's eternal.

112.1: Praise the Lord! Blessed is the one who got that holy fear for the Lord—and gets hype about His Word.
112.2: His kids gon' be strong out here—mighty on the earth. The whole fam stayin' blessed.
112.3: Wealth and abundance live in his house—and his righteousness? That don't expire.
112.4: Even when life get dark, light gon' shine on the upright—'cause he full of grace, compassion, and keeps it righteous.
112.5: A good man moves generous—he gives and helps, but he also handles his business with wisdom.
112.6: He solid. Won't be shaken. The righteous get remembered forever.
112.7: Bad news don't scare him—his heart steady, fully trustin' the Lord.
112.8: He ain't shook—his heart grounded. He gon' watch his enemies fall while he stay standing.
112.9: He spreads blessings everywhere—gives to the poor. His righteousness still goin', and his influence gon' rise with honor.
112.10: The wicked gon' see all this and be sick about it. They'll grind their teeth, but it won't matter—'cause their plans? Dead on arrival.

113.1: Praise the Lord! All y'all who serve Him—lift up His name and give Him what He due!
113.2: Let the Lord's name be blessed—starting now, and forever after that.
113.3: From sun-up to sundown—His name deserve nonstop praise.
113.4: The Lord sit high—above every nation. His glory? Past the skies.
113.5: Who else like our God? Ain't nobody up there with Him—He in a league of His own.
113.6: Yet He still stoops low—just to see what's goin' on in heaven and on earth.
113.7: He lift the poor up from the dirt—pulls the struggling up out the ash heap.
113.8: And He don't just lift 'em—He seat 'em with royalty. With the big dogs of His people.
113.9: He give the woman with no kids a home—make her a joyful mama, laughin' with her babies. Praise the Lord!

114.1: When Israel dipped outta Egypt—when Jacob's fam left a land that ain't even speak their language…
114.2: Judah became God's sanctuary spot—and Israel? That was His kingdom.
114.3: The sea saw them comin' and ran. The Jordan River? Turned back like, 'Nope!'
114.4: The mountains started skippin' like rams—hills dancin' like baby lambs.
114.5: What's up with you, sea—why you runnin'? Jordan, why you moonwalkin' backwards?
114.6: Mountains, what had y'all jumpin'? Hills, why y'all actin' like baby goats?
114.7: Whole earth, you better tremble—'cause the God of Jacob just showed up!
114.8: He turned a rock into a pool of water. Got water gushin' from stone like it was nothin'.

115.1: This ain't about us, Lord. Not about our name—but Yours. Get all the glory 'cause of Your mercy and Your truth.
115.2: Why the nations out here askin', 'Where y'all God at?'
115.3: Our God sittin' high in heaven—and He do whatever He want.
115.4: Their idols? Just silver and gold—man-made trinkets, not divine.
115.5: They got mouths, but they can't talk. Got eyes, but can't see nothin'.
115.6: Ears, but can't hear. Noses, but can't smell.
115.7: They got hands but don't do nothin'. Feet, but don't walk. Not even a whisper from their throat.
115.8: The folks who make idols? Just like 'em—lifeless. Same for anybody who trust in 'em.
115.9: Israel, trust the Lord. He your help. He your shield.
115.10: House of Aaron, trust the Lord. He your help. He your shield.
115.11: Everybody who fear the Lord—trust Him. He your help and your shield.
115.12: The Lord been thinkin' about us—He gon' bless us. Bless Israel. Bless Aaron's crew.
115.13: He bless everybody who fear Him—whether they got clout or not.
115.14: May the Lord increase y'all more and more—you and your kids too.
115.15: You blessed by the One who made heaven and earth. Period.
115.16: Heaven belong to the Lord—but He gave the earth to us, the children of men.
115.17: The dead can't praise the Lord—folks in the grave ain't got no more voice.
115.18: But we? We gon' bless the Lord—right now and forever. Praise the Lord!

116.1: I love the Lord—'cause He heard me. He heard my cries, my prayers, my whole situation.
116.2: He leaned in to listen—so I'ma keep callin' on Him for the rest of my life.
116.3: I was surrounded by death, feelin' it creep in. Trouble had me boxed in. Sorrow had me stuck.
116.4: Then I called out to the Lord's name: 'Lord, I'm beggin'—save me!'
116.5: The Lord is full of grace. He right. And He merciful, too.
116.6: He looks out for the simple, the overlooked. I was down bad—and He lifted me.
116.7: Chill, my soul. Rest easy—'cause the Lord been good to you.
116.8: You saved my life from death, Lord—You wiped my tears and kept me from fallin' flat.
116.9: So now I'ma walk this life out with You—in the land of the living, still breathin', still movin'.
116.10: I believed You, even when I said, 'I'm hurt real bad.'
116.11: I was overwhelmed and said, 'Everybody fake.' I was speakin' outta pain.
116.12: So what can I give You, Lord, for all You done for me?
116.13: I'ma lift up this cup of salvation—and I'ma call on Your name again.
116.14: I'ma keep my promises to You, Lord—right here in front of everybody.
116.15: The death of Your people? That's precious to You. You don't take our lives lightly.
116.16: Lord, I'm Yours—been Yours. I'm Your servant, born from a praying woman. You broke my chains.
116.17: So I'ma bring You an offering of thanks—and I'ma keep callin' on Your name.
116.18: I'ma fulfill every vow I made—right in front of Your people.
116.19: In the Lord's house, in the middle of Jerusalem—I'm gon' give You praise. Praise the Lord!

117.1: Y'all—every nation, every tribe, every crew—praise the Lord!
117.2: Why? 'Cause His love for us? Too big. His mercy? Overflowin'. And His truth? It don't ever change. It don't ever quit. Praise the Lord!

118.1: Go 'head and thank the Lord—'cause He real good. His mercy? That thang don't ever run out.
118.2: Let Israel say it loud: His mercy endures forever!
118.3: Let the house of Aaron say it too: His mercy endures forever!
118.4: Everybody who fear the Lord—go 'head and say it: His mercy endures forever!
118.5: I was stressed and pressed—I called out to the Lord. He answered me and gave me room to breathe.
118.6: The Lord is ridin' with me. I ain't scared. What can man do to me?
118.7: He with me even in the crew—my helpers got heaven on their side. I'ma watch my enemies fall back.
118.8: It's better to trust the Lord than to put your hope in people.
118.9: Better to lean on God than to count on leaders.
118.10: Every nation had me surrounded—but I called on the name of the Lord, and I took 'em down.
118.11: They had me boxed in, for real—but in God's name? I stood tall.
118.12: They swarmed me like bees—but got put out like a fire made of thorns. The name of the Lord had power.
118.13: You tried to push me down hard—but the Lord grabbed me up.
118.14: The Lord is my strength, my theme song—and He showed up as my Savior.
118.15: You can hear the praise from the tents of the righteous. That right hand of the Lord? It don't play.
118.16: The Lord's right hand is lifted up. The Lord's right hand? Mighty.
118.17: I ain't gon' die—I'm gon' live. And I'ma tell the story of what the Lord did.
118.18: Yeah, He checked me. It got rough. But He ain't let me die.
118.19: Open the gates of righteousness—I'm walkin' through with praise on my lips.
118.20: This right here? This the Lord's gate—the righteous get to walk through it.

118.22: The stone they threw away? That one became the cornerstone.
118.23: That was God's move—and it's blowin' our minds.
118.24: This the day the Lord made—we gon' rejoice and act like it.
118.25: Lord, save us right now! Lord, bless us big time!
118.26: Blessed is the one comin' in the name of the Lord—we see you, and we speak blessings from God's house.
118.27: God is the Lord—and He lit it up! Tie the sacrifice down, take it to the altar. Give Him everything.
118.28: You my God, and I'ma praise You. You my God—I'ma lift You up.
118.29: Give thanks to the Lord, y'all—'cause He's good. His mercy endures forever!

119.1: Blessed are the ones walkin' right—livin' by the Lord's law without switchin' up.
119.2: Blessed are those who hold tight to His word—chasin' after Him with all they got.
119.3: They don't play around with sin—they stay walkin' in His way.
119.4: You told us to stick to Your precepts—with focus and diligence.

119.6: Then I wouldn't feel no shame—when I check myself by what You said.
119.7: I'ma praise You with a clean heart—once I learn what's really right in Your eyes.

119.13: I speak Your truth with my mouth—all the judgments You declared.
119.14: I celebrate Your word like it's a treasure—worth more than money.
119.15: I sit and reflect on Your precepts—I keep Your ways on my mind.
119.16: I find joy in what You said—I won't forget Your Word.
119.17: Bless me, Lord—so I can live and stick to Your Word.
119.18: Open my eyes—so I can see the wild beauty in Your law.
119.19: I'm just passin' through this earth—don't hide Your commandments from me.
119.20: My soul be achin'—cravin' Your truth day and night.
119.21: You check the proud—the ones who stray from Your path.
119.22: Take away the shame and disrespect from me—'cause I been holdin' tight to Your truth.
119.23: Even when leaders gossip and plot—I stay locked in on Your statutes.
119.24: Your testimonies? That's my joy—and my go-to wisdom.
119.25: I feel low—dust level. Breathe life back into me through Your Word.
119.26: I told You everything—and You came through. Now keep teachin' me.
119.27: Show me how Your precepts work—so I can sit in awe of what You've done.
119.28: I'm heavy. Soul real low. Strengthen me with Your Word.
119.29: Keep me from walkin' in lies—and drop Your truth on me with grace.
119.30: I picked the road of truth—I laid Your words out like a map.
119.31: I'm holdin' on to Your promises—don't let me get embarrassed, Lord.
119.32: I'ma run this race by Your rules—'cause You're stretchin' my heart to fit more of You.
119.33: Lord, teach me Your ways—and I'll keep 'em all the way to the end.
119.34: Give me understanding—and I'll follow You fully, with my whole heart.
119.35: Guide my steps to Your commands—'cause that's where my joy come from.
119.36: Turn my heart toward what You say—not toward greed or wantin' what ain't mine.
119.37: Redirect my eyes—don't let me chase worthless stuff. Revive me in Your lane.
119.38: Let Your Word hit different for me—'cause I respect You deep.
119.39: Take away the shame I'm scared of—'cause what You say is good.
119.40: I'm out here thirstin' for Your truth—revive me with Your righteousness.
119.41: Lord, let Your mercy reach me—let Your salvation come through, just like You said.
119.42: Then I'll have somethin' to say when they come for me—'cause I trust Your word.
119.43: Don't take the truth out my mouth—'cause I'm holdin' on to hope in Your laws.
119.44: I'ma keep Your Word on repeat—forever and always.
119.45: I walk free—'cause I stay seekin' Your word like it's life.
119.46: I speak on Your truth in front of kings—and I ain't never ashamed.
119.47: I take joy in Your commands—'cause I love what You say.
119.48: I lift my hands to Your commandments—'cause I love them. I stay meditating on Your words.
119.49: Lord, don't forget the word You gave me—'cause it's what keeps my hope alive.
119.50: That same word comforts me when I'm down—You used it to breathe life back into me.
119.51: The arrogant stay clownin' me—but I never stray from what You told me.
119.52: I remember how You judged things back in the day—and that memory gave me peace.
119.53: I get heated when I see wicked folks throw away Your law like it's nothin'.
119.54: Your word been my song—even while I been journeyin' through rough places.
119.55: I call Your name in the midnight hour, Lord—and I stay obedient.
119.56: This walk? It's mine now—'cause I chose to live by Your word.
119.57: Lord, You are my portion. I said it out loud—I'ma keep Your words.
119.58: I came to You with my whole heart—please be gracious like You promised.
119.59: I checked myself, real talk—and I turned my steps back toward You.
119.60: I didn't wait—I moved quick to obey Your word.
119.61: Even when the wicked had me trapped—I ain't forget what You said.
119.62: At midnight I get up just to thank You—'cause You always judge right.
119.63: I roll with the ones who fear You—the ones who stay walkin' in Your word.
119.64: The whole earth full of Your mercy—Lord, teach me more of what You got to say.
119.65: You been good to me, Lord—just like You said You would.
119.66: Teach me how to move with wisdom and good sense—'cause I believe in what You said.
119.67: Before the struggle, I was slippin'—but now I stay in Your word.
119.68: You are good—and everything You do good. So teach me Your ways.
119.69: Proud folks made up lies about me—but I stick to Your word with my whole heart.
119.70: They hearts fat and numb—but I find joy in Your law.
119.71: That affliction? It helped me—made me lean into Your truth deeper.
119.72: Your word worth more to me than stacks of gold and silver.
119.73: You made me, Lord—shaped me with Your hands. Now give me understanding so I can live by what You say.
119.74: The ones who fear You gon' smile when they see me—'cause they know I been holdin' on to Your word.
119.75: I know You judge right, Lord. And when You checked me—it was outta faithfulness.
119.76: So let Your mercy be my comfort—like You promised.
119.77: Send that tender love my way—so I can live. Your law brings me joy.
119.78: Let the arrogant be ashamed—they lied on me. But I'll be over here, focused on Your word.
119.79: Let Your people—those who fear You—come connect with me, 'cause I know Your truth.
119.80: Keep my heart right with Your law—so I won't end up lookin' foolish.
119.81: My soul tired, Lord—I'm waitin' on Your rescue. Still got my hope in Your word.
119.82: My eyes hurt from searchin' Your word—askin', 'Lord, when You gon' come through?'
119.83: I feel like a dried-up wineskin in smoke—but I ain't forget what You said.
119.84: How long I gotta suffer, Lord? When You gon' deal with the ones hurtin' me?
119.85: The proud set traps for me—but they ain't playin' by Your rules.
119.86: Every command You gave is real—I'm bein' attacked for nothin'. Help me, please!
119.87: They almost ended me, Lord—but I never turned my back on Your word.
119.88: Revive me with Your love—so I can keep testifyin' about what You said.
119.89: Lord, Your Word? It's locked in. Set in heaven. Can't be moved.
119.90: You stay faithful—every generation got receipts. You made the earth, and it's still standin'.
119.91: Everything still movin' by what You said—'cause they all follow Your command.
119.92: If I ain't find joy in Your law, I would've been buried in my pain.
119.93: I ain't never forgetting what You said—Your Word gave me life.
119.94: I'm Yours, Lord. Save me. I been out here searching for Your Word.
119.95: Wicked folks waitin' to take me out—but I stay meditatin' on what You said.
119.96: I've seen perfection tap out—but Your Word? It's wide. Limitless.
119.97: Man, I love Your law. I stay thinkin' on it all day.
119.98: You made me smarter than my enemies—with Your Word always in my corner.
119.99: I got more insight than my teachers—'cause I stay meditatin' on Your truth.
119.100: I understand more than the elders—'cause I actually live what You teach.
119.101: I've pulled my steps back from wickedness—so I can hold tight to Your Word.
119.102: I ain't walkin' away from what You judge right—'cause You the one who taught me.
119.103: Your Word tastes sweeter than honey—got my mouth watering for truth.
119.104: Your precepts teach me discernment—that's why I stay away from every fake path.
119.105: Your Word is like a flashlight to my feet—shining on my path in the dark.
119.106: I made a promise—and I'm stickin' to it. I'ma keep Your ways.
119.107: I've been through it, Lord. Heavy affliction. Breathe new life into me through Your Word.
119.108: Please accept these words from my mouth, Lord—and teach me more of what's right.
119.109: My life stay hangin' in the balance—but I still ain't lettin' go of Your Word.
119.110: Wicked folks tryin' to trap me—but I won't step off Your path.
119.111: Your truth is my inheritance—it's what keeps my heart full of joy.
119.112: I've made it my mission to live by Your Word—forever, no matter what.
119.113: I can't stand folks who fake both sides—but Your Word? I love it.
119.114: You my safe space and my shield—I put my hope in what You said.
119.115: Back up, evil folks—I'm stickin' with my God's commandments.
119.116: Hold me up by Your Word—don't let me be out here lookin' foolish for trustin' You.
119.117: Keep me steady, Lord—I'll be safe, and I'll keep walkin' in Your truth.
119.118: You toss out the fake ones—'cause they built on lies.
119.119: You sweep the wicked off like trash—and that's why I treasure Your Word.
119.120: I tremble at You, Lord. My whole body feel it. I stand in awe of how You judge.
119.121: I've been livin' right, Lord. I did what's fair—don't leave me hangin' with my enemies.
119.122: Stand up for me. Vouch for me. Don't let prideful folks crush me.
119.123: My eyes tired from lookin' for You to come through—still waitin' on that righteous word.
119.124: Treat me with mercy, Lord—like You do for all Your people. And teach me Your truth.
119.125: I'm Your servant. Give me understanding—so I can really know what You're sayin'.
119.126: It's time for You to step in, Lord—'cause they out here wildin' like Your law don't matter.
119.127: That's why I love Your commandments—more than gold, more than even the finest gold.
119.128: Everything You say is right—that's why I hate every fake and twisted way.
119.129: Your testimonies? Straight up wonderful—that's why I keep 'em close.
119.130: Your Word shines light when it shows up—it gives wisdom to folks who keep it simple.
119.131: I open my mouth wide—I'm thirsty for Your Word.
119.132: Look at me with mercy, Lord—like You always do for those who love Your name.
119.133: Order my steps by Your Word—don't let sin get the upper hand.
119.134: Pull me out from under the weight of people's mess—so I can keep walkin' in what You said.
119.135: Shine Your face on me, Lord—and keep teachin' me how to move right.
119.136: Tears roll down like rivers—'cause folks out here really don't care about Your law.
119.137: You righteous, Lord—and everything You judge is straight and just.
119.138: Your words? Faithful. Righteous. You meant what You said.
119.139: I'm fired up inside—'cause my enemies forgot all about Your truth.
119.140: Your Word is pure—clean through. That's why I love it so deep.
119.141: I might be small and looked over—but I ain't forget what You said.
119.142: Your righteousness don't expire—and Your law? It's the real truth.
119.143: I'm pressed on all sides—but Your commandments still bring me joy.
119.144: Your word is forever solid—give me understanding, and I'ma live.
119.145: I'm cryin' out with everything in me—hear me, Lord! I'ma keep Your Word.
119.146: I'm callin' You now—rescue me. I promise I'll live by Your truth.
119.147: I'm up before sunrise—still callin', still hopin' in Your Word.
119.148: I'm up all night—can't sleep. Meditatin' on Your Word 'til my eyes burn.
119.149: Hear me through Your love, Lord—revive me by the justice You walk in.
119.150: The wicked stay close, plot heavy—but they far from Your Word.
119.151: But You, Lord—you right here. Every single thing You said? True.
119.152: I've known from way back—Your truth been solid since the beginning.
119.153: See what I'm goin' through, Lord—and pull me out. I ain't forget Your Word.
119.154: Fight for me, redeem me. Revive me like You said You would.
119.155: Salvation don't reach the wicked—they not even lookin' for You.
119.156: Your mercy runs deep, Lord—revive me with those same righteous ways.
119.157: I got enemies comin' from everywhere—but I still won't turn from Your truth.
119.158: I look at the fake ones—and it breaks me. They don't care about what You said.
119.159: You see how much I love Your law—revive me, Lord, with that same lovingkindness.
119.160: Your whole Word? Truth, front to back. Every one of Your judgments lasts forever.
119.161: Powerful folks come after me for no reason—but my heart still stands in awe of Your Word.
119.162: I rejoice in Your truth—like I just found hidden treasure.
119.163: I can't stand lies—but Your Word? I love that with my whole chest.
119.164: Seven times a day I give You praise—'cause Your judgments stay righteous.
119.165: Great peace belongs to the ones who love Your law—ain't nothin' trippin' them up.
119.166: Lord, I'm holdin' out hope for Your salvation—and I'm walkin' in Your commandments.
119.167: My soul guards Your Word—I love it deep.
119.168: I keep what You said, all of it—'cause I know You see everything I do.
119.169: Lord, hear my cry—give me understanding through Your Word.
119.170: Let my prayers rise to You—come through like You promised.
119.171: My mouth gon' praise You—'cause You taught me how to live right.
119.172: My tongue gon' speak Your Word—'cause everything You command is righteous.
119.173: Let Your hand pull me through—I chose Your Word over everything.
119.174: I'm longin' for Your salvation, Lord—and Your law still got me smilin'.
119.175: Let my soul live so I can praise You—and let Your Word guide me.
119.176: I done wandered like a lost sheep—Lord, come find me. I ain't forget what You said.

120.1: When I was stressed and pressed, I cried out to the Lord—and He heard me.
120.2: Lord, get me outta this mess—save me from folks with slick mouths and lying tongues.
120.3: You got a lying tongue? What you think gon' happen to you? What you got comin'?
120.4: Sharp arrows from a real one—plus fire straight from the broom tree. That's what's comin'.
120.5: Man, I'm tired. Stuck out here in Meshech, livin' in tents with folks who don't even want peace.
120.6: My soul been sittin' too long in the middle of folks that thrive on hate.
120.7: I'm out here speakin' peace—but every time I talk, they wanna fight.

121.1: I look up to the hills—where my help at?
121.2: My help come from the Lord—the One who made heaven and earth from scratch.
121.3: He ain't gon' let you slip—He holdin' you down, and He don't get tired.
121.4: Look, the One who watches over Israel? He don't doze off. Don't even blink.
121.5: The Lord is your keeper—your shade, standin' right by your side.
121.6: The sun ain't gon' burn you up in the daytime, and the moon won't mess with you at night.
121.7: The Lord gon' protect you from all evil—He got your soul on lock.
121.8: Wherever you go—when you step out, when you come back—He coverin' you. From now on, and forever.

122.1: Man, I was glad—like real glad—when they said, 'Let's go to the Lord's house.'
122.2: Now look—we finally made it. Our feet standin' in the gates of Jerusalem.
122.3: Jerusalem? That city built tight—everything connected, everything flowin' together.
122.4: That's where the tribes pull up—all the Lord's people—comin' to give thanks, like our testimony says.
122.5: That's where the thrones are set—the place where judgment happens. That's the house of David's legacy.
122.6: Y'all, pray for peace in Jerusalem—pray that the ones who love her stay prosperin'.
122.7: Let peace fill her walls. Let prosperity rest inside her palaces.
122.8: For my fam and my people? I'm speakin' peace over you right now.
122.9: And for the sake of God's house? I'ma seek your good every time.

123.1: I lift my eyes up to You—yeah, You who sit high in heaven.
123.2: Just like a servant watches their master's hand… like a maid waits on her lady's signal… that's how we keep our eyes locked on You, Lord—'til You show us some mercy.
123.3: Lord, please—have mercy on us. We full up with contempt out here.
123.4: Our souls? Overloaded. Tired of the smirks from the comfortable… fed up with the shade from the proud.

124.1: If the Lord hadn't been on our side—c'mon now, Israel, say it loud…
124.2: If the Lord hadn't been ridin' for us when folks came for our necks…
124.3: They would've swallowed us alive—anger burnin', ready to destroy.
124.4: We would've got washed—drowned in the flood of it all.
124.5: Those wild waters? Would've dragged our whole soul under.
124.6: But bless the Lord—He ain't let us get snatched up like prey.
124.7: We got out like a bird breakin' out the trap—the snare snapped, and we free now.
124.8: Our help? It's in the name of the Lord—the same One who made heaven and earth.

125.1: The ones who trust in the Lord? They like Mount Zion—can't be moved, standing forever.
125.2: Just like the mountains wrap around Jerusalem? That's how the Lord surrounds His people—now and forever.
125.3: Wickedness ain't gon' sit on the righteous' land too long—'cause if it do, even the good might get tempted to do wrong.
125.4: Do right by the ones who do right, Lord—the ones who keep their hearts upright.
125.5: But the ones out here swervin' into crooked paths? Let 'em walk with the wicked. Peace be on Israel.

126.1: When the Lord brought Zion back from captivity—it felt like a dream, for real.
126.2: Our mouths were full of laughter, and our tongues? Singin' non-stop. Even the nations said, 'The Lord done big things for them.'
126.3: The Lord really did come through for us—and we can't help but be glad.
126.4: Do it again, Lord—bring restoration like streams flowin' through the dry South.
126.5: The ones who plant with tears? They gon' harvest with joy.
126.6: That one walkin' out weepin', carryin' seed in hand—he comin' back shoutin', arms full of blessings.

127.1: If the Lord ain't building the house, then the builders wastin' their time. If He ain't guardin' the city, the night shift ain't savin' nobody.
127.2: You gettin' up early, stayin' up late, stress-eatin' your worries—but the Lord give His people rest, even while they sleep.
127.3: Listen—kids? They a gift from the Lord. Every child born is a blessing.
127.4: They like arrows in a warrior's hand—powerful when you raise 'em right, especially from your youth.
127.5: A man with a full house of kids? He blessed. He won't be embarrassed—'cause his legacy gon' stand firm, even when folks try to press him at the gate.

128.1: Everybody who fears the Lord and walks in His ways? They already blessed.
128.2: When you eat from the work of your own hands, you gon' be happy—and it's all gon' be good.
128.3: Your wife? She gon' be like a fruitful vine, growin' strong right in the center of your home. And your kids? Like olive plants—healthy, growin', sittin' all around the table.
128.4: Yeah, that's what blessing look like—for the one who fears the Lord.
128.5: May the Lord bless you straight outta Zion—and may you see good days in your city, all your life long.
128.6: And may you live long enough to see your kids' kids. Peace be on Israel.

129.1: They been afflictin' me since I was young—go 'head, Israel, say it with your chest—
129.2: Yeah, they been comin' for us since back in the day. But guess what? They still ain't beat us.
129.3: They tried to break me—like plowin' lines across my back. Left deep marks like trenches.
129.4: But the Lord? He righteous. He came through and cut the ropes the wicked tried to hold me with.
129.5: Let everybody who hates Zion get embarrassed—turned back the way they came.
129.6: Let 'em be like dry rooftop grass—withered before it even grows.
129.7: Ain't enough there for a reaper to grab—or for anyone to bundle up.
129.8: And when folks pass by? Don't let 'em say, 'Blessings on y'all.' Don't let 'em fake bless in the Lord's name.

130.1: Out the deepest part of my soul, I cried to You, Lord.
130.2: Lord, please hear my voice—lean in close and catch every word I'm beggin'.
130.3: If You kept track of all our wrongs… Lord, who could even stand?
130.4: But You? You forgive—and that's why we fear You with reverence.
130.5: I'm waitin' on You, Lord—my soul's waitin'. And I'm holdin' tight to Your Word.
130.6: My soul waitin' on You like night guards watchin' for the sunrise—yeah, even more than that.
130.7: Israel, keep your hope in the Lord—'cause mercy stay with Him. And redemption? He got more than enough.
130.8: He gon' come through for Israel—wipe away every sin, clean and complete.

131.1: Lord, I ain't walkin' around all proud—my heart ain't arrogant, and my eyes ain't lookin' down on nobody. I'm not out here stressin' about stuff too big or too deep for me.
131.2: Nah—I done quieted my soul. Calmed it down like a weaned child leanin' on their mama. That's how my soul is with You.
131.3: Israel, put your hope in the Lord—from right now to forever.

132.1: Lord, remember David—remember all the pain he went through.
132.2: How he made a vow to You, the Mighty One of Jacob—
132.3: 'I ain't goin' in my house, I'm not layin' in my bed…
132.4: 'I won't even let my eyes close or rest hit my body…
132.5: 'Til I find a place for the Lord—a spot for the Mighty One of Jacob to dwell.'
132.6: We heard about it back in Ephrathah—then found it out in the woods.
132.7: Let's go to His tabernacle—bow low at His footstool.
132.8: Lord, rise up and rest right here—you and that ark that carries Your strength.
132.9: Let Your priests wear righteousness like a robe—and let Your people shout with joy.
132.10: For the sake of David, Your servant—don't turn away from Your chosen one.
132.11: The Lord made a solid promise to David—He not changin' His mind: 'One of your sons gon' sit on your throne.'
132.12: 'If your sons keep My covenant and walk in what I teach—they sons gon' sit on that throne too. Forever.'
132.13: The Lord picked Zion—He said, 'That's where I wanna live.'
132.14: 'This it—My resting place, forever. I'm settlin' here, 'cause I chose it Myself.'
132.15: 'I'm gon' bless her with everything she need—make sure the poor got bread to eat.'
132.16: 'Her priests? Dressed in salvation. And her saints? Shoutin' loud with joy.'
132.17: 'Right here, I'm growin' David's strength—like a horn risin' up. I got a lamp ready for My Anointed one.'
132.18: 'His enemies? I'm dressin' them in shame. But His crown? That thang gon' shine and flourish.'

133.1: Look at this—how good and how sweet it is when the fam dwells in unity!
133.2: It's like that anointing oil on the head—drippin' down Aaron's beard, all the way to the hem of his robe.
133.3: It's like the dew from Mount Hermon—settlin' on Zion's mountains. That's where the Lord dropped the blessing—life that don't ever run out.

134.1: Y'all look—bless the Lord, all His servants, the ones who stand up in His house through the night hours.
134.2: Lift them hands up in the sanctuary—and bless the Lord for real.
134.3: May the same Lord who made heaven and earth—turn 'round and bless you from Zion.

135.1: Praise the Lord! Y'all, lift up the name of the Lord—go 'head and bless Him, all His servants!
135.2: All y'all standin' in the house of the Lord, right there in His courts? Bless Him!
135.3: Praise the Lord, 'cause He's good—and His name? Sweet to sing.
135.4: The Lord picked Jacob for Himself—Israel is His treasure.
135.5: I know the Lord is great—our God stand way above every so-called god.
135.6: Whatever He wanna do? He do it. Heaven, earth, sea, deep places—He run all of it.
135.7: He sends the mist from across the earth, makes lightning ride the rain, pulls wind straight out His stash.
135.8: He struck down Egypt's firstborn—humans and animals both.
135.9: He dropped signs and wonders all over Egypt—right on Pharaoh and his whole crew.
135.10: He took down nations, crushed powerful kings—
135.11: Sihon from the Amorites, Og from Bashan, and all the kingdoms in Canaan—
135.12: And handed over their land as an inheritance—to His people, Israel.
135.13: Your name, Lord? It lasts forever. Your legacy gonna echo through every generation.
135.14: The Lord gon' bring justice to His people—and He gon' show mercy to His own.
135.15: The idols of these nations? Just silver and gold—manmade, handcrafted fakes.
135.16: They got mouths, but can't talk. Eyes, but they blind.
135.17: Ears, but can't hear a thing—and no breath in they body.
135.18: Folks who make 'em? Just as lifeless. Same for everybody who trusts in 'em.
135.19: House of Israel, bless the Lord! House of Aaron, bless the Lord!
135.20: House of Levi, bless the Lord! And everybody who fears the Lord—bless Him too!
135.21: Let the Lord be blessed straight outta Zion—where He lives in Jerusalem. Praise the Lord!

136.1: Give thanks to the Lord—'cause He good for real. For His mercy endures forever.
136.2: Thank the God of all gods. For His mercy endures forever.
136.3: Shout out to the Lord of all lords. For His mercy endures forever.
136.4: He the only One doin' wonders nobody else can pull off. For His mercy endures forever.
136.5: He built the heavens with wisdom. For His mercy endures forever.
136.6: Laid the earth right above the waters. For His mercy endures forever.
136.7: Made the big lights in the sky. For His mercy endures forever.
136.8: The sun to run things by day. For His mercy endures forever.
136.9: The moon and stars to shine at night. For His mercy endures forever.
136.10: He struck down Egypt's firstborn. For His mercy endures forever.
136.11: Brought Israel out the middle of all that mess. For His mercy endures forever.
136.12: With a strong hand and arms that don't fold. For His mercy endures forever.
136.13: Split the Red Sea clean in two. For His mercy endures forever.
136.14: And walked Israel right through it. For His mercy endures forever.
136.15: Then flipped it and drowned Pharaoh's whole squad. For His mercy endures forever.
136.16: He led His people through the wilderness. For His mercy endures forever.
136.17: Took down powerful kings. For His mercy endures forever.
136.18: Even the famous ones that looked unstoppable. For His mercy endures forever.
136.19: Like Sihon, king of the Amorites. For His mercy endures forever.
136.20: And Og, king of Bashan. For His mercy endures forever.
136.21: Then gave their land away as a blessing. For His mercy endures forever.
136.22: To Israel—His chosen one. For His mercy endures forever.
136.23: He remembered us when we were down bad. For His mercy endures forever.
136.24: And snatched us up from the enemy's grip. For His mercy endures forever.
136.25: He feeds everybody—all flesh, all people. For His mercy endures forever.
136.26: So give thanks to the God of heaven. For His mercy endures forever.

137.1: By the rivers of Babylon, we sat down—and we wept, just thinkin' 'bout Zion.
137.2: We hung up our harps on the willow trees—right there in the middle of that place.
137.3: The ones who snatched us up asked us to sing. The ones who robbed us wanted a show: 'Sing us one of them Zion songs!'
137.4: But how we supposed to sing the Lord's song… in a land that ain't home?
137.5: If I ever forget you, Jerusalem—let my right hand stop workin'.
137.6: If I don't keep you on my mind, let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth—if I don't put Jerusalem above my biggest joy.
137.7: Lord, remember what Edom said the day Jerusalem fell—they yelled, 'Tear it down! Burn it all! Wipe it clean to the ground!'
137.8: Babylon, you next. Destruction waitin' on you. Blessed is the one who pays you back for what you did to us.
137.9: Blessed is the one who takes your babies—and smashes them against the rocks.

138.1: Lord, I'ma praise You with everything in me. I'ma sing about You bold—don't care who's listenin', not even the so-called gods.
138.2: I'm bowin' toward Your holy place, liftin' Your name high—'cause Your love and truth been real. You even lifted Your Word above Your own name.
138.3: Soon as I cried out, You answered me. And You gave me strength deep in my soul.
138.4: All the kings gon' praise You too, Lord—when they hear what You really say.
138.5: They gon' sing about how You move—'cause Your glory? It's unmatched.
138.6: Yeah, You sit high—but You still see the lowly. And the proud? You keep 'em at a distance.
138.7: Even when I'm in the thick of trouble—You revive me. You stretch out Your hand and shut down my enemies. Your right hand? It saves me.
138.8: The Lord gon' finish what He started in me. Your mercy lasts forever, Lord—don't give up on what You made.

139.1: Lord, You done searched me—and You know me.
139.2: You know when I sit down and when I get up. You even know what I'm thinkin' from way off.
139.3: You see my path, You see me when I lay down. You know all my moves.
139.4: Before I even speak a word—You already know what I'm bout to say.
139.5: You got me surrounded—behind me, in front of me. And Your hand stay restin' on me.
139.6: That kind of knowledge? It's too much for me. Too high up—I can't even reach that.
139.7: Where could I run from Your Spirit? Where could I go to get away from You?
139.8: If I rise up to heaven, You there. If I lay my bed in hell? You still there.
139.9: If I fly off like the morning sun, way out to the edge of the sea…
139.10: Even there, Your hand gon' lead me. Your right hand gon' hold me down.
139.11: If I say, 'The dark gon' hide me,'—even night gon' light up around me.
139.12: Darkness can't hide from You, Lord. The night shine like daylight to You—dark and light feel the same in Your presence.
139.13: You the One who put me together from the inside. You was workin' in my mama's womb.
139.14: I praise You—'cause I'm fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are a wonder, and my soul know it deep.
139.15: You saw my frame even when I was hid—crafted in secret, stitched together low and quiet.
139.16: You saw me before I was even formed. And all my days? Already written in Your book—before one of 'em ever started.
139.17: Your thoughts about me? So precious, God. So many, I can't even count.
139.18: If I tried to add 'em up, they'd outnumber the grains of sand. And when I wake up? You still right here with me.
139.19: Lord, if only You would wipe out the wicked! Y'all bloodthirsty ones—get away from me.
139.20: They talk reckless against You. They throw Your name around like it ain't sacred.
139.21: Lord, You know I hate those who hate You. I can't stand the ones who fight against You.
139.22: I hate 'em with a holy hate—I count 'em like enemies.
139.23: Search me, God. Know my heart. Test me. Know what's got me anxious.
139.24: Look through me—if You find anything off, anything twisted—lead me back to the path that lasts forever.

140.1: Lord, get me outta the grip of evil men—keep me safe from the violent ones.
140.2: They be sittin' up plottin' evil deep in they heart—always ready to start somethin'.
140.3: They sharpen they tongue like a snake—venom under they lips, straight poison.
140.4: Keep me covered, Lord—keep me out the wicked's hands. These violent folks tryna trip me up on purpose.
140.5: The proud ones got traps laid out for me—ropes, nets, whole setups by the roadside. They waitin' to catch me slippin'.
140.6: But I said to the Lord, 'You my God.' Lord, please hear my cry—hear me when I call out.
140.7: O God, my saving strength—You the One who covered my head when the battle popped off.
140.8: Don't let the wicked get what they want, Lord. Don't let their plans win—don't let them get too full of themselves.
140.9: As for them loudmouths surroundin' me—let their own evil clap back on 'em.
140.10: Drop coals on their heads. Let 'em fall in fire. Deep pits. No bounce back.
140.11: Don't let the messy ones rise up. Let violence chase the violent 'til they fall under what they started.
140.12: But I know the Lord gon' defend the ones hurtin'—He gon' stand for the poor and the mistreated.
140.13: And the righteous? They gon' keep thankin' You. The upright? They gon' live right up in Your presence.

141.1: Lord, I'm cryin' out—don't take Your time gettin' to me! Hear me when I call.
141.2: Let my prayers rise up to You like incense. Let these lifted hands be like the evening sacrifice.
141.3: Lord, put a guard over my mouth—watch my lips like a bouncer on duty.
141.4: Don't let my heart lean toward anything evil. Don't let me run with folks who stay doin' dirt. And keep me from tastin' the luxury of the wicked.
141.5: If the righteous check me, I'll take it as love. If they rebuke me, that's like fresh oil on my head—I ain't gon' reject it. I'm still praying against the mess the wicked do.
141.6: Their leaders? Gon' fall hard—off the edge, off the throne. They'll finally hear my words, and know it was truth the whole time.
141.7: Our bones feel scattered like dirt from a plowed field—left near the grave, broken and exposed.
141.8: But my eyes? Stay locked on You, Lord God. You my refuge. Don't let me be left out here with nothin'.
141.9: Keep me from their traps, Lord. Don't let me fall in the mess they set up.
141.10: Let the wicked fall face-first in their own nets—while I walk out safe and untouched.

142.1: I cried out to the Lord with my voice—yeah, I'm speakin' it out loud. Lord, I'm beggin' You, hear me.
142.2: I laid it all out in front of Him—didn't hold nothin' back. Told Him exactly what I'm goin' through.
142.3: When I was overwhelmed and feelin' like I couldn't breathe—You still knew the way I was walkin'. But the enemy had traps waitin' on that same path.
142.4: Look to my right, Lord—ain't nobody there. No one got my back. Refuge gone. Don't nobody care about my soul.
142.5: So I cried to You, Lord—I said, 'You the only safe place I got. You my portion while I'm still alive.'
142.6: Please, hear me when I cry. I'm real low right now. Set me free from these folks comin' for me—they stronger than me.
142.7: Bring my soul up out this prison—so I can praise Your name like I want to. The righteous gon' surround me again—'cause I know You still gon' come through.

143.1: Lord, hear my prayer—listen close when I cry out. You faithful, You righteous—so answer me.
143.2: But please… don't judge me too hard. Ain't nobody alive righteous in Your sight.
143.3: My enemies comin' for my soul. They crushed me to the ground, got me sittin' in the dark like I'm already gone.
143.4: My spirit feel overwhelmed. My heart? Heavy and hurtin'.
143.5: I think back on how You used to move. I meditate on Your works—lookin' at the evidence of Your hands.
143.6: I stretch my hands out to You—my soul thirsty for You like dry land after drought.
143.7: Answer me quick, Lord—I'm barely holdin' on. Don't hide from me… I don't wanna be like the ones already laid out in the grave.
143.8: Let me hear Your love in the morning—'cause I'm puttin' my trust in You. Show me which way to walk—I'm liftin' my whole soul to You.
143.9: Lord, deliver me from my enemies—I'm takin' shelter in You.
143.10: Teach me how to do what You want—'cause You my God. Your Spirit good—lead me through upright paths.
143.11: Bring me back to life, Lord—for Your name's sake. Pull me outta this trouble 'cause You righteous.
143.12: In Your mercy, wipe out my enemies—shut down every soul tryna destroy mine. I belong to You—I'm Your servant.

144.1: Bless the Lord—my Rock, the One who trains my hands for war and my fingers for the fight.
144.2: He's my ride-or-die love, my fortress, my high tower, my deliverer. He's my shield, the One I run to for safety. And He's the One keepin' my people in check under me.
144.3: Lord… what's man that You even think about us? Why You care for us like this?
144.4: We here today, gone tomorrow—like a breath, like a shadow that disappears quick.
144.5: Lord, bend the sky and come down. Touch the mountains—make 'em smoke.
144.6: Flash Your lightning, scatter the enemy. Let them arrows fly—shut 'em down.
144.7: Stretch out Your hand from above—pull me out the deep waters. Save me from these outsiders—
144.8: The ones who talk lies and give fake handshakes with double meaning.
144.9: But I'ma sing a brand new song to You, God—praises on this ten-string harp.
144.10: You the One who saves kings—and You the One who pulled me, David, out from the sword's edge.
144.11: Do it again, Lord. Save me from these foreigners, with their slick talk and shady handshakes.
144.12: So our sons can grow up strong like planted trees—and our daughters stand tall like carved palace pillars.
144.13: Let our barns stay full, overflowin' with harvest. Let our sheep multiply in the fields—by the thousands and more.
144.14: Let our cattle stay heavy with blessing. No break-ins, no breakouts. No cries of pain in our streets.
144.15: People who got it like this? Yeah—they're blessed. But even better? Folks whose God is the Lord.

145.1: I'ma lift You up high, my God, my King—and I'ma bless Your name forever.
145.2: Every single day, I'ma bless You. I'ma keep praisin' Your name, no matter what.
145.3: The Lord is great—and worthy of the highest praise. His greatness? Ain't nobody touchin' it.
145.4: Each generation gon' tell the next about Your power—and all the mighty things You've done.
145.5: I stay meditatin' on Your glory—on how You shine, on all the wonders You worked.
145.6: People gon' talk about how strong You move—and I'ma tell the world how great You really are.
145.7: They gon' speak on Your goodness like a song on repeat—and shout about how righteous You are.
145.8: The Lord? Gracious and full of compassion. Slow to get angry. Real heavy on the mercy.
145.9: He good to everybody—and His kindness stretch over everything He made.
145.10: Everything You made gon' praise You, Lord—and Your people? We stay blessin' Your name.
145.11: They talkin' about the glory of Your kingdom—they speak on Your power with pride.
145.12: They makin' sure everybody know—about Your mighty acts and Your glorious reign.
145.13: Your kingdom? Everlasting. Your rule? Generation to generation—it don't stop.
145.14: The Lord lift up the ones who fall—and He raise up the ones who bowed down low.
145.15: All eyes lookin' to You, Lord—and You provide right on time.
145.16: You open up Your hand—and every living thing gets what it needs.
145.17: The Lord is righteous in every way—and kind in everything He does.
145.18: He close to all who call on Him—especially the ones who do it with a real heart.
145.19: He gon' answer the ones who fear Him—He gon' hear their cry and pull up with the save.
145.20: He protectin' all who love Him—but the wicked? He gon' shut that down.
145.21: I'ma speak praises with my whole mouth—and everybody, all flesh, gon' bless His holy name forever and ever.

146.1: Praise the Lord! My soul, you better get in on this praise!
146.2: Long as I'm breathin'? I'ma praise the Lord. While I still got life, I'ma sing to my God.
146.3: Don't put your trust in big names or people in power—man can't save you.
146.4: Soon as they take they last breath, it's a wrap. They go back to dust, and all their plans die with 'em.
146.5: But blessed is the one whose help is the God of Jacob—the one whose hope stay in the Lord.
146.6: The same Lord who made heaven, earth, sea, and everything in it—He stay true forever.
146.7: He fight for the oppressed. He feed the hungry. And He break chains for the ones locked down.
146.8: The Lord open blind eyes. He lift up the low. And He loves the righteous.
146.9: He got eyes on the outsiders. He look out for orphans and widows. But the wicked? He flips their path upside down.
146.10: The Lord stay reigning forever—your God, Zion, through every generation. Praise the Lord!

147.1: Praise the Lord! It's a good thing to sing to our God—feels good, and that praise? It's beautiful.
147.2: The Lord buildin' up Jerusalem—He bringin' the outcasts of Israel back home.
147.3: He the One who heals the brokenhearted—and wraps up every wound.
147.4: He countin' every star in the sky—and He know all their names.
147.5: Our Lord is great—mighty in power. His wisdom? Can't be measured.
147.6: He lift up the humble—but He slam the wicked down to the ground.
147.7: Sing to the Lord with thanksgiving—bring out the instruments, give Him praise on the strings.
147.8: He's the One who covers the sky with clouds, sends rain to the earth, and makes the grass grow up in the hills.
147.9: He feed the animals—yeah, even the baby ravens when they cry.
147.10: He ain't impressed by horse strength—and He don't care about how fast a man can run.
147.11: What He loves? People who fear Him. Folks who hope in His mercy.
147.12: Jerusalem, go 'head and praise the Lord! Zion, give your God His praise!
147.13: He's the One who secured your gates—and blessed your kids inside your walls.
147.14: He bring peace to your borders—and fill your table with the finest wheat.
147.15: When He speaks, His Word hits the earth quick—it moves fast.
147.16: He throws down snow like wool—spreads out frost like ashes.
147.17: Hail falls from Him like pebbles—who can even stand that kind of cold?
147.18: Then He speaks again—and melts it all. Wind starts blowin', water starts flowin'.
147.19: He gave His Word to Jacob—His laws and truth to Israel.
147.20: No other nation got treated like that—they don't know what He showed us. Praise the Lord!

148.1: Praise the Lord! Lift Him up from the heavens—praise Him from way up high!
148.2: Praise Him, angels! Praise Him, all His heavenly squad!
148.3: Sun and moon, give Him glory! Stars, y'all shine and praise too!
148.4: Y'all highest heavens—waters way above the skies—y'all better praise Him!
148.5: All y'all were made by His word—so praise the name of the Lord!
148.6: He set y'all in place forever—what He spoke? It stands. Ain't nobody reversing that.
148.7: Now praise Him from the earth too—all the sea monsters and deep ocean zones!
148.8: Fire and hail, snow and clouds—storm winds doin' what He say!
148.9: Mountains, hills—get in on this! Fruit trees and mighty cedars too!
148.10: Wild beasts and farm animals—everything that crawls and everything that flies, praise Him!
148.11: Kings of the earth and all y'all people—rulers and judges, that mean you too!
148.12: Young men and women, old heads and babies—everybody!
148.13: Let all creation praise the Lord's name—'cause only His name stands above it all. His glory? Higher than heaven and earth.
148.14: He raised up strength for His people—praise rise from His saints, the children of Israel, the ones close to His heart. Praise the Lord!

149.1: Praise the Lord! Sing somethin' new to Him—lift up His name in the middle of the faithful.
149.2: Let Israel get loud for their Maker—Zion's kids need to be joyful for their King.
149.3: Let 'em praise His name with a dance—bring out the tambourine and harp and give Him glory.
149.4: The Lord takes pleasure in His people—He gon' crown the humble with salvation.
149.5: Let the saints celebrate in glory—sing out loud, even from your bed.
149.6: Let high praise stay on your lips—and a two-edged sword in your hand.
149.7: To bring justice on the nations—and correction to the people.
149.8: To lock up their kings in chains—and their big names in iron cuffs.
149.9: To carry out what God already wrote down—this right here? This honor belong to all His saints. Praise the Lord!

150.1: Praise the Lord! Praise God in His house—praise Him out in the heavens where His power stretches wide!
150.2: Praise Him for the mighty things He's done—praise Him 'cause His greatness stay unmatched!
150.3: Blow the trumpet and praise Him! Play the strings—harps, lutes, all that—and lift Him up!
150.4: Bring the tambourine, bring the dance—let them bodies move for His name. Play them strings, run them flutes—give Him glory with sound!
150.5: Hit them loud cymbals! Let the clashing ring out—don't hold back!
150.6: If you got breath in your body? Praise the Lord. Praise the Lord!
